tei:div.tei:p: (āḥ)༄༅// rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i bskyed rim rnal 'byor bcu gcig gi rnam par bshad pa mkha' spyod lam bzang gsal ba'i nyin byed bzhugs so// ༈ /na mo gu ru bud+dha dh+wa dza ye/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i bskyed rim rnal 'byor bcu gcig gi rnam par bshad pa mkha' spyod lam bzang gsal ba'i nyin byed ces bya ba/ bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i dpal mkha' spyod dbang mo la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// rdo rje btsun mos nyer bzung nā ro paṇa chen dang*// pham thing sku mched mal lo sa skya'i bla chen rje// de sras zung dang paṇa chen 'phags pa sogs// rim par byon pa'i brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams la 'dud// khyad par snyigs dus bstan pa'i gsal byed mchog /sngags 'chang bla ma kun dga' rin chen dang*// bsod nams ye shes mthar phyin dbang po'i zhabs// 'dzam gling mdzes rgyan grags pa'i mtshan can rgyal// rgyal kun spro bsdu'i byed po mus chen rje// sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin mdzad pa// grub pa'i dbang phyug ting 'dzin rab brtan zhabs// spyan snga kun dga'i mtshan can phyag gi gnas// gzhan yang shes bya kun gzigs thams cad mkhyen// mkhan chen 'jam pa'i dbyangs sogs myur lam 'di'i// bka' drin thob pa'i bla ma mchog rnams kyi// zhabs pad btud de rnam bshad 'chad la spro// de la 'dir rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sgo nas mchog gi dngos grub sgrub par byed pa'i tshul/ rgyud sde rin po che las gsungs pa grub pa'i dbang phyug rnams kyis bkral ba'i tshul mang du yod kyang*/ gtso bor gyur pa ni rje btsun sa skya pas bzhed pa'i mchog bsgrub pa'i dmar mo skor gsum mtshan gsol ba ste/ mi dbang in+d+ra bhu ti nas brgyud pa in+d+ra mkha' spyod dang*/ mai tri mkha' spyod/ nā ro mkha' spyod de rnam gsum yin no// de la in+d+ra mkha' spyod dam/

zhal gnyis ma chung bar grags pa la mi dbang chos gsum du grags pa zhal gnyis ma'i sgrub thabs/ sngags de kho na nyid dang*/ phag mo las bcu dang gsum yin la/ gong ma gnyis ni mi dbang gnyis kyis mdzad la/ las bcu ni de'i man ngag dang snyan brgyud rnams rje btsun bha len+d+ra ru rtses mdzad pa yin no// 'di gsum lag tu blangs shing 'khyer bde ba'i don 'grel gyi yi ge gsum rje btsun grags pas mdzad pa yod do// de yang las bcu ni lha so bdun ma'am/ zhal gnyis ma che chung gnyis sam/ zhal gcig ma la sogs pa'i gang gi sgor zhugs kyang rung*/ rang gzhan gyi don byed pa la las kyi yan lag bcu dgos te/ thog mar bsnyen pa/ gzhan don du slob ma rjes bzung*/ tshes bcu dang 'brel ba'i tshogs mchod/ rang gzhan gnyis ka dang 'brel ba gzhon nu ma'i mchod pa/ gnas skabs thams cad dang 'brel ba gtor ma/ dman pa'i dngos grub dang 'brel ba sbyin sreg bu chung gsar bu la phan 'dogs pa srung 'khor/ las rtsub mo'i dbang du byas te gdug pa can tshar bcad pa sum+bha'i cho ga bsgom pas phyir bzlog pa dang*/ bris pas phyir bzlog pa dang bcu yin no// 'di dag ni rdo rje rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyi ma tshang ba kha skong ba yin kyang*/ gtso bor zhal gnyis ma chung ba dang*/ sngags kyi de nyid grub pa'i yan lag yin no// brgyud pa ni/ rnal 'byor ma/ lā bā pa/ in+d+ra bhu ti/ lcam legs smin/ bir+wa pa/ a bhi dzu ta pa/ hang du dkar po/ yang bir+wa pa/ sha ba ri pa/ mai tri pa/ rgya gar phyag na/ hang du dkar po phyis hang du dkar pos rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud man ngag dang bcas pa rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nyid la gsan gsungs pa/ yang bir+wa pa/ a wa dhū tī/ ltong dar ba/ bsod snyoms pa che chung*/ hang du dkar po/ bla ma hang du la bal po'i lo tsā ba ye shes rdo rjes gsan/ de la rje btsun sa skya pa chen pos gsan gsungs so// mai tri mkha' spyod ni/

'bum phrag gsum pa las byung ba'i sgyu 'phrul drwa ba chen po ral pa gyen du brdzes pa'i rgyud las gsungs pa'i rgyud tshig sgrub thabs can rig pa 'dzin pa'i sgrub thabs su mtshan gsol ba/ slob dpon gnyis med rdo rje ste mai tri pas mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang gi cho ga li la badz+ra ste khang gsar bas mdzad pa'i rje btsun gyi mchan 'byar ba rnams yod cing*/ brgyud pa/ rnal 'byor ma/ mai tri pa/ nam mkha'i paṇ+ḍi ta/ bla ma a/ shākya rak+ṣi ta/ ka na ka shrī/ dza ya se na/ phyis bla ma a nyid la gsan/ yang phyis mai tri pa'i slob ma ka ma la badz+ra bya ba la bla ma khang gsar bas gsan no// yang na lo ke shwa ra/ shā ba ri pa/ a wa dhū tī/ mṛ ti kā ma la badz+ra/ li la badz+ra ste khang gsar bas paṇ+ḍi ta de nyid dang*/ sum lo dar ma yon tan gnyis la rje btsun grags pas gsan/ yang rnal 'byor ma spyan ras gzigs/ byang sems blo gros rin chen/ shā wa ri/ mai tri pa/ rgya gar phyag na/ ka ma la badz+ra rnams so// 'di'i rgyud sgrub thabs bag tsam mi 'dra ba sgrub thabs bzhin byed gsungs so// nā ro mkha' spyod nā ro pa'i gzhung chung la sa chen gyi mchan 'byar/ sa chen gyis mdzad pa'i rnal 'byor bcu gcig rtse mo'i mchan sbyar/ rje btsun gyis pra sen dbab pa/ tshes bcu'i mchod pa gnyis/ byin rlabs bya tshul phyi rol tshogs gsog gnod sbyin mo dbang du bya ba/ sman chen gyi bcud len/ mar me'i sbyin sreg sogs dang*/ 'phags pa'i yig sna dang bcas pa yod cing*/ 'di'i pra sen dbab pa yab yum thun mong gi yin zhing*/ yum gyi thun mong ma yin pa rdzas sngags rten 'brel la brten nas pra sen dbab pa dang*/ 'pho ba dang*/ dbang bzhi lus sgrig sogs zab chos yin gsungs/ sgrub thabs kyi brten pa'i rgyud ni/ rtsa rgyud kyi le'u zhe bdun par yum la brten nas dngos grub sgrub tshul gsungs pa'i man ngag rdo rje rnal 'byor mas jo bo nā ro pa la gnang ba'i khyad chos yin gsungs/

le'u 'dir rje btsun ma'i nye ba'i snying po/ mkha' 'gro ma kun gyi nye ba'i snying por gsungs la/ 'di nyid dbang po rab la bzlas pa tsam gyis 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dngos grub thams cad bskyed par gsungs shing*/ las tshogs kyang bcu gcig gsungs so// le'u zhe brgyad par yum gyi nye snying gsungs/ le'u bdun pa dang brgyad par snying po phan yon dang bcas pa dang lnga bcu par de nyid kyi las tshogs bcu gnyis kyang bka' stsal te/ de bas na rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nyid kyis jo bo nā ro pa la dngos su stsal ba'i gdams pa nā ro ta pas gzhan la ma gnang bar pham thing pa sku mched la stsal ba'i khyad chos bskyed pa'i rim pa phag mo mkha' spyod/ rdzogs pa'i rim pa rtsa dbu ma/ lam gyi yan lag dang bcas pa gsungs pa'i zab gnad khyad par can nyid 'dir bshad par bya ba yin no// kha cig lang ka li ya'i sbyor ba la brten nas dngos grub thob par gsungs pas gzhan las khyad par 'phags so zer/ de ni ma nges te mai tri mkha' spyod la'ang de gsungs par ma mthong bar smra ba zad do// kha cig phag mo mkha' spyod dang rtsa dbu ma gnyis bskyed rdzogs zab shos yin pas phyogs gcig tu bsdom nas smos kyi/ de gnyis bskyed rdzogs su sbyor rgyu ni min te/ der go cha gsum ldan du bshad pa dang*/ pho nya'i lam snas de la mi 'grim pa'i phyir dang*/ rtsa dbu ma ni kun spyod dang*/ mngon spyod las gsungs pa'i don lū hi pa'i rdzogs rim la sbyor rgyu yin no// des na yum gyi rtsa dbu ma'i tha snyad med do gsungs mod/ de ni mtha' gcig tu min te rje btsun gyis rtsa ba'i khrid yig jo bo nā ro pas gzhan la ma gnang ba'i gdams pa/ bskyed rim phag mo mkha' spyod/ rdzogs rim rtsa dbu ma sogs lhan du gsungs pa'i phyir dang*/ bskyed rim zab mo la mkha' spyod rnal 'byor dang*/ rdzogs rim dbu ma'i rnal 'byor/

zhes rgyun du 'don pa dang 'gal ba'i phyir ro// rnal 'byor gyi lam gyi skabs su go cha gsum ldan du bsgom par gsungs pa ni/ yab kyi rnal 'byor pas kyang bsgom du rung ba la dgongs nas gsungs shing mtha' gcig tu dgos pa ni min te yum la brten pa'i dbu ma la de mi dgos shing pho nya'i lam gyi skabs su gsungs pa yum gyi khrid min par yab kho na la sbyor ba byed pa'i gnad ma rtogs par snang ngo*// des na khrid yig rje btsun gyi de gcig pu la yab dang yum la brten pa'i rtsa dbu ma'i khrid gnyis thon pa yin te/ rnal 'byor gyi lam la dga' ba'i khrid la yum gyi dbu ma dang*/ pho nya'i lam la dga' ba'i khrid la yab kyi dbu ma'i khrid du 'dogs par mdzad do// kun spyod dang mngon spyod las bstan/ gzhan rtsa rgyud las ma gsungs pa yang ma yin te/ pho nya mchog 'bring tha ma rnams// zhes dang*/ rnal 'byor pas dus khyad par du// rigs ldan ma rnams rtag mchod bya// zhes pa rnams kyis dbu ma'i nyams len bstan pa bshad pas so// yab la sbyor ba'i tshe lū hi pa la sbyar chog pa ni dpal mngon par rtogs pa las/ ā li kā li mdun bsam nas// rnal 'byor chen po la gso bya// zhes pa nas/ bsam gyis mi khyab de bsams na// de la gzungs ni thob par gyur// zhes pa'i bar gyis dbu ma ston par yang mdzad pas yab la yang dbu ma'i khrid bzhed pa yin no// de ltar na ring brgyud du 'gyur ram snyam na/ brgyud pa nye ring gnyis ka 'dod kyang zab gnad nye brgyud che ba bzhed do// de lta bu'i bskyed rim phag mo mkha' spyod nā ro pa'i bzhed pa ltar 'chad pa la/ nyams len rnal 'byor bcu gcig tu bsdus pa ltar yin zhing*/ bskyed rim de ni gsang sngags kyi bye brag tu 'khor lo bde mchog gi bskyed rim mthar thug pa yin gsungs shing*/ de'i rgyu mtshan yang gsang sngags thams cad kyi mthar thug pa ni rgyud sde sgo drug pa bde mchog yin te/

ji srid mdo bya spyod pa dang*// rnal 'byor gsang mtha'i dbye ba yis// zhes so// de'i zab don mthar thug pa ni grub chen lū dril nag gsum gyis bkral ba'i lam rim du 'dus la/ 'dir de dag gi don bsdus nas nyams len 'khyer bde la 'dus che zhing gnad zab pas so// de 'dir ji ltar 'dus pa'i tshul yang bsgrub bya sgrub byed thams cad 'dus pa yin no// bsgrub bya'i dbang du byas na rnam pa thams cad pa'i sangs rgyas nyid la mkha' 'gro mar ming bzhag pa nyid don du gnyer bya yin la/ de yang sangs rgyas la mkha' 'gro ma'i ming brjod pa ni/ rje btsun rtse mos/ mkha' 'gro ma ni don chos kyi sku nam mkha' ltar mi rtog pa yin la/ de'i rnam pa mkha' 'gro'i skur ston pas so// zhes dang*/ mkha' 'gro ma ni mkha' 'gro'i sku nyid ston pa'i phyir ram/ yang na rdo rje gur gyi rgyud las/ ḍai bi ha yas ga ma ni// sangs rgyas khams dang rnam par dag /nam mkha' kun tu spyod grub pa// mkha' 'gro ma zhes bya bar brjod// ces gsungs so// zhes pa ltar ro// gal te kyai rdo rje dang bde mchog lta bu la mkha' 'gro ma'i ming mi 'thad la/ bdag med ma dang phag mo lta bu la de'i tha snyad thob par rigs snyam na min te/ gong du lung drangs pa dang*/ gzhan yang brtag gnyis las/ kyai rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma drwa ba'i gdams pa zhes dang*/ mkha' 'gro ma ni rdo rje gur// zhes dang*/ bde mchog las kyang*/ ḍā ki ni dz+wa la saṃ bha ra// zhes mkha' 'gro ma'i tha snyad gsungs shing*/ de la sogs te mang por mkha' 'gro ma'i tha snyad bshad pas ma nges pa yin no// de lta bu'i mkha' 'gro ma la rigs bye brag bsam gyis mi khyab pa yod kyang*/ stong phrag bdun cu rtsa gnyis su 'dus la/ de rnams sum cu rtsa bdun nam rtsa gnyis su 'dus/ de yang rigs nyer bzhi'am brgyad dam lngar 'dus/ de yang rdo rje phag mo la 'dus te/

sangs rgyas kun 'dus mkha' 'gro ma// zhes dang*/ mkha' 'gro ma ni nyi shu bzhi// phag mo yi ni rigs las byung*// zhes dang*/ mkha' 'gro grangs de stong phrag bdun cu gnyis// bsdu byed sum cu bdun nam sum cu gnyis// de dag rang bzhin lha mo bco lnga'i gtso// gnyis med zhabs la/ zhes dang*/ dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma// mkha' 'gro ma yi 'khor los sgyur// ye shes lnga dang sku gsum nyid// ces bshad pa ltar ro// de yang nang lus kyi rten 'brel gyi dbang gis te/ rdo rje'i lus la rtsa ji snyed yod kyang stong phrag bdun cu rtsa gnyis su 'dus la/ de yang rtsa sum cu rtsa bdun dang*/ de yang yul nyer bzhi'i rtsa/ bu ga brgyad/ sbas pa'i rtsa lnga/ mthar de yang dbu ma kho na la 'dus te/ phag mo ti la ka zhes brjod do// zhes pa ltar ro// de bzhin du yi ge dang*/ bdud rtsi dang*/ rlung gi dkyil 'khor la yang de ltar du sbyar ro// rten dkyil 'khor bzhir ma zad brten pa sems kyang gzung 'dzin gnyis su 'du bas so// de dag de ltar 'ong ba yang phyi rol na ji ltar yod pa ltar nang lus la yang tshang bar shes dgos te/ ji ltar phyi rol de bzhin nang*// zhes gsungs pas so// sgrub byed kyi dbang du byas na yang*/ 'dir 'dus te/ de yang lam 'di nyid ni ltos sa yab la bzhag nas ltos chos yum du len pa bya ba smin byed yab la ltos pa'i nyams len khyad par can nyid yin zhing*/ smin byed ni yab la ltos te/ 'di nyid kyi dbang bzhi ni byin rlabs kyi tshul can nyid yin pas smin byed mi rung ste/ deng song rdo rje phag mo yi// byin rlabs dbang bskur yin zhes zer// zhes dang*/ phag mo'i byin rlabs smin byed du// rgyud sde kun las gsungs pa med// ces dang*/ rdo rje phag mo nyid las kyang*// dbang bskur thob cing dam tshig ldan// de la byin rlabs bya zhes gsungs// zhes so// de nas yab kyi dkyil 'khor du ma smin pa la ni 'di sbyin par mi bya zhing*/

sbyin kyang*/ dbang bskur med par byin rlabs na// dam tshig nyams par thub pas gsungs// zhes pa'i nyes par 'gyur ro// yab kyi dkyil 'khor du smin zin pa la 'di'i byin rlabs nas lam bsgom na myur du mchog 'grub par 'gyur na man ngag gi gnad yin no// 'o na yum gyi sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor du smin mi nus na de la dgos pa ci zhe na/ dbang gis smin pa la ting nge 'dzin khyad par can rgyud la skyed par byed pa ste/ rje btsun gyis de ltar du bshad cing de yang zhal gnyis ma chung ba las gsung bar bshad pa lta bu'o// 'o na 'di nyid ches zab par mi 'grub ste yab kyi phyi dkyil la ltos pas so snyam na/ 'o na lam zab kyang ches zab par mi 'gyur te smin byed phyi dkyil la ltos pa'i phyir te/ phyi dkyil du dbang ma thob pa la bstan du mi rung bas so// sgrub byed kyi dbang du byas na yang 'dir 'dus te/ sangs rgyas thob byed kyi lam la zab pa ni rdo rje theg pa yin la/ de la 'khor lo bde mchog gi lugs kyi rgyud sde sgo drug yod pa las gsang mtha' nyid zab pa'o// sgo drug po ji ltar yin na/ rtsa rgyud las/ rgod dang lta ba lag bcangs dang*// gnyis gnyis 'khyud la sogs pa'i bdag /rgyud rnams kun tu ma gsungs te// de nyid 'dus pa 'khor sdom pa'i// gsang ba'ang rdo rje 'jigs byed las// dkyil 'khor rnams kyi mchog 'di ni// ma byung 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro// zhes pas bstan te/ rgod pa dag pa bya rgyud/ lta ba spyod rgyud/ lag bcangs rnal 'byor rgyud/ gnyis 'khyud dag pa bla med/ gzhan las ma gsungs pa'i don 'dir bstan pas gsang ba'i mtha' zhes bla med spyi las zab par grub la/ de yang rnal 'byor rgyud kyi mtshan gzhi de nyid 'dus pa dang*/ ma rgyud kyi mtshan gzhi 'khor lo sdom pa dang*/ sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor sogs yin zhing*/ pha rgyud kyi mtshan gzhi 'dus pa dang*/

'jigs byed sogs yin la/ de las kyang ma gsungs zhes so// des na/ ji srid mdo bya spyod pa dang*// rnal 'byor gsang mtha'i dbye ba yis// zhes pa ltar mdo sde rtogs pa'i rgyud dang*/ bya ba spyod pa rnal 'byor/ rnal 'byor gsang mtha'i rgyud yin/ rnal 'byor gsang mtha'i rgyud la pha rgyud dang ma rgyud gnyis/ phyi ma la rgyud sde sgo drug yod de/ he ru ka rnam snang*/ rin 'byung*/ 'od dpag med/ don grub/ rdo rje sems dpa'i rigs kyi rgyud drug go /yang na bya spyod rnal 'byor rgyud gsum/ rnal 'byor chen po pha'i rgyud/ rnal 'byor chen mo ma'i rgyud/ ma'i yang ma bla na med pa ste drug go /de ltar na de thams cad las rtsa rgyud le'u nga gcig pa bshad rgyud lngas 'chad pa'i lugs kyis gsang mtha' nyid zab par bzhed cing*/ de'i yang nyams len grub pa'i slob dpon lū dril nag po pa gsum gyis bkral ba'i lugs su 'dus/ de'i yang snying po ni phyi dkyil du dbang thob rjes 'di'i byin rlabs kyis smin par byas nas/ jo bo nā ro pa'i lugs kyi mkha' spyod ma dbang bzhi lus bsgrigs su bsgom pa 'dir 'dus pas so// 'di la yab kyi lam rgyas pa'i nyams len thams cad 'dus pa'i tshul yang*/ phyi dkyil sogs rgyas pa'i tshe rten dga' ba gsum ldan du bsgom pa ni/ 'dir rnal 'byor ma'i skur ldang ba dang*/ bdud rtsi myang ba dang*/ thugs kar bam̐ yig bsgom pa dang gsum du 'dus/ sngon 'gro tshogs gnyis bsags pa ni tshad med bzhi dang bla ma'i rnal 'byor la 'dus/ dngos gzhi bskyed rim bsgom pa ni 'di'i bdag lhar bskyed pa/ 'gro ba dag par bya ba/ dpa' bo dpa' mos byin gyis rlabs pa gsum du 'dus te/ de gsum ni rim pa ltar bdag gi gzhi sbyong bsgyur dang*/ gzhan gyi gzhi sbyong bsgyur dang*/ 'khor 'das thams cad rnal 'byor ma'i skur ro gcig tu bsre ba yin zhing lū dril sogs rgyas pa la yang gzhi bsgyur ba'i theg pa nyams su len pa'i rnal 'byor mthar thug de las med pa'i phyir ro// des na 'di'i rtogs rigs thams cad 'dir 'dus par shes par bya'o// gal te phyi dkyil du rgyas pa'i tshe srung 'khor gzhal yas khang lha tshogs thams cad dang bcas pa bsgom la/

'dir bcom ldan 'das ma gcig pu nyid bsgom pas na snga ma rnams mi 'du'am snyam na/ de ni min te yum gyi kha ṭ+wāṃ ga la de dag tshang bar bzhed pa'i phyir/ ji ltar tshang na yum gyi kha ṭ+wāṃ ni lha dang*/ de yang gtso bor yab kyi sku yin te/ kha ṭ+wāṃ ga ni lha yi sku// zhes bshad cing*/ ḍā ma ru dang g.yer kha gsung*/ 'phan rtse gsum pas ni thugs rnam par thar pa'i sgo gsum mtshon pas yab kyi sku gsung thugs mtshon la/ yang na kha ṭ+wāṃ ga'i mas kyi rdo rje phyed pas srung 'khor/ rkang pa'i brgyad gzhog dur khrod brgyad/ sna tshogs rdo rje gzhal yas khang*/ thod pa skam rlon rnyid gsum ni sku gsung thugs kyi 'khor lo/ bum pa ni bde chen 'khor lo/ steng gi rdo rje phyed pa ni tog yin no// rten gyi dkyil 'khor du ma zad brten pa lha yang tshang ste/ steng gi rdo rje phyed pa bcom ldan 'das/ yum ni rje btsun ma nyid dngos su snang ba/ bum pa snying po'i rnal 'byor ma bzhi bum thod dang bcas pa/ mi mgo gsum gyis thugs gsung sku'i dpa' bo dang dpa' mo bzhi bcu rtsa brgyad dang*/ sna tshogs rdo rje ni dam tshig gi 'khor lo'i rnal 'byor ma brgyad yin no// lha drug cu rtsa gnyis kyi sngags thams cad rnal 'byor ma'i sngags 'di la 'dus par bshad de/ 'dis bzlas pa thams cad kyi go chod do// de nas phyi dkyil du byin rlabs drug skor gyi tshe lha thams cad kyi gnas su sarba bud+dha sogs yum gyi sngags kyis byin gyis rlabs pa dang*/ bum bzlas kyi tshe yang rnal 'byor ma'i nye snying 'dis lha thams cad kyi go chod par mdzad pa yang 'di la dgongs pa yin no// des na bskyed rim bzlas pa dang bcas pa mthar thug 'dir ma 'dus pa med pas bum dbang gi lam rgyas pa mtha' dag tshang*/ gsang dbang sogs tshang tshul dbang bzhi lus sgrigs kyi skabs su 'chad do// lam rgyas pa'i spyod lam rnal 'byor kyang 'di'i rnal 'byor bcu gcig tu 'du bar tshul bzhin shes pas nyams su blangs na mchog gi dngos grub tshegs med du thob par 'gyur pa ni gdon mi za'o// de lta bu'i sgrub thabs de nyams su len pa'i tshul ni nā ro ta pa'i gzhung don sa chen gyis bkral ba ltar yin te/

de la gsum/ sgom pa po rten gyi gang zag de'i bsgom bya'i lam/ des thob pa'i 'bras bu'o// dang po ni nā ro pas 'di'i sgrub thabs kyi gzhung du rnal 'byor pas zhes pas bstan te/ de yang 'di ni lū nag sogs phyi dkyil rgyas pa'i rten gyi gang zag ston byed kyi gzhung gi brjod bya thams cad bsdus nas bstan te/ 'di nyams su len pa'i rten gyi gang zag la snga ma gsum gyi gang zag gi mtshan nyid tshang ba'i steng du 'di'i sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor du dbang thob la ma nyams pa zhig dgos pa'o// gnyis pa lam la rnal 'byor bcu gcig ste/ nyal dang ldang dang bdud rtsi myang*// tshad med bla ma bdag lhar bskyed// 'gro ba dag pa'i rnal 'byor dang*// dpa' bo dpa' mos byin gyis brlabs// ngag bzlas yid bzlas gnyis gcig yin// bsam gyis mi khyab rnal 'byor dang*// spyod lam gyi ni rnal 'byor te// de ltar rnal 'byor bcu gcig go /zhes pa ltar ro// de yang go rim de ltar du 'byung ba ni gzhung du/ dang po re zhig ces 'byung bas bstan te/ de yang sgrub thabs bsgom pa'i sngon du ldang ba'i rnal 'byor 'gro dgos shing*/ de'i yang sngon du nyal ba'i rnal 'byor 'gro dgos pa'i phyir/ des na rnal 'byor bcu gcig gi dang po kho nar re shig rnal 'byor pas nyal ba'i rnal 'byor la gnas par bya'o// zhes 'brel lo// de yang nyal ba'i rnal 'byor sogs dang po gsum ni gzhung gis bsam mi khyab nas/ spyod lam du ldang bar bstan pas zin te/ de gnyis kyi rnal 'byor bsam mi khyab tu gnas pa las rnal 'byor ma'i skur langs te/ bdud rtsi myang bas ldang ba'o// gsungs so// de la dang po nyal ba'i rnal 'byor la gnyis/ bskyed rim gyi phyogs sam ngang du nyal ba'i thun tha ma'i 'jug la seṅges btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri'i steng du rang rnal 'byor ma rgyan dang phyag mtshan spangs pa bu mo gzhon nu'i rnam pa can gyi mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma rdo rje chos kyi rnam pa can bzhugs pa'i pang du mgo bos btud de nyal bar dmigs la nyal lo// 'di zhu bde lhan skyes bde ba'i ngang nyal ba yang yin no// gnyis pa rdzogs rim gyi phyogs sam ngang du nyal ba ni/

bsam mi khyab sgom pa de'i ngang du nyal lo// bsgom na skad cig gis stong par sgom la spros bral gyi ngang la nyal gsungs/ 'di rang bzhin lhan skyes stong pa'i ngang la nyal ba yin no// de yang zhi gnas shas che na dang po ltar dang*/ gsal ba dang bde ba shas che na phyi ma ltar nyal bas zung 'jug tu 'gyur ba yin no// gnyis pa ldang ba'i rnal 'byor ni ldang ran pa dang nam mkhar ḍā ma ru'i sgra oṃ gsum ma'i sgra'am/ nye snying du grags pas bskul te rang rnal 'byor ma rgyan dang phyag mtshan med pa'i rnam par ldang ngo*// de yang nyal lugs gnyis yod pa'i dang po ltar na sku de nyid kyis ldang zhing*/ phyi ma ltar na chu las nya ldang ba'i rnam par stong pa'i ngang las skad cig gis rje btsun ma phyag mtshan med pa'i skur ldang bar bya'o// de lta bu'i nyal lugs kyi rnal 'byor de gnyis las dang pos snod 'jig pa dang*/ bcud kyi sems can 'chi ba'i rim pa phra rags dang bcas pa sbyong zhing*/ gtso bor bsam mi khyab tu nyal bas 'chi rim sbyong*/ rmi lam 'od gsal du bsgyur bas/ rmi lam nyid thabs kyis zin par byas pas bar do sbyong*/ ldang ba'i rnal 'byor gyis skye ba sbyong*/ des na skye 'chi bar do gsum gyi bag chags rtog snang dang bcas pa mtha' dag sbyong bar shes dgos shing*/ phar phyin theg par yang kun slong gis dbang gi gnyid dge bar bsgyur ba tsam yod kyang*/ 'dir nyal ba'i rnal 'byor du sbyong byed ngo sprad nas nyams su len pa yin/ bskyed rim yang mngal skyes ltar rim gyis skye ba dang*/ rdzus skyes ltar gcig char skye ba gnyis yod pa'i dbang gis/ ldang ba yang sku de nyid kyis ldang ba dang*/ chu las nya 'phar gyi tshul du ldang ba gnyis yod/ yang na de las rim gyi ldang ba dang*/ gcig char du ldang ba gnyis kyang gsungs so// gsum pa bdud rtsi myang ba ni/ sems kyis snying ga'i bam̐ mchod par bsam la 'bru gsum brjod cing myang bar bya ste/

de la rab ni ril bu gsum/ 'bring gnyis/ tha ma gcig myang bar bya'o// med na chang hub gsum btung ngo*// zhes gsungs pas bdud rtsi ril bu yod na myang*/ de tsam ma 'byor na chang la bdud rtsi ril bu gcig btab la myang*/ de'ang ma 'byor na chang byin gyis brlabs te 'bru gsum brjod pas myang zhing*/ spyir lus kyi rtsa gnas thams cad dang*/ bye brag tu snying ga'i bam̐ la mchod pas ma dag pa'i skyon thams cad sbyong nas bde chen gyi ye shes brgyud la skyes par bsam/ de ni 'dul ba yan chad kyi khrus kyi rnal 'byor thams cad las mchog tu gyur pa'i dag byed kyi thabs khyad par can yin la/ rang gi lus lhar bsgom pa'i sku'i dga' ba/ bdud rtsi myang ba gsung gi dga' ba/ bam̐ yig sgom pa thugs kyi dga' ba ste dga' ba gsum ldan du bsgom/ des tha mal pa'i lus ngag yid gsum sbyong bar byed do// bzhi pa tshad med ni gzhung du sems can thams cad 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho las bsgral la rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi bde ba la 'god par bya'o// zhes tshad med pa'i rnal 'byor sngon du bya'o// zhes gsungs shing*/ sa chen gyis rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par byas la/ sems can thams cad srid pa'i sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho las bsgral bar bya'o// zhes bsam ste de la tshad med bzhi tshang ngo*// zhes gsungs pa'i don nyams su len pa la sngon du skyabs 'gro dgos pas/ skyabs yul ni rgyas par yab bde mchog nag po pa'i skabs bzhin gsal btab pa'am/ bsdu na dkon mchog gsum 'dus kyi ngo bo bla ma nyid rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i rnam par sgom la zhe thag pa nas skyabs 'gro ci nus bya'o// de nas 'phags pa rin po ches/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang sogs kyi tshad med bsgom par gsungs kyang*/ 'dir sems bskyed nyid tshad med kyi don tshang bas de bzhin mdzad cing*/ de'i don blo dang 'dres nges su bsgom/

tshad med bzhi tshang ba ni tshad med dang sems bskyed rgyu 'bras su song ba dang*/ ngo bo gcig tu song ba gnyis las 'dir phyi ma yin gsungs/ de yang sems can thams cad 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho las bsgral zhes pas snying rje/ bla na med pa'i byang chub la 'god par bya zhes pas byams pa/ de'i phyir rdo rje rnal 'byor ma bsgom zhes pas dngos su sems bskyed shugs la dga' ba dang btang snyoms bstan no// skabs 'dir spro na rdo rje sems dpa'i bsgom bzlas bya zhing*/ bsdu na ma byas kyang chad pa'i skyon du mi 'gyur ba lags// lnga pa bla ma'i rnal 'byor ni gzhung du de nas rang nyid bla mar bsgom par bya'o// gsungs la/ de yang gsang sngags kyi skabs su yon tan dang dngos grub thams cad bla ma las 'byung ba yin zhing*/ bla med kyi skabs su bla ma las gzhan pa'i skyabs dang dngos grub len pa'i yul gzhan med de/ gsang sngags pa yi bla ma mchog /dkon mchog gsum dang dbyer med yin// des na de la gsol btab na// dkon mchog gsum po tshe 'dir 'grub// ces dang*/ bla ma'i drin gyis phan pa'i lung thob na// grol bar mi 'gyur snyam yang grol bar 'gyur// zhes pa dang*/ gzhan gyis brjod min lhan cig skyes// gang du yang ni mi rnyed de// bla ma'i dus thabs bsten pa dang*// bdag gi bsod nams las shes bya// zhes dang*/ bla ma'i byin rlabs tsam gyis ni// skad cig nyid la 'byung gang yin// zhes bla ma la gsol ba btab pas dngos grub thams cad dus myur ba nyid du bde blag tu thob par gsungs/ des na rang rgyud la rtogs pa skye ba byin rlabs la rag las/ byin rlabs 'jug pa gsol 'debs la rag las shing*/ de mos gus la ltos pa mos gus bskyed nas gsol ba 'debs pa gal che zhing*/ ji ltar 'debs na yul ni mdun gyi nam mkhar seng khri rin po che pad zla'i gdan la rtsa ba'i bla ma dkon mchog gsum dang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma gnyis su med pa'i ngo bo dpa' bo rdo rje chos ḍā ma ru dang thod pa kha ṭ+wāṃ ga 'dzin pa dar la babs pa'i rnam pa can mngon rtogs ltar bsgom la/

mos gus bskyed la ngag 'don ltar gsol ba rtse gcig tu gdab par bya'o// 'dir rdo rje chos dpa' bor bsgom pa ni thun mong ma yin pa yin la/ rdor dril 'dzin pa ni bde mchog dang thun mong gi skabs yin no// gsol ba 'debs pa po ni rang dang sems can thams cad/ tshul ni mkhyen brtse nus pa'i yon tan mthong ba'i sgo nas mos gus drag pos gsol ba btab pa'o// des na 'bras bu rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i skur bskyed pa la rgyu tshogs gnyis rgya chen po gsag dgos la/ phar phyin theg pa yan chad kyi tshogs bsags rtogs rigs thams cad yar ldan du 'dus pa'i stobs dang ldan pa'i tshogs gsog tshul yin no// mthar bla ma 'od zhu spyi bo'i smin mtshams su thim pas/ bla ma'i sku gsung thugs dang rang gi lus ngag yid gsum dbyer med du 'dres pa la blo gzhag ye shes kyi tshogs gsog tshul ni bsam mi khyab kyi ngang las langs pa yin na 'di yan chad des rtsis zin par 'gyur bas ye shes kyi tshogs bsags yin zhing*/ de min na 'dir bla ma rang la thim pas bde stong zung 'jug gi ngo bor song nas de la ye shes kyi tshogs kyi don legs par tshang ngo*// bdud rtsi myang ba dang tshad med bla ma'i rnal 'byor rnams kyis tshe snga ma'i las ngan bag chags dang bcas pa sbyong zhing*/ bde stong la mnyam par bzhag pa'i ye shes des ni 'chi srid kyang sbyang gsungs so// drug pa lhar bskyed pa ni/ gzhung du de'i rjes la rang gi snying gar a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bsam la/ der/ oṃ sarba bud+dha ḍā ki nī ye/ badz+ra war+ṇa nī ye hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes bya ba'i sngags kyi kha dog dmar po 'od zer sna tshogs 'phro ba lugs las bzlog par bsam mo// dbus su ni bam̐ yig go /de'i 'od zer gyis rang gi lus khyab pas yongs su dag pa na bdag nyid bcom ldan 'das ma rdo rje phag mo'i sku zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/

sku mdog dmar mo bskal pa'i me lta bu'i gzi brjid can/ phyag rgya lnga'i rgyan dang ldan pa/ sna tshogs pad+ma nyi ma'i gdan la 'jigs byed dus mtshan zhabs kyis mnan pa/ g.yas na rdo rje gri gug g.yon na thod pa dang kha ṭ+wāṃ ga 'dzin pa'o// zhes gsungs te/ de yang thog mar rang gi gzhi sbyong ba ni gong gi bde stong gi ngang las/ rang gi snying gar e yongs su gyur pa las chos 'byung gru gsum nyis brtsegs zla ba la bam̐ yig sngags phreng dang bcas pa las 'od 'phros pas lus kyi phyi nang thams cad gang*/ tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib bag chags dang bcas pa byang zhing dag nas lus 'od kyi rang bzhin du gyur par bsam mo// 'dir gang sbyang bar bya ba'i gzhi ni/ rang gi sems kun gzhi'i steng na thog med bag chags kyis bslad pa'i dbang gis rten dkyil 'khor bzhi shar/ de rtsa yig la sogs sna tshogs su grub pa'i rten 'brel gyis phyi rol du snang ba sna tshogs pa ji snyed shar ba yin pas/ phyi rol gyi snang ba de thams cad rten dkyil 'khor bzhi shar/ de nang lus la tshang*/ de thams cad rang gi sems kun gzhir 'dus pa ste sbyang gzhi yin no// mdor na 'khor ba rgyu 'bras thams cad sbyang gzhir byed pa yin no// de yang yab kyi tshe nag po pas mngal skyes/ lū hi pas sgong skyes/ dril bu pas brdzus skyes dngos su sbyong la/ 'dir skye gnas bzhi gcig char du sbyong ste/ snying ga'i chos 'byung phyi ma gang du skye ba'i gnas nyi ma ma'i mngal/ zla ba pha'i khams/ sam+bu ṭir gsungs pa ltar zla ba la dmar dwangs yod pa rang chas can nam/ bam̐ yig gi mdangs kyi dbus dmar nyams yod pa de ni ma'i khams/ bam̐ yig gi bar srid des mngal skyes sbyong zhing*/ yang 'khor lo lnga po des skye gnas lhag ma sbyong ste/ chos 'byung gnyis pha ma dang sgong lkogs/ zla ba dmar cha dang bcas pa byang sems gnyis/ bam̐ yig snga ma ltar te sgong skyes sbyong byed dang*/

'od zer 'phros nas 'od zer gyi gong bur gyur pas drod gsher skyes sbyong*/ de la rje btsun mar skad cig gis bzhengs pas rdzus skyes sbyong*/ yang na 'od kyi gong bur gyur pas sgong skyes sbyong ste/ gong bu'i bdag nyid chos mthun pas gsungs so// 'di phyi dkyil rgyas pa mngon byang lnga yang bsdus te/ 'bras bu ye shes lnga tshang ba'i bskyed chog nyid la mngon byang lnga yang tshang ba yin la/ ye shes lnga ni zla ba'i brdas bstan pa me long ye shes/ sngags phreng mnyam nyid ye shes/ bam̐ sor rtogs ye shes/ 'od zer spro bsdu bya grub ye shes/ skur bzhengs pa chos dbyings ye shes yin no// dngos su tshang ba rtsi na chos 'byung gi nang stong pa ni chos dbyings stong pa nyid la byang chub pa/ zla ba dang*/ dmar chas ni gdan pad nyi las byang chub pa/ sngags phreng gsung yig 'bru las byang chub pa/ e wam̐ gzugs sgrub kyi tshe bam̐ gyi yi ge la gri gug gi so lta bu yod pas thugs phyag mtshan la byang chub pa/ lhar bzhengs pa sku yongs su rdzogs pa la byang chub pa ste lnga tshang ngo*// de nas gzhan gyi gzhi sbyong bsgyur ni 'og nas 'byung ba ltar gyi 'gro ba dag pa'i rnal 'byor ram gzhi bsgyur ba ltar bskyed par byed pa yin te/ mchan las rang gi gzhi sbyang zin pa'i rjes nas sngags phreng las 'od zer phyir 'phros pas 'gro ba dag par byas te rje btsun mar bskyed/ de rnams rang gi lus la bcug nas rang gi gzhi bsgyur bar gsungs te lū hi pa dang mthun no// ji ltar bya ba 'og bdun pa nyid du 'chad do// lhar bskyed pa dngos ni gong du smos pa'i rang nyid bcom ldan 'das ma rdo rje phag mo zhes sogs te/ lha thams cad kyi sdud byed rdo rje rnal 'byor ma ste/ 'di la phyi nang mthar thug gi rdo rje rnal 'byor ma rnams su yod pa las 'dir nges don gyi rnal 'byor ma spros bral gyi shes rab/

de nyid drang don gyi rnal 'byor ma lha sku zhal phyag gi rnam pa can du bzhengs pa yin no// de'i phyir sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bskyed pa dang rol pa'i yum gnyis ka yin te/ chos dbyings shes rab pha rol phyin// zag med bde chen sgyu ma'i sku// bde gshegs thams cad bskyed pa'i yum// bdag med ma zhes dang*/ shes rab pha rol phyin gnyis med// ye shes de ni de bzhin gshegs// bsgrub bya de ni zhes sogs gsungs shing*/ smra bsam brjod med shes rab pha rol phyin// sogs kyang 'di la dgongs pa ste/ spros bral gyi cha la phag mo bdag med ma/ sher phyin ma/ sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro sogs mtshan gyi rnam grangs du mas don gcig bstan pa'o// gzugs sku bde chen gyi sgyu ma'i sku la rol byed kyi yum du'ang rnam par bzhag go /de lta bu'i sku ni 'khor ba'i nyes pas ma gos pa'i rtags sna tshogs pad+ma dang*/ khro mo mtshon pa nyi ma'i gdan la zhabs g.yas pa thabs snying rje chen po'i rang bzhin brkyang pa des myang 'das kyi mtha' dus mtshan mnan zhing*/ shes rab chen po'i rang bzhin zhabs g.yon bskum pas 'khor ba'i mtha' 'jigs byed nag po mnan pa ste mtha' gnyis spangs nas mi gnas pa'i myang 'das su sgrub pa'o// thugs rjes sems can gyi don la chags pas sku mdog dmar mo/ chos thams cad de bzhin nyid du ro gcig par rtogs pas zhal gcig ma/ bden gnyis mtshon pa'i phyag gnyis/ rang dang gzhan gyi gzung 'dzin gyi rnam par rtog pa bcas pa dang gcod pa mtshon pas zhe sdang dag pa'i rdo rjes mtshon pa'i gri gug thur du 'phyang ba/ rang nyid kyis bde ba chen po'i go 'phang brnyes nas gzhan dag kyang de la 'god pa'i phyir/ g.yon pas 'dod chags dag pa'i thod khrag steng du phyogs pas bzung nas zhal du gsol ba/ spyan dbus ma gti mug dag pa/ thabs byang chub kyi sems dang mi 'bral bar mtshon pas phrag pa g.yon par kha ṭ+wāṃ ga bsnams pa/

dus gsum mkhyen pas spyan gsum ma kun tu 'dzin pa'i mdud pa grol bas dbu skra nag po sil bur 'phyang ba/ ye shes lnga'i yon tan rgyas pas thod skam lnga'i dbu rgyan can/ ā li kā li lnga bcu dag pas thod pa lnga bcu'i do shal te thod pa skam po mngon rtogs kyi yi ge phal cher las bshad kyang*/ yum rkyang gi tshe rlon pa byed pa 'thad de/ kun mkhyen chen po'i mkha' spyod sgo 'byed las kyang rlon par gsungs shing*/ de bzhin re tsag dgon pa'i rje btsun ma nā ro pa'i phyag bzo yin pa la yang de ltar yod par sku de nyid dngos su gzigs pa'i bla ma rnams kyi gsung rgyun gyi yi ge las 'byung ba dang*/ gzhan rgya gar gyi sku li ma phal cher la yang rlon pa'i do shal kho na 'byung bas so// kha cig gzhung las rlon par bshad zer yang gsal kha med do// yab yum lhan cig tu bkod tshe yum la skam po thob pa kun dang mthun no// nyon mongs pa'i sgrib g.yogs dang bral bas gcer bu/ thabs rigs lnga'i rang bzhin phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ phyi nang gi don thams cad sreg par byed pas ye shes kyi me phung gi dbus na bzhugs pa ste/ dag bya dang dag byed dran par byas la gsol ba btab bo// de nas go cha bgod kyang rung*/ ye shes pa bcug pa'i rjes la yang rung ngo*// ye shes pa bcug pa'i rjes la go cha bkod na/ nā ro pa'i bzhed pas shing gnyis gzer gyis bsdams pa mi 'bral ba bzhin/ dam tshig pa dang ye shes pa mi 'bral ba'i rten 'brel du yang 'gyur gsungs so// bdun pa 'gro ba dag pa'i rnal 'byor ni/ gzhung du yang de'i 'od zer gyis 'gro ba thams cad dag par byas nas/ slar log ste sngags kyi phreng ba nyid la zhugs dang*/ zhes pas bstan te/ phar phyin theg par zhing sbyong ba sems can smin par byed pa'i tshul gsungs pa las/ 'dir de bas kyang stobs dang ldan par byed pa ste/ rang gi sngags phreng las 'od 'phros snod bcud la phog pas de dag gi dri ma bsal te/

snod chos 'byung dang*/ sems can thams cad rnal 'byor mar bsgyur ba ni gzhan gyi gzhi sbyong bsgyur te gong du yang smos pa ltar/ kha cig 'dir 'od 'phro 'du'i phaiṃ zhes zer ba ni ma dag pa'o// brgyad pa dpa' bo dpa' mos byin gyis brlabs pa ni/ nā ro pas/ de nas slar yang yig 'bru'i tshogs kyi 'od zer gyis dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kun spyan drangs te bdag nyid la gzhug par bya'o// zhes gsungs so// de yang 'khor lo bde mchog gi lugs kyi dngos grub shin tu myur ba'i gnad kyang pho nya rnam gsum bsre ba'i thabs yod pas kyang yin te/ ji skad du/ pho nya rnam gsum legs bsres nas// sgrub pa po la mchog ster 'gyur// zhes so// de yang pho nya gsum ni/ sngags zhing lhan skyes gsum yin pas/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od 'phros pas bcud rnal 'byor mar gsal ba dang*/ dzam+bu'i gling na bzhugs pa'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma zhing skyes/ 'og min na bzhugs pa'i lhan skyes/ gzhan yang sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad rnal 'byor ma'i rnam par byon nas rang nyid sngags skyes kyi rnal 'byor ma la thim pas gnyis su med par bsam/ de'i tshe phaiṃ gyi sgra 'bar ba'i phyag rgya dpral bar g.yon du bskor/ mig steng du bsgrad gdong g.yon du bsgyur/ rkang pa'i mthe bong g.yas pas g.yon mnan par bya'o// 'di ni skye bo dam pa kun 'dus pa zhes pa'i don yin no// de nas bdag kyang ye shes kyi ngo bor rnam par dag la/ chos thams cad kyang de'i ngo bor rnam par dag go snyam du bsam zhing*/ oṃ yo ga shud+dho sogs brjod de/ de nyid mi 'bral ba'i phyir skabs 'dir go cha bgo na/ gnas drug tu zla ba'i gdan la go cha'i lha yig 'bru'i rnam par bsgom ste/ lha nyid sngags kyi tshul gyis ni// sgrub pa po la mchog ster byed// ces dang*/ gal te dngos grub mchog 'dod na// sngags dang lha ni tha dad med// ces pa ltar sngags dang lha tha dad med par sngags bsgom pas lha bsgom par 'gyur zhing bsgom sla bas so// zhal phyag gi rnam par bsgom na a bhi dha na ltar byed do// dbang bskur rigs bdag gi rgyas 'debs ma byas kyang nyes pa med de rigs bdag rnam snang rang chas can du bsgom pa yin pas dbang don tshang zhing chad pa'i skyon yang med do// dgu pa bzlas pa ni/

gzhung du yid dang ngag gi dbye bas bzlas par bya'o// gsungs pa'i don ni/ bzlas pa gnyis kyi go rim la dang po yid kyi bzlas pa dang*/ de nas ngag bzlas/ yang kha cig bskyed rim gyi cha lag yin pas dang po ngag bzlas byed gsungs kyang rang gi spro ba dang bstun la bya'o// de la bzlas pa'i dmigs pa ni rgyas par na kho bos byas pa'i sgrub thabs ltar bya ba'am/ bsdu na sngags phreng bam̐ yig dang bcas pa las 'od 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyi mkhyen brtse nus mthu'i byin rlabs dang yon tan rnams bsdus nas sngags phreng la thim pas dngos grub rnams thob par mos shing*/ mdun nas g.yon bskor du yig 'bru mgo gyen bstan du gnas pa la klog tshul du bzla'o// kha dog spyir las bzhi so so dang bstun la bye brag rgyun du lha dbang du bya ba'i don yod pas kha dog dmar por bya'o// bzlas bya'i sngags ni slob dpon gyi gzhung du nye snying las ma gsungs kyang*/ man ngag gi phyag len oṃ gsum ma rang la mdzad pas/ 'di la kha cig oṃ gsum yod pa'i rgyu mtshan rtsa sngags dang snying po dang*/ nye snying gsum phyogs gcig tu sdebs pas thog mthar oṃ dang hūm̐ phaṭa gsum 'byung ba'i rgyu mtshan yin no zer ro// de min te/ 'di la snying po dang nye snying gnyis yod kyang rtsa sngags kyi cha shas tsam yang mi snang ba'i phyir dang*/ yod na rtsa sngags kyi yi ge 'di dag yin zhes smra dgos pa las de ston rgyu med pa'i phyir te/ yab yum gyi rtsa sngags so so na shes par yod pas so// des na 'di sngags btu la ltos pa yin zhing sngags btu'i gzhung las de ltar 'byung bas so// de yang sngags btu'i gzhung zhal gnyis chung ngu'i gzhung la ltos pa can yin zhing*/ oṃ gsum ma'i sngags btu dang yi ge so gnyis po de dag lus kyi gnas so sor bkod nas bsgom pas dngos grub thob tshul sngags kyi de nyid grub pa las bshad pa lta bu'o// gal te in+d+ra bhu ti'i lugs yin gyi gzhan la mi 'jug gam snyam na 'di ni rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyi rtsa ba lta bu yin pas/

phag mo kun la sbyar bas chog pa ste rje btsun chen pos rnal 'byor byang seng gi zhus lan las/ de yang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i rtsa ba lta bu slob dpon rgyal po in+d+ra bhu tis mdzad pa'i zhal gnyis ma chung ngu zhes bya ba las/ zhes gsungs shing*/ 'di nyid kyi phag mo las bcu yang phag mo so bdun ma nas lha gcig ma'i bar dang*/ zhal gnyis ma che chung*/ don grub ma che chung kun la thun mong du 'jug tu rung bar rje btsun gyis bshad pa'i phyir ro// des na yig 'bru ni gong du smos pa ltar lha nyid yin la/ de yang yi ge so gnyis ni dam tshig gi 'khor lo'i ma mo brgyad/ yul nyer bzhi'i rnal 'byor ma de snyed de so gnyis yin la/ dbus kyi bam̐ yig la 'byung ba bzhi tshang bas ya ra la wa grub pas bde chen gyi lha mo bzhi klad kor rdo rje phag mo ste lha so bdun nyid yin no// de nas ngag bzlas ni/ rang gi dam bca' ji ltar yod pa ltar bzlas pa'i skyon dang bral bar bzlas shing*/ yid bzlas ni ngo bo mtshan bcas kyi rdzogs rim yin te/ de yang bde ba skye bar 'dod na gsang gnas su chos 'byung gnyis brtsegs bsgom/ grwa rnams su dga' ba 'khyil ba bzhi yang dmigs la/ dbus su bam̐ yig sngags phreng g.yon du bkod pa la dmigs la steng 'og gi rlung kha sbyar nas yid kyis bzlas pa ci rigs dang*/ tha na'ang gsum bya'o// phyis goms nas ci mang la bslab pas drod dang bde ba skye zhing*/ 'phar g.yo drag tu 'byung yang rim gyis glod/ mi rtog pa 'dod na lte bar bsgom/ 'di la sems zin pas du ba la sogs pa'i rtags rnams 'byung gsungs shing*/ zung 'jug tu gsal bar 'dod na snying kar bsgom/ 'di la 'gog pa'i bzlas pa zhes kyang zer/ yang na yid kyi bzlas pa mi byed par/ chos 'byung gi mdun rgyab spangs pa'i grwa bzhir dga' ba 'khyil pa bzhi/ g.yon du 'khor ba la dmigs pa gtad de rlung kha sbyar sgom pa yang rdzogs rim bsgom tshul gcig yin par gsungs la/

yang bde ba skye bar 'dod na lte ba'i bam̐ yig las dga' ba 'khyil pa gcig chad nas gsang gnas su g.yon du 'khor ba la dmigs pa bzung*/ mi rtog par 'dod na bam̐ yig las 'phros sam ma 'phros kyang rung ste/ mdzod spur dga' ba 'khyil pa g.yon du 'khor ba la sems gtad cing*/ zung 'jug 'dod na de gnyis bam̐ yig la bstim zhes kyang gsungs so// de lta bu'i bskyed rim bzlas pa dang bcas pa de la yab kyi lam rgyas pa'i bskyed rdzogs thams cad tshang zhing*/ de yang dbang bzhi lus sgrigs su 'du ba yin te/ de yang bskyed rim rgyas pa tshang tshul sngar yang smos la zhib par na lam rgyas pa'i chos 'byung gzhal yas khang dang bcas pa 'dir chos 'byung gnyis brtsegs so// de'i nang gi zla ba ni thabs rig pa byang chub kyi sems te/ bcom ldan 'das nas rdo rje sems dpa'i bar gyi dpa' bo nyer lnga/ bam̐ yig sngags phreng dang bcas pa la rnal 'byor ma so bdun tshang bar bshad zin pa ltar ro// ngag bzlas dmigs pa dang bcas pa ni sngags mchod dang lha bde chen gyi ngo bor gsal btab par 'gyur te/ gal te dngos grub mchog 'dod na// zhes sogs gsungs pa ltar ro// de ni bum dbang gi lam yin no// gsang dbang ni yab kyi lam rgyas pa'i skabs su 'khor lo lnga la rten dkyil 'khor bzhi la gnad du bsnun pa yin la/ de 'di la tshang ste/ rgyas pa'i gnas kyi 'khor lo gru gsum ni 'di'i chos 'byung phyi ma/ rgyas pa'i lte ba sprul 'khor rtsa mdud gru gsum rtsa gsum 'dus pa'i bdag nyid can te 'dir chos 'byung nang ma/ rgyas pa'i snying ga'i 'khor lo 'dir zla ba'i dkyil 'khor rgyas pa'i mgrin pa longs spyod kyi 'khor lo ya ra la wa sogs par gnas pa de 'dir de rnams 'dus pa'i bdag nyid bam̐ yig go /rgyas pa spyi bo ā li kā li ru gnas pa/ sngags phreng ā li kā lir gnas pa yin no// de lta bu gsal btab nas rlung kha sbyar nas/

yid bzlas pas rten dkyil 'khor bzhi la gnad du bsnun par 'gyur te/ chos 'byung ni lus rtsa'i dkyil 'khor/ bam̐ yig sngags phreng dang bcas pa rtsa yi ge'i dkyil 'khor/ zla ba khams bdud rtsi'i dkyil 'khor/ rlung la gnad du bsnun pa snying po ye shes rlung gi dkyil 'khor yin no// de'i tshe nyams ci skyes kyang byung rgyal du skyong ngo*// de dag ni gsang dbang gi lam yin no// sngar gyi chos 'byung gnyis brtsegs sogs gsang gnas su phab pa'i dmigs pa de nyid kyi tshe grwa bzhir dga' ba 'khyil pa zur med pa bzhi g.yon skor du bsgom te rlung kha sbyar ro// thun 'jog na lte bar spos la bzhag go /de yang lam rgyas pa'i tshe shes rab ye shes dga' ba bzhir nyams su len pa yin la de 'di'i dga' ba 'khyil pa bzhi g.yon skor du 'khor bas bde ba skye ba nyid la tshang zhing*/ dga' ba'i dga' ba sogs bcu drug ni dga' ba 'khyil pa re re la'ang 'khyil chung bzhi bzhi yod pas mtshon zhing*/ zur med pa ni rnam rtog gi grwa zur med pa'o// des ni shes rab ye shes kyi lam yin no// dmigs pa des bde bas brgyal ba la sogs byung na dmigs pa cung zad glod la bsgom mo// dbang bzhi pa'i dmigs pa la bum dbang sogs dbang dang po gsum gyi khyab byed du 'gro ba gsum dang*/ dbang bzhi pa dngos dang bzhi las dang po bum dbang gi khyab byed du 'gro ba ni/ rang gi dpral ba'i dbyings su dga' ba 'khyil pa'am chos 'byung dmar po/ yang na thig le skya hril ba gcig rnams gang rung ngam/ res mos kyi sgo nas sems gtad pas mi rtog pa'i ting 'dzin dpag tu med pa skye bas nyams byung rgyal du skyong ngo*// de ni dang po de nyid yin no// gnyis pa ni rang gi spyi bo nas lte ba'i bar du rtsa dbu ma gro sog tsam bsgom pa'i yas snar haṃ yig 'khyogs po mgor thur bstan/ mar snar lte dbus su bam̐ bsgom/

'og sgo 'byed 'dzum byas pas bshang sgo'i rlung gis sum mdo'i me sbar/ lte ba'i bam̐ la mchod pas bam̐ las me 'bar dbu ma nas song*/ spyi bo'i haṃ la reg pas bdud rtsi babs/ bam̐ la phog pa'i 'bar 'dzag la sems gtad la rlung kha sbyar du 'dzin pa'o// gsum pa'i lam ni rtsa dbu ma sngar ltar la mas sna gsang gnas su bsgom/ spyi bo'i haṃ las bdud rtsi ba thag ltar na rar byung gsang gnas nas phyir sor gsum tsam thon par bsam la rlung kha sbyar du bzung ngo*// byang chub kyi sems rgyud ma chad pa dang*/ thun 'jog tsa na nang du sdud pa gnad yin no// dbang bzhi pa dngos ni de ltar bsgom pa las bde stong gi nyams bsam gyis mi khyab pa skye bas ma brjed par rgyun du bskyangs/ 'dzag la khad du gyur pa'i tshe ni phyir thon pa'i sor gsum po nas nang du gcig gam gnyis sam gsum ga sogs ci rigs pa nang du drangs par bsgom la de las skyes pa'i nyams rgyun ring du skyong ba ni dbang bzhi pa dngos kyi lam yin no// dbang bzhi pa'i lta ba skyon med skyes na bsam mi khyab kyi rnal 'byor sogs lhag ma rnams mi dgos pas ma byas kyang rung bar bshad do// dbang bzhi lus bsgrigs kyi nyams len rgyas pa 'di lta bu rnal 'byor bcu gcig gi rnam bshad dkyus gzhan du bkod pa mi 'byung zhing 'dir bshad pa ni 'di la rje btsun chen po'i shog dril gcig dang*/ rje rdo rje 'chang gi shog dril gnyis dang*/ shin tu zab pa'i shog dril khyad par can gsum yod pa'i dgongs pa bzhi yin/ zhes brgyud ldan gyi bla ma yid ches can dag gi gsung rab las 'byung ba bzhin bkod pa yin la/ 'di dag ni shin tu dkon pa'i man ngag khyad par can yin no// rnal 'byor bcu gcig gi spyi tsam dbang bzhi lus bsgrigs kyi zhal shes ni/ rang rje btsun mar bsgom pa bum dbang gi lam/ chos 'byung gi zla ba sngags phreng bam̐ yig la sngar bshad pa ltar 'khor lo lnga tshang bas gsang dbang gi lam/

gsang gnas kyi dga' ba 'khyil pa la sems gtad pa dbang gsum pa'i lam/ de rnams bde stong zung 'jug tu shes pas dbang bzhi pa'i lam yin no// bcu pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rnal 'byor ni/ gzhung du de nas bam̐ yig gi 'od zer gyis sa gsum dang*/ lus dang yi ge'i rim gyis bsam gyis mi khyab pa la bzhugs pa sngon du 'gro bas de kho na nyid bsgom par bya'o// zhes gsungs pa'i don rje sa chen gyis bkral ba ltar rang gi snying ga'i sngags phreng las 'od zer 'phros khams gsum 'od zer gyis gang*/ khams gsum 'od sngo dmar dkar gsum gyis stod smad bar gsum la thim/ de yang gzugs med khams lus kyi stod kyi cha la/ 'dod khams pa smad cha la/ gzugs khams pa thams cad bar gyi cha la/ rang yang sngags dang bzlas pa yang sngags la/ de bam̐ la/ de thig le la/ de nā da dkar du gyur te chu la rlabs thim pa ltar ci yang mi dmigs par bsam la de'i ngang la shes pa glod/ de la ji tsam gnas tshad du bzhag go /zhi gnas shas che na lhar ldang*/ gsal ba dang bde ba shas che na stong pa'i ngang la bzhag de nas ldang ba'i tshe skad cig gis rje btsun ma rgyan dang phyag mtshan med pa'i skur ldang ngo*// de nas sku mdog dmar ba ni sems can la rjes su chags pa'o// zhes sogs gong gi dag bya dag byed rnams dran par byas kyang rung*/ ma byas kyang skyon med do// bcu gcig pa spyod lam gyi rnal 'byor ni/ gzhung du las dang po pa'i bsgom pa mdor bsdus pa zhes pas bstan te/ 'di la spyod lam dngos dang*/ thun mtshams tshogs bsags pa/ gtor ma dang*/ kha zas kyi rnal 'byor dang bzhi/ zhar la mar me'i sbyin sreg dang lnga las/ dang po spyod lam dngos ni/ sa chen gyis/ rang dang snang ba thams cad rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i skur dmigs la lha la lhas mchod pa'i bsam pa sku'i dga' ba/ de yang sgyu ma lta bu'i sku dang*/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i ngang las ma g.yos par bya ba thugs kyi dga' ba/

sgra ci grags pa thams cad ngag gi bzlas par gsung ba gsung gi dga' ba ste/ zhes gsungs pa ltar sbyang gzhi snang grags rig gsum thams cad sbyong byed dga' ba gsum po der bsgyur te de'i ngang las ma g.yos pa shin tu gal che'o// sin+dhū ra la brten pa'i mkha' spyod sgrub tshul kyang gong ma'i gsung bzhin kho bos logs su byas pa ltar rtogs par bya'o// gnyis pa thun mtshams su tshogs bsags pa la/ phyi mchod kyi rnal 'byor/ tshogs mchod/ tshes bcu'i mchod pa'i rnal 'byor gsum/ dang po bdag bskyed sngon du song ba'i mdun bskyed sgrub/ de la mchod gtor phul/ grub na bum pa sgrub ste byin brlabs bdag 'jug kyang blangs/ de dag gi cho ga rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum gong ma'i yig cha ltar shes par bya zhing*/ gnyis pa tshogs mchod ni sngar gyi steng du tshogs bsham nas 'bul ba'o// gsum pa dus kyi khyad par tshogs gsog na yar ngo dang*/ sgrib pa sbyong na mar ngo'i tshes bcu la grub na sngar ltar tshogs mchod dam phyi mchod tsam bya/ ma grub na grong pa'i chos kyi ma gos pa'i bu mo gsum mam lnga la sogs pa ston mo bya/ de'ang ma grub na oṃ gsum brgya rtsa sogs sngar gyi grangs las lhag par bzlas pa tsam gyis kyang bya'o gsungs/ ༈ /gsum pa gtor ma'i rnal 'byor ni sngags phreng la a kā ro btags la phul/ ༈ /bzhi pa kha zas kyi rnal 'byor ni/ kha zas la mtheb srin reg cing 'bru gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ de nas snying ga'i bam̐ de rnal 'byor mar dmigs la de mchod pa'i bsam pas g.yon gyi kun spyod kyis bza'o/ ༈ /lnga pa ni/ sbyin sreg rgyas bsdus la bla ma gong ma'i yi ge logs su snang ba ltar shes par bya zhing*/ des na rnal 'byor pa bsod nams rab la bsgom bzlas tsam gyis lus ma spangs par mkha' spyod 'grub/ 'bring gis sin+dhū ra'i bsgrub pa brten nas 'grub/ tha mas 'chi kha ma'i rnal 'byor 'pho ba'i man ngag la brten nas 'grub/

shin tu tha ma gzhi dam tshig la gnas nas lam rnal 'byor bcu gcig nyams su blang kyang brtson pa dang skal pa zhan pas bar do tshun la mchog ma 'grub na/ smon lam gyis mtshams sbyar te skye ba brgyud nas phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub 'grub pa'o// de dag gi yan lag tu 'dod don bsgrub pa'i phyir pra sen dbab pa/ zas gos kyi rtsol ba mi mdzad pa'i phyir sman gyi bcud len/ thun mong gi dngos grub bsgrub pa'i phyir gnod sbyin mo dbang du bya ba/ pad+ma pa ti'i sgrub pa/ khol po sgrub pa sogs gsungs kyang rang gi mos pa dang bstun nas rje btsun gong ma'i yi ge bzhin nyams su blangs pas dngos grub chen po'i yang rgyur 'gro ba'o/ ༈ /gsum pa 'bras bu ni gnas skabs su zhi sogs dman pa'i dngos grub thams cad dang*/ 'bring grub pa chen po brgyad/ 'bring gi mchog mkha' spyod ces bya ba rdzu 'phrul gyis nam mkha' la rgyu zhing spyod yul du byed pa/ lus mdzes shing lo bcu drug lon pa'i na tshod dang cha lugs can/ tshe nyi zla dang mnyam pa/ ci bsams pa'i longs spyod nam mkha' las 'byung ba/ rdzu 'phrul gyi stobs kyis sangs rgyas kyi zhing nas sangs rgyas kyi zhing du 'gro/ sprul sku las chos nyan pa dpa' bo rnams dang skal ba mnyam par spyod cing rten de nyid la 'tshang rgya bar nges pa dang*/ rig pa 'dzin pa dang*/ 'khor los sgyur ba ste gsum dang*/ mthar thug gi 'bras bu sku gsum yan lag bdun dang ldan pa'i khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang chen po'i go 'phang myur du thob par 'gyur ba ni nges pa'o// ༈ /'dir smras pa/ grub chen nā ro ta pa'i thugs kyi bcud// dpal ldan mkha' 'gro'i dbang mo sgrub pa'i thabs// sa skya'i bla chen mchog gi bzhed pa'i srol// rnal 'byor bcu gcig don 'grel rnam bshad 'di// 'khor lo sdom pa mus pa chen po sogs// 'khrul zad bla ma rnams kyi gsung rgyun dang*// sngon byon gong ma'i gsung rab rgya mtsho las// rab gsal blo yis legs par btus te sbyar// lugs 'di'i rnam gzhag rgyas par shes 'dod na// sa skya'i rje btsun rnams kyi gsung rab dang*// khyad par mus chen sems dpa' chen po yi// dngos dang brgyud pa'i slob tshogs bgrang yas kyi// gsung rab rnams la yun ring 'dris byas na// lugs 'di'i spyi dang bye brag zab mo'i don// kun la 'jigs med blo yi gdengs thob ste// rang gzhan don gnyis 'grub par 'gyur ro kye// 'di sbyar dge bas bdag cag dpon slob rnams// tshe ring nad med bsam don kun 'grub ste// dpal ldan sa skya'i chos srid dpal 'byor rnams// dbyar mtsho bzhin du 'phel zhing rgyas gyur cig

/nam zhig tshe 'di'i snang ba nub ma thag /dpal ldan mkha' spyod dbang mos mdun bsus te// dpon slob lhan cig bde ba can skyes nas// 'gro kun dag pa'i zhing der 'dren gyur cig /dus gsum sgrib med gzigs pa'i bla ma dang*// rje btsun rdo rje btsun mo'i thugs rje yis// bdag cag rnams kyi yid la re ba'i don// 'di kun yid bzhin 'grub par mdzad du gsol// zhes rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i bskyed rim rnal 'byor bcu gcig gi rnam par bshad pa mkha' spyod lam bzang gsal ba'i nyin byed ces bya ba 'di yang rigs ldan chos kyi rgyal po 'jam pa'i dbyangs bsod nams dbang po sku mched dang*/ mus chen 'khor lo sdom pa sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan/ spyan snga rin po che kun dga' don grub/ chos kyi rje dbang phyug rab brtan/ mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang chos kyi grags pa rnams las/ rje btsun nā ro mkha' spyod kyi chos skor yongs su rdzogs pa'i bka' drin nos pa dpal sa skya pa sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos spre'u lo zla ba gnyis pa'i dkar phyogs bzang po gsum pa'i tshes la/ dpal sa skya'i bzhi thog bla brang gi tshom dmar du sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni rang dang nye bar gnas pa'i dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa/ skyes sbyang gi blo gros rab tu gsal ba'i gzhung lugs rab 'byams smra ba rgya mtsho'i mtha' can dang*/ sa skyar skyes shing yi ge'i 'du byed byang chub pa bsam 'grub ces bya bas bgyis so// 'dis bstan pa rin po che dang sems can rnams la mchog tu phan par gyur cig /sarba maṅga lam// ༈ /rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nā ro mkha' spyod kyi sgrub thabs kyi rnam par bshad pa mkha' spyod kyi lam bzang zhes bya ba'i dbu phyogs bzhugs so// ༈ /oṃ swa sti/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nā ro mkha' spyod kyi sgrub thabs kyi rnam par bshad pa mkha' spyod lam bzang zhes bya ba/

rje btsun bla ma dam pa brgyud pa dang bcas pa rnams kyi zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// yan lag bdun ldan sku ni pad+ma rā ga'i mdog mtshungs mtshan nyid rdzogs// drug cu'i dbyangs ldan gsung ni so so'i skad du dam chos legs par ston// ji lta ji snyed mkhyen pa'i thugs ni rnam par rtog med lhun gyis grub// rgyal ba'i yum mchog rnal 'byor ma dpal dag dang dbyer med bla mar 'dud// lnga rigs paṇa chen kun gyi gtsug gi rgyan// drug gnyis dka' spyad mthar phyin brtson pa'i phul// bdun ldan sku mnyes dbang mo'i rjes su bzung*// brgyad ldan dbang phyug nā ro ta par 'dud// gang gsung zhal gyi bdud rtsi mtho ris chab// lo paṇa las 'bab gang thugs rgya mtshor sim// phrin las chu rlung phyogs brgyar legs 'bab pa'i// sa skya'i 'jam mgon brgyud par bcas rnams rgyal// khyad par rgyal bas lung bstan e wam̐ pa// nges don bstan pa rgyas mdzad mus pa rje// snyan brgyud rgya mtsho'i mnga' bdag tshar chen sogs// lugs 'dir bka' drin che rnams 'dir phyag yin// de ltar dam pa'i phyag srol las byung ba'i// skal bzang mkha' spyod bgrod pa'i lam bzang 'dir// ci nus dbye yi don gnyer grogs mchog sogs// bdag dang skal mnyam tshogs rnams gar byos shig /ces mchod par brjod cing bshad par dam bca' ba dang spro ba bskyed pa'i tshig sngon du btang nas 'dir rje btsun nā ro ta pa chen pos mdzad pa'i rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sgrub thabs bshad pa la don gnyis te/ chos spyi'i rnam bzhag bstan pas blo gros yangs par byas/ skabs don rgyas par bshad pas nyams rtogs rgyas par bya ba'o// dang po ni/ 'o skol rnams kyi ston pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis chos kyi phung po ji snyed cig gsungs pa'i brjod bya bsdu na theg pa che chung gnyis las/ 'dir theg pa chen po'i nyams len ston te/

nyan thos theg pa 'di la ni// spyod pa yongs bsngo ma bshad pas// theg pa chen po ga la rung*// zhes gsungs so// theg chen de la yang rgyu 'bras gnyis las/ khyad par du 'phags pa gsang sngags te/ mdo sde gdams ngag 'bog pa'i rgyal po las/ 'dren pa'i theg pa gsum po dag /bcom ldan nges par gsung lags na// rgyu 'bras lhun grub tu spyod cing*// sangs rgyas gzhan nas mi 'tshol ba'i// nges pa'i theg pa ci ma gsung*// zhes pa'i lan du/ bcom ldan 'das kyi bka' stsal pa/ rgyu la mos pa rgyu chos kyi// 'khor lo rab tu bskor byas nas// rdo rje theg pa'i nye lam zhig /ma 'ongs dus na 'byung bar 'gyur// zhes gsungs pas shes so// sngags kyi theg pa'i 'dod tshul la mang du yod na'ang*/ 'dir rje btsun rtse mos gur gyi dgongs pa la/ dgos pa mang po la dgongs nas rgyud sde bzhir bzhed do// mdor na spyi'i rnam bzhag rgyas par shes par 'dod na rje btsun rtse mos mdzad pa'i rgyud sde spyi rnam chen mo mkhas pa'i bshad srol gyi gsal byed dang bcas pa rnams las shes par bya'o// gnyis pa skabs don rgyas par bshad pa la gnyis te/ bde mchog gsang mtha'i lam rim spyir bstan/ de nyid kyi snying po byung ba'i nyams len bshad pa'o// dang po ni/ 'khor lo bde mchog gi dgongs pa dang*/ de'i 'grel byed rnams rgyud sde drug tu bzhed de/ rtsa rgyud le'u lnga bcu rtsa gcig pa las/ ji srid mdo bya spyod pa ni// rnal 'byor gsang mtha'i dbye ba yis// sems can mos pa 'jug pa rnams// de dang de la dga' ba yi// zhes gsungs pa'i don la/ mdo zhes pa 'chad tshul gnyis las/ gtso bor mdo sde rtogs pa'i rgyud las 'chad/ de bzhin du bya ba dang spyod pa dang rnal 'byor gyi rgyud dang*/ gsang zhes pa gsang ba 'dus pa la sogs pa rgyud sde gsum/ mtha'i zhes pa dges pa rdo rje dus kyi 'khor lo la sogs pa ma rgyud sgo drug

dbye ba ni zhes pa de'i nang mtshan gyi bye brag drug pa dpal bde mchog gi rgyud do// 'dir rtsa rgyud rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum las/ rtsa rgyud rgyas pa nam mkha' dang mnyam pa le'u 'bum pa ston pa rdo rje 'chang chen po'i gsungs/ de dus kyi dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams kyi don byas te sgra nam mkha' la dengs te/ a bhi dha nar/ las kyi dpa' bo chen po ste// khyod kyi ye shes gang mthong ba// ye shes shes bya chen po ste// de ni de yi ngang du thim// zhes pa ltar ro// yang dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams kyis/ tshogs mchod sngon du btang nas/ 'bring po gsung bar gsol ba btab pas rtsa rgyud 'bring po sh+lau ka 'bum pa gsungs/ de dus kyi gdul bya rnams kyi don byas nas baiḍūr+ya'i shog bu la gser zhun mas glegs bam du bris nas mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis rgyas btab ste/ nub phyogs o ḍi bhi sha'i gtsug lag tu bzhugs so// yang gdul bya mi rnams kyi don du 'gyur ba'i rtsa rgyud gsung bar zhus pas bsdus pa yi ge 'bum pa le'u lnga bcu rtsa gcig pa 'di gsungs so// 'di don 'grel byed so so'i bkral tshul bzhi yod pa las rtsa rgyud kyi dgongs pa bshad rgyud rnam pa lnga'i gsang mthar 'chad de/ bshad rgyud lnga ni/ slob dpon skar rgyal zla bas/ 'byung dang mkha' 'gro kun spyod dang*// kha sbyor rgyud dang bla ma ste// bshad rgyud rnam pa lngar 'dod do// zhes pa lnga ni/ he ru ka mngon 'byung*/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro/ rnal 'byor ma kun spyod/ dpal sam+bu ṭa/ a bhi dha na rnams kyis bkral ba'i gsang mtha' 'di/ bde mchog gzhan las zab ste/ spyir theg dman nas rdo rje theg pa'i bar dman sems spong zhing rtogs rigs yar ldan du 'gro ba las/ 'og ma 'og ma las gong ma gong ma zab tshul spyir bshad ltar yin pa las/ gsang mtha' mchog zab ste/ rtsa rgyud las/ pho nya rnam gsum legs bsres nas// sgrub pa po yis dngos grub thob// ces gsungs/

gsang mtha'i lam rim ni/ sbyin bya bzhi/ bslab bya gnyis/ grogs spyod pa gnyis kyi mtshams sbyar nas/ 'bras bu mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub sgrub par byed do// dang po ni/ lū nag gnyis kyi phyi'i dkyil 'khor du/ smin byed kyi dbang bskur ba ma thob pa la gang zag mchog ma yin pa rnams kyis dril bu lus dkyil dang*/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i lam nyams su blangs na/ rtsa ltung 'byung bar gsungs te/ yongs su ma smin sems can la// gsang ba sgrogs pa bdun pa yin// zhes gsung*/ rnal 'byor ma'i bskyed rdzogs kyi lam nyams su len pa la yang sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor du byin rlabs dbang bzhi'i tshul du thob dgos te/ sbyor ba nges par ma byas par// skal min gsang ba ston pa dang*// zhes gsungs pa ltar gyi yan lag gi ltung ba 'byung ba'i phyir/ bslab bya gnyis la slob tshul yang blo dman nas rim gyis 'khrid pa'i dbang du byas te dang po phyi rtog brtags sems la gnad du bsnun pa gtso bor byas te/ nang lus la zhar byung gi tshul gyis bsnun pa/ nag po chos skor gyi khrid de nas phyi nang gnyis ka la cha mnyam du bsnun pa grub chen lū hi pa'i khrid/ de nas spyir spros pa spangs te/ zab mo lus la gnad du bsnun pa dril bu chos skor gyi 'khrid do// 'di dag gi rnam dbye rgyas par bde mchog chos 'byung sogs su gzigs/ gnyis pa de nyid kyi snying por byung ba'i nyams len rgyas par bshad pa ni/ de ltar lū nag dril gsum gyi nyams len de dag la bogs dbyung zhing 'bras bu 'byin pa dang*/ tshe gcig gis sangs rgyas sgrub par byed pa rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i chos skor 'di ni/ rnal 'byor gsang mtha'i rtsa bshad kyi rgyud thams cad kyi snying po byung ba'i man ngag rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nyid kyis nā ro ta pa la dngos su gnang ba'i nā ro mkha' spyod kyi gdams ngag 'di yin la/

nā ro pa de nyid la slob ma'i mchog 'phags yul na yongs su grags pa'i paṇa chen bcu gnyis tsam dang*/ bod yul nas dka' ba du ma spyad nas byon pa'i thugs sras mar pa lo tsā rnams yod kyang de dag la ma gnang bar/ bal po pham thing pa sku mched la slob bshad kyi tshul du gnang ba'i zab chos klog skya shes rab brtsegs pa dang mal lo tsā ba la rim gyis brgyud de sa skya pa chen po la bka' babs pa'i gdams pa khyad par can yin la/ sa chen la yang spyir bla med dang 'brel ba'i gdams pa rgya mtsho tsam yod pa las/ mchog tu gyur pa gser chos bcu gsum gyi nang tshan mchog bsgrub pas thun mong zhar las 'byung ba dmar mo skor gsum du grags pa/ in+d+ra mkha' spyod/ mai tri mkha' spyod/ nā ro mkha' spyod gsum las/ de'i nang tshan mchog tu gyur pa nā ro mkha' spyod kyi gdams pa yin la/ 'di 'chad pa la don gsum ste/ gang gis nyams su len pa'i gang zag des nyams su blang ba'i lam/ nyams su blangs pa'i 'bras bu gsum/ dang po la smin lam 'jug rung gi gang zag dang*/ grol lam bsgom rung gi gang zag gnyis/ dang po ni/ spyir rdo rje theg pa nas bshad pa'i mtshan nyid thams cad tshang na rab/ mdor bsdus pa ni/ rdo rje snying 'grel las/ brtan zhing dul la blo gros ldan// bzod ldan drang la g.yo sgyu med// ces bshad pa ltar gyi mtshan nyid tshang zhing 'khor lo bde mchog lū nag dril gsum gyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bzhi thob pa rab/ gsum char gyi dbang ma thob kyang lū nag gang rung gi rdul tshon ras bris su thob pa ni 'bring*/ de'i dbang ye ma thob kyang ma rgyud kye rdor lta bu'i dbang thob pa tha ma'o// gnyis pa grol lam bsgom rung gi gang zag ni/ sngar gyi de'i steng du sam+bu ṭa las/ bskal pa kun gyi sngon grub pa'i// slob dpon chen po gdod nas gnas// zhes gsungs pa ltar// sgrub pa po rang nyid kyi sems nyid rdo rje rnal 'byor ma ye gdod ma nas gnas pa de ngo sprod pa'i ched du sin+dhū ra'i dkyil 'khor du rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i byin rlabs legs par thob cing rgyun du chag med du nyams su len pa byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems brtan po dang ldan zhing so thar nas rdo rje theg pa'i bar gyi thun mong dang*/

'khor lo bde mchog gi thun mong ma yin pa'i dam tshig rnams ma nyams shing nyams su blang bya'i lam la sgro 'dogs chod cing de'i steng du yang 'di'i sin+dhū ra'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bzhi byin rlabs kyi tshul du thob pa'i dam tshig la gnas nas nyams su blang bya'i rnal 'byor bcu gcig sogs la sgro 'dogs chod cing sems can gyi don myur du phyag rgya chen po sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par 'dod pa'i blo can te/ slob dpon rdo rje dril bu pas/ 'gro kun don la rab gzhol ba// rang rgyud sngags dang rnal 'byor shes// zhes so// de lta bu'i gang zag rab kyis bsgom bzlas la brten nas mchog gi dngos grub 'grub/ 'bring gis sin+dhu ra'i sgrub pa la brten nas 'grub/ tha mas 'pho ba'i gdams ngag la brten nas bar dor 'grub/ shin tu tha mas ni skye ba phyi ma rnams su rnal 'byor ma'i bzlas bsgom byed pa'i rigs su skyes te/ nam zhig nas mkha' spyod du bgrod pa'o// gang zag des bsam gtan bsgom pa la/ gang du bsgom pa'i gnas/ der gdan gang gi steng du spyod lam dang bsam gtan ji lta bus/ nam bsgom pa'i dus/ kha gang la bltas nas tshul ji ltar du bsgom pa rnams las/ gnas ni nges brjod dam/ mngon brjod dam/ a bhi dha na ste/ mtshan gyi rnam grangs gsum dang ldan pa las/ ri sul dang ni ri rtse dang*// chu bo'i ngogs dang 'dus pa dang*// rgya mtsho chen po'i 'gram dag dang*// shing gcig dang ni zhi ba'i gnas// ma mo'i khyim dang dur khrod dam// sna tshogs skyed mos tshal mchog gam// lha khang dang ni mchod rten nam// khyim mam bzhi mdo dag tu ni// sgrub pa po yis sbyor sgrub na// 'dod pa kun gyis 'bras bu gsol// gnas ni brtags par byas pa'am// yid ni gang du dga' ba der// sna tshogs bde mchog dam pa der// de ru bsgrubs nas dngos grub 'gyur// dbye ba dus mas bsgom pa ni// gdul bya'i bsam pa'i dbang gis so// zhes gsungs pa'i ri sul nas gzhi mdo'i bar rnams gdul bya'i bsam pa'i dbang gis rgyas par dbye ba yin la/

mdor bsdu na/ yid ni gang du dga' ba der// zhes pa ste/ kyai rdo rjer/ dang po goms par byed dus kyi// gnas ni gang du bsngags pa'i sems// gcig tu mnyam bzhag 'grub 'gyur ba'i// gnas ni bzang po nges par brtag /rang gi khyim du zhes gsungs pa dang mthun pas/ las dang po pa 'tshe ba med cing bkra shis pa'i gnas su bsgom pa khyad par can du bsngags pa'am/ yang na dur khrod du bsgoms kyang rung ste/ bar chad 'ong gis dogs nas bsgom pa la brtson 'grus brtsams pa'i dgos pa yod pas so// der gdan gang gi steng na 'dug pa ni/ bsgom pa'i dus su rnal 'byor pa'i gdan la he ru ka'i chas drug nas gsungs pa ro gdan dngos sam/ ras la sogs pa la ro'i gzugs brnyan bris pa'am/ ro gdan bting bar bsam pa'am/ yang na ro ras zhes pa ro dur khrod du bskyal ba'i gos blangs pa bting ba'i dgos pa ni/ ro la bdag med pa bzhin du rnal 'byor pas kyang bdag med rtogs pa dang bdag med la dris goms byed pa'i dgos pa yod do// bsnyen pa'i dus su g.yam pa sogs la sna tshogs rdo rje bris pa'ang gdan 'og tu 'jug ste/ slob dpon gnyis med rdo rje'i sgrub thabs las/ sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan pa'i bde ba'i stan la zhes dang*/ kam pa las/ sna tshogs rdo rje'i gdan la gnas pas zhes so// spyi dang bye brag gi dkon mchog gi rten yod na bshams/ med kyang 'gal ba med do// ji ltar dgos pa'i mchod gtor rdor dril la sogs pa nye bar mkho ba'i yo byad rnams ma tshang ba med pa tshul bzhin bsham mo// spyod lam dang bsam gtan ji lta bus 'dug na/ rdo rje gur las/ rdo rje skyil krung rnams bcas nas// zhes gsungs pa ltar rkang pa rdo rje'i skyil krung ngam de ma nus na'ang sems dpa'i skyil krung sogs lus bsam gtan gyi spyod lam nges par bca' zhing nyal ba dang 'phres pa sogs nges par mi rung ste/

grub chen nā ro pa nyid kyis/ mi mos nyal sngags bzla ba spangs// zhes gsungs so// bsam gtan kyang 'di bzhin bya dgos te/ sgrub thabs kyi thog mar dal 'byor rnyed par dka' ba bsam pa dang*/ skyes bu dam pa dang mjal bar dka' ba bsam pa dang*/ dam pa'i chos zab mo dang 'phrad par dka' ba bsam pa sogs bya ste/ sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs kyis/ dal 'byor 'di ni shin tu g.yo ba dang*// 'jig rten skye bo dam pa 'phrad rnyed dka'// de bas shes rab thabs la gzhol ba yi// yid la byed pa mchog 'di bsgrub par bya// zhes gsungs pa ltar nges 'byung dang byang sems sogs sngon 'gro'i chos zhib tu bsams nas blo 'khul nges bya ba brtag dpyad legs por byas nas 'jug dgos kyi gya tshom du mi 'jug gsung ngo*// nam bsgom pa'i dus ni/ kyai rdo rjer/ rang gi khyim du mtshan dus su// bdag nyid bsgrub pa'i sems kyis ni// rnal 'byor ma bsgom shes rab can// zhes pa ltar las dang po pa rnam rtog nyung bas mtshan mo'i dus la lhag par 'bad cing thun gsum thun bzhi la sogs pa mnyam rjes kun du gzhan don bsam pas bsgom mo// kha gang la bltas nas tshul ji ltar du bsgoms na/ sngags kyi rgyud sde phal cher las shar du blta bar bshad pa ni/ shar phyogs su dbang po gnas pa dang nyi zla 'ong bas bkra shis pa'i phyogs yin pa la dgongs so// bya spyod phal cher dang dus 'khor las/ shar dang byang thabs kyi phyogs dang*/ nub dang lho gnyis shes rab kyi phyogs yin pas/ shes rab kyi phyogs su blta bar bshad pa bzhin/ 'di yang shes rab kyi phyogs lhor kha blta ba'i mos pa bya ste rgyu mtshan shes rab kyi rgyud gtso bor byas par bskor phyogs la bltas nas/ g.yas bskor thabs g.yon bskor shes rab las/ 'dir g.yon bskor/ lag pa yang g.yas thabs g.yon shes rab las 'dir bya ba thams cad g.yon pas byed pa ni/ rtsa rgyud las/

'jig rten na rtag g.yon nas spyod// rkang pa g.yon pa sngon la 'dor// lag pa g.yon pa sngon du 'gyur// g.yon gyis mchod pas rab mchod byed// lus kyi g.yon ni rnam par 'khrid// g.yon pa yis ni tshim par bza'// brtul zhugs ma nyams brtul zhugs rdzogs// sgrub po de ni dam tshig brtson// zhes dang*/ rje btsun gyis nag po bshad sbyar las/ de la g.yon nas bskor bas zhes bya ba ni phyogs thams cad shar nas g.yon skor bayin te/ de'i rgyu mtshan yang*/ chos thams cad shes rab g.yon pa las 'byung ba ste/ 'gro kun g.yon las byung ba yin// zhes bya ba yin no// pu hrang lo chung lugs kyi nag 'bum du/ g.yon pa'i kun tu spyod pa ni/ nangs par mal nas langs pa'i dus su rkang pa g.yon pa sngon du 'dor ba dang lag pa g.yon pas zas bza' ba dang mchod pa la sogs bya'o// g.yon pas byed pa'i dgos pa ni g.yon ngos na rdo rje dbyings phyug ma yod pas de la brten nas bde ba skye/ de la brten nas sems zin pa dang mi rtog pa dang stong pa nyid rgyud la skye bas stong pa nyid la gus pa bskyed pa'i ched du'o// zhes gsungs pas/ rkang pa yang g.yas thabs g.yon shes rab la 'dir g.yon pa sngon la 'dor/ phyogs la shar dang byang thabs lho dang nub shes rab las 'dir lhor blta/ 'o na lho dang nub gnyis ka shes rab kyi phyogs yin pa la/ nub tu mi blta zhing lhor blta ba'i rgyu mtshan gang zhe na/ 'dir lhor blta ba la dgos pa khyad par can yod de/ spyir gdul bya gang na yod pa der 'dul byed gzigs dgos pa la/ bde mchog gi gdul bya ni drag po dbang phyug 'khor bcas yin pa lhor yod pa dang*/ gling gsum skyes pa'i mi rnams ni longs spyod che zhing dbang po rtul la chos kyi snod ma yin par dgongs nas mi gzigs shing*/ lho 'dzam bu gling pa rnams longs spyod chung zhing dbang po rno la chos kyi snod du gyur par dgongs pa dang*/

dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas rnams kyang 'dzam bu gling pa'i mi'i lus re re la brten nas mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas par bzhed pas dag pa'i zhing yin pa sogs la dgongs pa'o// mos pa ni 'jig rten pa'i lho phyogs su mos pa yin gyi rnal 'byor pas ni kha gang bstan shar yin pa'o// yang bha wa bha dras kha lhor bstan pa ni shes rab kyi phyogs dang dga' ba'i yul yin pas so// zhes dang*/ la wa pas zhal lhor bstan pa shes rab kyi phyogs su bshad pa'i don ni gong dang 'dra la/ dga' ba'i phyogs la ltos nas 'jig rten pa'i shar mchog dga' dang*/ byang khyad dga' las 'jig rten pa'i lhor rnal 'byor pa'i shar/ skye dka' ba dga' ba bzhi'i nang gi dga' ba dang*/ 'jig rten pa'i nub rnal 'byor pa'i byang lhan skyes yin pas khyad par 'phags/ de la dga' ba'i phyogs lho yin pas skye dka' ba la/ bltas pas lan gcig don 'grub gsungs so// tshul ji ltar du bsgom na/ kyai rdo rjer/ chu bo'i rgyun ni rab 'bab dang*// mar me'i rtse mo rab bcings ltar// rtag tu/ zhes pa ltar sems rnam rtog gzhan gyis bar ma chod cing*/ drag cing gsal ba'i tshul gyis bsgom zhing*/ 'grub bam mi 'grub bam snyam pa'i dogs pa sogs spangs te sems rtse gcig par dgos te/ de nyid las/ dogs pa med pa'i sems kyis ni// de yis las rnams thams cad byed// ces pa ltar ro// gnyis pa de dag gang zag dbang po rab 'bring bzhi char gyi nyams su len rgyu'i chos la don gsum ste/ thog mar bshad bya'i gsung rab sogs rnam gzhag spyir bstan pa/ gzhung dang sbyar nas bskyed rim 'khor bcas bshad pa/ shin tu zab pa'i rdzogs pa'i rim pa bshad pa'o// dang po ni/ bskyed pa'i rim pa phag mo mkha' spyod/ rdzogs pa'i rim pa rtsa dbu ma/ lam gyi yan lag gnod sbyin mo dbang du bya ba/ pra sen dbab pa/ sman chen po'i bcud len la sogs pa rnams te/

rtsa rgyud le'u so gnyis pa las/ rdo rje phag mo de yi ni// sku mdog mtshon cha 'phyar la gzigs// zhes pas lha bstan/ le'u zhe bdun pa las/ de nas mkha' 'gro ma yis rigs pa chen po bzlas nas rigs thams cad dbang du byed par 'gyur ro// rtag tu bzlas brjod byas na dpal chen po bskyed par 'gyur zhes phag mo'i nye snying la brten pa'i las tshogs gsungs/ le'u zhe brgyad pa las/ de nas gzhan yang bshad bya ste// mkha' 'gro kun gyi bde ba'i mchog /snying po'i rnal 'byor ma kun gyis// 'dod pa'i las kun sgrub pa po// gang zhig dran pa tsam gyis ni// 'jig rten gsum po g.yo byed cing*// rjes su dran pa tsam gyis kyang*// yang dag dngos grub rim gyis ster// oṃ sarba bud+dha ḍā ki nī ye badz+ra war+ṇa nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ sngags 'di bzlas pas 'grub pa ste// las rnams kun byed dga' ba yin// mkha' 'gro rnal 'byor ma rnams dang*// khaṇ+ḍa ro hī lā ma sogs// mkha' 'gro ma ni thams cad kyi// sngags ni 'di nyid yin par bshad// sa 'og yang na mtho ris sam// de bzhin mi yul dag tu yang*// las ni gang dag yod pa rnams// bklag pas de dag thams cad 'grub// 'di las shin tu mchog gyur gang*// 'jig rten gsum na ci yang med// gang phyir 'di ni bla med pa// las rnams thams cad sgrub byed yin// mkha' 'gro ma ni kun gyi gnas// mdor bshad rgyas pa ma yin no// zhes gsungs/ gzhung de rnams kyi dbang du mdzad nas/ jo bo nā ro ta pas bskyed rdzogs kyi gzhung chung 'di mdzad/ gzhung dngos bstan la rnal 'byor brgyad las ma bstan kyang nyal ldang khrus gsum man ngag gis kha bskangs nas/ rje sa chen gyis bskyed rim gyi gzhung brgyad rdzogs rim gyi gzhung bzhi ste bcu gnyis mdzad/ de rnams kyi sgrub thabs spyod lam gyi rnal 'byor las 'phros pa'i phyi mchod mdor bsdus/

de zhar la rjes gnang ngam byin rlabs gcig yod phyag len mi mdzad par gda'/ bskyed rim dang bzlas bsgom la brten nas mkha' spyod bsgrub pa byin rlabs kyi yi ge tshogs mchod tshes bcu'i mchod pa/ sbyin sreg mar me'i sbyin sreg pra sen dbab pa/ rgyud kyi dum bu gnod sbyin mo'i sgrub thabs tshangs pa'i bu mo sgrub pa/ pad+ma pa ti'i man ngag khol po pa ti'i man ngag sman chen po'i bcud len te/ dum bu 'di dag 'bri ba la/ go rim nges pa mi snang gsungs/ la la sa chen gyis ma mdzad kyang don 'khrul med yin no// rje btsun chen pos mdzad pa'i rtsa dbu ma 'di gzhung dngos bstan yab la sbyar kyang*/ bla ma phyi ma rnams kyis yum la'ang sbyar ba mdzad de/ rdo rje 'chang gi nye brgyud kyi brgyud 'debs las/ bskyed rim zab mo'i mkha' spyod rnal 'byor dang*// rdzogs rim dbu ma'i rnal 'byor bsgom pa'i mthus// bde chen lhan skyes ye shes skye ba dang*// mkha' spyod gong 'phang thob par byin gyis rlobs// zhes gsungs pas/ sbyor lugs ni yab yum tha dad du mkhyen dgos/ spyir rtsa dbu ma la phyag chen gces bsdus na bzhugs pa/ man ngag gces bsdus na bzhugs pa sogs yod pas mtha' gcig tu ma nges so// gang ltar rje sa chen gyis phag mo las bcu'i gzhung mdzad/ las bcu ni rang gzhan gyi don byed pa la las kyi yan lag bcu dgos te/ thog mar bsnyen pa/ gzhan don du slob ma rjes bzung*/ tshes bcu dang 'brel ba'i tshogs mchod/ rang gzhan gnyis ka dang 'brel ba gzhon nu ma'i mchod pa/ gnas skabs thams cad dang 'brel ba gtor ma/ dman pa'i dngos grub dang 'brel ba sbyin sreg bu chung gsar bu la phan 'dogs pa srung 'khor ro// las rtsub mo'i dbang du byas te gdug pa can tshar gcod pa sum+bha na'i cho ga bsgom pas phyir bzlog pa dang*/ bris pas phyir bzlog pa dang bcu yin no// 'di dag ni rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyi ma tshang ba kha bskang ba yin kyang*/

gtso bor zhal gnyis ma'i skor/ rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi las bcu'i gsal byed sogs dang*/ zhal gnyis ma'i sgrub thabs su/ nyal ldang khrus gsum gsungs nas phag mo gang du 'di gsum ma tshang ba 'dis kha bskang bar bya'o// zhes gsungs so// 'phags pa rin po ches/ mngon rtogs/ dkyil chog tshogs 'khor/ sbyin sreg rnams mdzad/ bla ma dam pa'i dngos slob sngags 'chang gzungs pas man ngag rin po che'i gter zhes bya ba sgrub thabs rdzogs rim cung zad/ mdun bskyed mchod chog slob ma la byin rlabs bya tshul/ zhi ba'i sbyin sreg de gzhir bzhag nas rgyas pa dang*/ dbang drag rnams bya tshul/ mar me'i sbyin sreg yi ge brgya pa la brten pa'i sbyin sreg bum khrus/ 'khrul 'khor gyi cho ga rnams phyogs gcig tu sdebs pa mdzad/ rdo rje 'chang gis nye brgyud kyi brgyud 'debs gnyis/ bstod pa la sogs pa'i gzhung bzhi mdzad/ gzhan yang kun mkhyen gung ru/ mnga' ris pa tshul khrims 'od zer/ kun mkhyen rin po ches sgrub thabs rnal 'byor bcu gcig gi nyams len/ sbyin sreg mar me'i sbyin sreg tshes bcu'i mchod pa ste mkha' spyod sgo 'byed mdzad/ sa lo 'jam pa'i rdo rje/ ngor chen dkon mchog lhun grub/ sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po/ thar rtse nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ paṇa chen shāka mchog tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po yab sras/ 'dren mchog blo gros chos 'phags/ mang thos klu sgrub/ mkhas grub ngag dbang chos grags/ rje btsun kun dga' grol mchog sngags 'chang thams cad mkhyen pa/ ngag dbang bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ yab rje sangs rgyas dpal bzang*/ rje dpal ldan rgyal po'i gsung bzhin rje bzang po dpal ba'i khrid yig sogs mdor na skyes chen rnams kyis bshad sgrub kyi sgo nas dar zhing rgyas par mdzad pa'i yig cha sgrub thabs dkyil chog byin rlabs bstod pa bkra shis sogs glegs bam du longs pa du ma yod de/

'di rnams ni bshad bya'i chos so// bshad bya rdo rje phag mo ni/ mtshon bya don gyi rdo rje phag mo/ mtshon byed brda'i rdo rje phag mo/ dang po ni rang gi sems gnyis su med pa'i ye shes spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral ba 'di la rdo rje zhes bya ste/ dper na rdzas kyi rdo rje pha lam gyis phar dngos po thams cad 'joms shing tshur gang gis kyang gzhig par mi nus pa ltar/ stong nyid rtogs pa'i ye shes 'dis kyang phar mtshan rtog thams cad 'joms shing tshur gang gis kyang gzhig par mi nus te/ rdo rje rtse mo las/ sra zhing snying po khog stong med// gcad dang gzhig par bya ba med// bsreg par byar med 'jig med pas// stong nyid rdo rje brjod par bya// zhes gsungs so// phag ni ji ltar phag pas/ mi gtsang ba ljan ljin sba sbur thams cad za ba ltar/ stong nyid rtogs pa'i ye shes 'dis kyang mtshan rtog thams cad za bar nus pas phag ces bya'o// mo ni mo chags kyis sems can skyed pa bzhin du gnas lugs stong pa nyid 'dis kyang dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad skyed pa'i yum yin pas mo zhes bya ste/ de skad du/ nga ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// yum gyi gzugs kyis skyed par byed// ces gsungs/ gnyis pa la phyi'i rdo rje phag mo/ nang gi rdo rje phag mo gnyis las/ dang po ni/ lha sku zhal phyag gi rnam pa can te/ bskyed rim gyis tha mal gyi snang zhen gcod par byed pa ste/ bskyed rim gyis tha mal gyi rnam rtog lha sku zhal phyag gi ngang du za bar nus pas phag gzugs sku skyed byed yum yin pas na mo zhes bya'o// gnyis pa ni gsang ba chos kyi dkyil 'khor gsum ste/ yi ge dang bdud rtsi dang rlung gsum la gnad du bsnun pa la brten nas gsal stong bde stong stong nyid bde stong mchog gi ting nge 'dzin gyis gya nom lhar zhen gyi rnam rtog gcod pas rdo rje/

ting nge 'dzin des lhar zhen gyi rnam rtog za bar nus pas na phag chos sku skyed byed kyi yum yin pas na mo zhes bya'o// de ltar yang*/ bden gnyis rnam dag rdzogs rim dbu ma'i lam// sgrib gnyis sbyang phyir brtson pas legs bsgoms pas// don gnyis lhun grub 'gyur med bde ba'i thugs// mkha' spyod thugs kyis byin gyis brlab tu gsol// zhes gsungs so// gdams ngag 'di dag gi bstan pa'i lam nyams su len par byed pa la/ bsgrub bya'i lha sgrub byed kyi mngon rtogs de ji ltar bsgrub pa'i tshul lo// dang po bskyed rim phag mo mkha' spyod ni dbang bzhi'i don dang ldan pa zab don mthar thug yin te/ dbang bzhi'i don ldan bskyed rim zab mo'i lam// thun bzhir bsgom zhing gus pas gsol btab pas// sku bzhi dbyer med zung 'jug rdo rje'i sku// mkha' spyod sku yis byin gyis brlab tu gsol// zhes gsungs/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro las/ mkha' 'gro ma yi drwa ba sdom// rnal 'byor ma yi legs rdzogs pas// rdo rje phag mo'i dkyil 'khor ni// 'di ni rnal 'byor thams cad kyi// snying po dal la bsdus pa yin// zhes gsungs pas dbang bzhi'i lam thams cad lha sku zhal phyag can gyi rnam pa can/ de'i thugs kar 'khor lo lnga brtsegs bsgom pa la tshang bas shin tu zab bo// gzhan yang rnal 'byor ma kun spyod las/ de ni he ru ka dpal sprul// dag pa chos kyi sprul pa ni// phag mo'i gzugs su bstan pa yin// thabs dang shes rab sbyor ba las// 'di nyid dang ni thams cad 'byung*// zhes dang*/ 'gro ba 'di kun sangs rgyas mnga' bdag nyid// gar mkhan dag dang rol mo bzang ltar snang*// gang zhig drug pa zhes bya'i sangs rgyas nyid// gcig pu nyid ni du ma'i gar mdzad do// zhes gsungs/ rtsa rgyud las/ mkha' 'gro ma ni nyi shu bzhi// phag mo yi ni rigs las 'byung*// zhes gsungs pas/

dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyi bdag nyid du gsungs so// yang kun spyod las/ mkha' 'gro ma ni re re bzhin// bye ba grangs med dag gis bskor// zhes gsungs/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro las/ rnal 'byor ma yi skye ba mchog /rtsa yi mchog gi grong khyer du// stong phrag bdun cu rtsa gnyis kyi// dbu ma a wa dhū ti 'o// dbu ma 'di ltar thams cad kyi// khyab byed nyid du gnas pas na// go 'phang mchog ni gzhal bar bya// zhes gsungs pas/ dang por a wa dhū ti/ de las nang skor 'dab ma brgyad la/ mtshams kyi rtsa bzhi las gnyis re ste/ rnam shes tshogs brgyad kyi rtsa brgyad/ de re re la sku gsung thugs kyi rtsa gsum gsum/ sngar gyi phyogs kyi rtsa bzhi/ dbu ma dang lnga ste sum cu rtsa bdun/ de las stong phrag bdun cu rtsa gnyis/ de las rgya mtsho'i nang du skar ma shar ba bzhin/ rten dkyil 'khor bzhi tshad med grangs med/ 'khor 'das snod bcud thams cad la sbyang gzhi dang sbyong byed dbyer med pa'i tshul gyis g.yogs nas bzhugs pa yin te/ dpal ldan khrag 'thung rgyal po che// 'dod pa kun gyi dbang phyug gtso// kun tu phyag dang zhabs ldan pa// kun tu mig dang mgo bo'i zhabs// kun tu thos ldan 'jig rten la// thams cad g.yogs te rnam par bzhugs// de dag kyang bsdu na/ bye ba phrag phyed dang bzhir 'dus/ de stong phrag bdun cu rtsa gnyis su/ de bdun cu rtsa bdun du/ de nyi shu rtsa bzhir/ de yang brgyad du 'dus te/ lā ma dang*/ gzugs can ma dang*/ yongs gyur ma dang*/ byis bcas ma dang*/ mi ldog ma dang*/ i hi ka dang*/ tsum bi ka dang*/ rdo rje phag mo rnams so// de rnams kyang bsdu na phag mor 'dus te/ rtsa rgyud las/ ya mi ni dang skrag byed ma// 'od ldan ma dang 'jigs gzugs ma// kun tu spyod ma mdzes ma dang*// bha su ra dang rnam pa bdun// sdud pa mo ni 'di bshad bya// zhes 'das pa'i ming ngo*// gzugs can ma dang tsum bhi ka
