/la ma yongs gyur byis bcas mo// mi ldog i hi ka lha mo// mkha' 'gro ma ni bdun du bshad// ces gsungs so// de yang sku 'khor gyi phyogs ma bzhi lā mar sdud/ mtshams ma bzhi gzugs can mar sdud/ gsung 'khor gyi phyogs ma bzhi yongs gyur mar sdud/ mtshams ma bzhi byis bcas mar sdud/ thugs 'khor gyi phyogs ma bzhi mi ldog mar sdud/ mtshams ma bzhi i hi kar sdud/ rnal 'byor ma bzhi tsum bhi kar sdud/ sgo mtshams brgyad gtso mor sdud/ de ltar phag mo ni rigs thams cad kyi sdud byed dam gtso mo yin pas zab bo// gnyis pa sgrub byed mngon rtogs kyi sgo nas kyang gzhan las zab ste/ de yang lam 'di nyid ni/ ltos sa yab la bzhag nas/ ltos chos yum du len pa bya ba smin byed yab la ltos pa'i nyams len khyad par can te/ gsang mtha' la yang lū nag dril gsum gyi nyams len la/ mnyam par bzhag pa'i rnal 'byor dang*/ ma bzhag pa'i rnal 'byor ro// mnyam bzhag la yang bskyed pa'i rim pa dang rdzogs pa'i rim pa'o// bskyed pa'i rim pa la yang rgyu tshogs gnyis bsags pa dang*/ 'bras bu lhar bskyed pa gnyis te/ de dag gi lam rnams las chung la zab khyad dang ldan zhing lam thams cad tshang ste/ de la tshogs gnyis bsags pa'i bsod nams kyi tshogs ni/ 'dir bla ma spyi bor bsgom zhing gsol ba 'debs pa la zab bo// ye shes kyi tshogs ni bla ma 'od du zhu nas rang la thim pas lus sems thams cad bde chen gyi ye shes su byin gyis brlabs shing*/ der 'khor 'das snod bcud thams cad la rgyas btab nas bsgom pa la tshang zhing zab bo// gnyis pa 'bras bu lha bskyed pa la/ lū nag dril gsum gyi skabs su nag po pa la 'byung bzhi lugs 'byung la gzhal yas khang bskyed la/ mngon byang lnga las rgyu rdo rje 'chang yab yum bskyed pa/ yab yum snyoms 'jug gi bde ba sngon du 'gro ba'i sgo nas thig le las dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog bskyed pa/

lū hi pa las 'byung bzhi sgra tshul dang bcas pa la phyi nang gnyis gcig char du bskyed pa/ dril bu pa las skad cig gis phyi'i he ru ka zhar byung las nang la lha drug cu rtsa gnyis bskyed pa'i bskyed chog rnams rtogs rigs yar ldan gyi tshul du tshang zhing*/ 'dir zab khyad dang ldan pas bskyed chog khyad par 'phags pa yin te/ oṃ gsum ma tshar gcig brjod pa/ sgra tshul las bskyed pa lū hi pa dang mtshungs/ nyi zla phyag mtshan sa bon rnams mtshon pa yod pas nag po pa dang*/ skad cig gis rdo rje rnal 'byor ma bsgoms pas dril bu pa dang mtshungs la de rnams re res kyang skye gnas bzhi sbyong ba dang gtso che chung gi khyad par yod pa'ang shes par bya'o// 'dir skye gnas bzhi gcig char sbyong ste/ snying kha'i chos 'byung phyi ma gang du bskyed pa'i gnas/ nyi ma ma'i mngal/ zla ba pha'i khams/ sam+bu ṭir gsungs pa ltar zla ba dmar mdangs yod pas rang chas can nam/ bam̐ yig gi mdangs kyis dbus dmar nyams yod pa des ni ma'i khams bam̐ yig gis bar srid des mngal skyes sbyang zhing*/ yang 'khor lo lnga po des skye gnas lhag ma sbyong ste/ chos 'byung gnyis pha ma dang sgong lkogs/ zla ba dmar cha dang bcas pa byang sems gnyis/ bam̐ yig snga ma ltar te/ sgong skyes sbyong byed dang*/ 'od zer 'phros nas 'od zer gyi gong bur gyur pas drod gsher skyes sbyong*/ de las rje btsun ma skad cig gis bskyed pas rdzus skyes sbyong*/ yang na 'od kyi gong bur gyur pas sgong skyes sbyong ste/ gong bu'i bdag nyid du chos mthun pas so gsung*/ 'dis phyi dkyil rgyas pa'i mngon byang lnga yang bsdus te/ 'bras bu ye shes lnga tshang ba'i bskyed chog nyid la mngon byang lnga yang tshang ba yin la/ ye shes lnga ni zla ba'i brdas bstan pa'i me long lta bu'i ye shes/ sngags phreng mnyam nyid kyi ye shes/ bam̐ sor rtog ye shes/

'od zer spro bsdu bya grub ye shes/ sku bzhengs pa chos dbyings ye shes yin no// dngos su tshang ba rtsi ba rang nyid rnal 'byor mar bsgoms pa'i snying gar chos 'byung gi nang stong pa ni stong pa chos dbyings stong pa nyid la byang chub pa/ zla ba dang dmar cha ni gdan pad nyi las byang chub pa/ sngags phreng gsung yig 'bru las byang chub pa/ e wam̐ gzugs sgrub kyi tshe bam̐ gyi yi ge la gri gug gi so lta bu yod pas thugs phyag mtshan las byang chub pa/ lhar bzhengs pa sku yongs su rdzogs pa las byang chub pa ste lnga tshang ngo*// ji skad du/ a bhi dha na las/ de las gzhan yang bshad bya ba// phag mo yi ni sgrub pa mchog /bskyed pa'i rim pa'i sbyor ba yis// bdag nyid bsgom pa rnal 'byor bsgom// zhes gsungs pa dang*/ gzhan yang mkha' 'gro rgya mtshor/ phag mo phyi yis yongs su byung*// bskyed pa gang gis bskyed pa lags// rang gzhan dang ni ji ltar lags// bdag nyid 'byung ba'i rgyu mtshan ji// 'dir ni dgos pa ji ltar lags// zhes zhus pa'i lan du/ dbang po dang ni yul thams cad// lte ba'i dal du rab zhugs pa// spyi bor rdo rje gur du ni// steng du kha ra rlung 'bab bo// 'dod chags nyi ma'i dbus su ni// skad cig gis ni sprul tser 'gyur// de las bskyed pa'i phag mo ni// bha ga liṅga yi las byung*// bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin las// de rnams la ni sngon du bskyed// rang gzhan bdag med gcig pu ste// mkha' mnyam rnal 'byor gzugs can no// rgyu mtshan 'gro ba sgrol ba dang*// snying rje'i gzugs dang gzhan du byung*// 'dir ni dgos pa gnyis rig ste// phyag rgya sbyor ba rab sbyor ba'o// zhes gsungs pas/ des na lū nag dril gsum gyi bskyed chog rnams las zab pa'i bskyed chog bstan pa ni/ bla ma 'od du zhu ba'i rkyen gyis lus sems rnams bde chen gyi ye shes su byin gyis brlabs pa ni/

bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin las// zhes pas bstan te/ de ni sbyang gzhi 'chi ba sbyang zhing chos sku bsgrub pa'i sgrub thabs pho nya lhan skyes so// bde chen gyi ye shes de'i ngang las/ rgyas par na rang gzhan gnyis ka'i gzhi sbyong zhing bsgyur ba dang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyang rnal 'byor ma'i skur byas la rang la bsdus te de rnams la bskyed pa dang*/ rang gzhan gnyis ka'i gzhi sbyang bsgyur byas nas bskyed pa dang*/ bsdus pa ni/ rang gzhan gzhi sbyang bsgyur byas pa dang gsum las/ phyi ma phyag len la mdzad pas/ de'i ngang las e las chos 'byung yig 'bru bam̐ yig rnams ni/ bha ga liṅga yi las byung*// zhes pas bstan te/ de yang sbyang gzhi bar srid sbyang zhing longs sku sgrub pa'i sgrub thabs pho nya zhing skyes so// chos 'byung*/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ yig 'bru/ bam̐ yig rnams las 'od zer 'phros gzhi sbyong bsgyur byas/ lha sku zhal phyag gi rnam par bskyed pa ni/ de rnams la ni sngon du bskyed// ces pas bstan te/ de yang sbyang gzhi skye ba sbyang zhing sprul sku sgrub pa'i pho nya sngags skyes so// 'o na de ltar bskyed pa'i phag mo'i rang bzhin ji ltar yin snyam na/ rang bzhin bdag med gcig pu ste// mkha' mnyam rnal 'byor gzugs can no// zhes pa dang*/ a bhi dha nar/ phag mo'i gzugs ni tha dad pas// spros dang bral bas sdom pa 'o// zhes gsungs pas/ rang bzhin chos thams cad kyi sdud byed de kho na nyid do// de ltar gnas lugs spros bral de kho na nyid do// lha sku zhal phyag gi rnam par bsgom pa la/ rgyu mtshan ci yod snyam na/ rgyu mtshan 'gro ba sgrol ba dang*// snying rje'i gzugs dang gzhan du 'byung*// zhes pas bstan te/ sems can thams cad 'khor ba duḥkha las sgrol ba'i phyir du lha sku zhal phyag gi rnam par bsgom pa'o// de ltar bsgom pa la dgos pa ci yod ce na/

mchog thun mong gi dngos grub ste/ de'ang 'dir ni dgos pa gnyis rig ste/ phyag rgya sbyor ba rab sbyor ba'o// zhes pas bstan to// des na de lta bu'i bskyed chog de rten dkyil 'khor bzhi dang 'khor lo lnga la gnad du bsnun pa zab ste/ dang po dkyil 'khor bzhi la gnad du bsnun pa ni/ lus la rtsa bsam gyis mi khyab pa rnams chos 'byung*/ yi ge rnams yig 'bru/ bdud rtsi rnams zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ rlung rnams dga' ba 'khyil par bsdoms nas gnad du bsnun/ chos 'byung phyi ma lte ba'i 'khor lo/ nang ma gsang gnas kyi 'khor lo/ zla ba'i snying po'i 'khor lo bam̐ yig ya ra la wa bzhi/ mtshon pas mgrin pa'i 'khor lo/ yig 'bru rnams spyi bo'i 'khor lo/ rtsa 'dab so gnyis mtshon/ de rnams kyang chung chung nyung nyung ma zhig yin/ lha drug cu rtsa gnyis kyi rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor yin te/ chos kyi 'byung gnas gzhal yas khang*/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dpa' bo rnams/ yi ge so gnyis bam̐ yig cha lnga dang bcas pa rnal 'byor ma so bdun no/ des na sgrub byed mngon rtogs kyi sgo nas zab bo// gnyis pa des tshul ji ltar sgrub pa'i tshul ni lū nag gi skabs su rgyu bde gshegs snying po de nyid/ stong nyid snying rje'i snying po can gyi byang chub sems su bsgyur/ de lta bu'i byang chub kyi sems de la smin byed kyi dbang gi sgo nas dbang gi ye shes su byin gyis brlabs/ de ltar brlabs pa de nyid sin+dhū ra'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bzhi byin rlabs kyi tshul du bskur nas dbang gi ye shes la ngo sprod/ sprad pa'i ye shes de nyid rdo rje 'chang gis/ tha mal snod dang bcud du rab zhen pa'i// kun rdzob 'khrul pa'i las snang ma lus kun// rnam bzhag lha yi snang bar sgyur byed pa'i// mkha' spyod bskyed rim bsgom par byin gyis rlobs// zhes gsungs pa ltar gyis/

'khor 'das snod bcud kyi snang ba phra rags thams cad rang sems kun gzhi skad cig mar bsdus/ de spros bral stong pa nyid du sbyangs/ de'i ngang las chos 'byung zla ba sogs/ de dag las lha sku zhal phyag gi rnam par bsgyur bas zab bo// de'ang rnal 'byor bcu gcig gi sgo nas bsgrub pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa gzhung dang sbyar nas bskyed rim 'khor bcas bshad pa ni/ klad kyi don/ gzhung gi don/ mjug gi don dang gsum las/ dang po klad kyi don la/ mtshan bsgyur ba/ zhar byung lo tsā bas phyag bya'o// dang po rgya gar skad du/ badz+ra yo gi nī dha ya/ de bod skad du bsgyur na/ badz+ra rdo rje/ yo gi nī rnal 'byor ma/ dha ya ni sgrub pa'i thabs ces bya'o// gnyis pa dgos don/ bsdus don/ tshig don rnams kyis 'chad do// gsum pa ni/ thugs rje chen po la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes so// gnyis pa gzhung gi don la rten gyi gang zag de nyams su blang ba'i lam/ lam de nyams su blangs pa las byung ba'i 'bras bu'o// dang po gzhung las/ dang po re zhig rnal 'byor pas// zhes pas bstan la/ rnal 'byor ma kun spyod du yang*/ dang po re zhig rnal 'byor pa'i dbang phyug /ces gsung zhing*/ lū hi pa'i rgya gzhung du yang*/ de ltar du gsungs pas/ de la gnyis te/ slob pa'i rnal 'byor pa'i dbang phyug dang*/ mi slob pa'i rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug go /de'ang rgyud sde 'og ma la ltos nas/ lū nag gi rnal 'byor pa mi slob pa'i rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug yin te/ rgyud sde 'og ma rnams kyi lam gyi rtogs rigs yar ldan yin zhing*/ de dag las khyad par du 'phags so// rnal 'byor ma'i rnal 'byor pa la ltos nas/ lū nag gi rnal 'byor pa slob pa'i rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug yin te/ de dag gi lam rim gyi rtogs rigs yar ldan zhing*/ de dag las rno ba'i lam yin pa'i phyir ro// de slob pa'i rnal 'byor pa ni spros bcas la dga' ba/

mi slob pa'i rnal 'byor pa ni spros med la dga' ba'o// rnal 'byor zhes bya ba ni/ lū nag gi rtogs rigs yar ldan zhing*/ 'di'i rnal 'byor bcu gcig nyams su blangs pas ting nge 'dzin rgyud la skyes pa'o// pa zhes bya ba ni dper na rta dang ldan pa la rta pa zhes bya ba/ de bzhin du de lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin dang ldan pas na pa zhes bya'o// dbang phyug ces bya ba ni/ spyir lū nag dril gsum gyi lam rnams gzhan las khyad par du 'phags shing*/ bye brag tu rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i lam 'di gzhan las zab cing mchog tu gyur pa yin pas/ de nyams su len pa'i rnal 'byor pa thams cad kyi mchog tu gyur pa yin pas dbang phyug ces bya'o/ rten gyi gang zag gi mtshan nyid gong du bshad zin to// thob bya mthar thug sangs rgyas kyi sku thob par byed pa la/ rtogs bya mthar thug de kho na nyid du rtogs dgos/ de la rdzogs rim gyi ting nge 'dzin rgyud la skye dgos/ de la rten bskyed rim dgos/ bskyed pa'i rim pa bsgom pa la lha sku zhal phyag gi rnam par bzhengs dgos/ de la bskyed rim rnal 'byor bcu gcig ni/ sa skya pa chen po'i zhal snga nas/ nyal dang ldang dang bdud rtsi myong*// tshad med bla ma bdag lhar bskyed// 'gro ba dag pa'i rnal 'byor dang*// dpa' bo dpa' mos byin gyis brlabs// ngag bzlas yid bzlas gnyis gcig yin// bsam gyi mi khyab rnal 'byor dang*// spyod lam gyi ni rnal 'byor te// de ltar rnal 'byor bcu gcig go /zhes gsungs/ de la dang po nyal dang zhes pa ni/ lha sku zhal phyag gi rnam par bzhengs pa'i sngon du nyal ba'i rnal 'byor dgos te/ de dag gi go rim ni dang po re shig ces pas bstan no// rnal 'byor bcu gcig las dang po nyal ba'i rnal 'byor la gnyis te/ bskyed rim gyi phyogs la mos pa dang*/ rdzogs rim gyi phyogs la mos pa'o// gnyis po gang ltar na'ang srod thun la bsgom bzlas byas nas thun gzhug tu nyal ba'i rnal 'byor bya/

bsgom bzlas dang ma 'brel na yang skad cig gis nyal ba'i rnal 'byor bsgom pa'o// dang po sgrub pa po spros pa la dga' zhing skyed rim la mos pa che na/ rang nyid gnas khang chos 'byung nyis brtsegs kyi nang du seṅges btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri sna tshogs pad+ma nyi ma'i steng du rang nyid rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sku rgyan dang phyag mtshan spangs pa sha rus sogs gdos bcas ma yin pa 'od kyi rang bzhin du bsgom/ grogs yod na yang de lta bur gsal btab/ rang gi spyi bo'i sngas mgor sngas bsrung gi tshul du seṅges btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje chos kyi rnam pa can rgyan cha lugs yongs su rdzogs pa cig gsal btab/ de la gus 'dud drag pos phyag 'tshal gsol ba btab cing blo gtad/ des mtshams sbyar la gzhogs g.yas 'og tu phab cing nyal lo// 'di zhu bde lhan skyes bde ba'i ngang la nyal ba yang yin no// gnyid sad byung na yang de ltar gsal btab ste nyal lo// gnyis pa ni sa skya pa chen pos bsam mi khyab kyi rnal 'byor dang 'brel nas nyal ba'am/ skad cig gis stong par bsgoms nas nyal ba gang rung gsungs pas/ bsam mi khyab dang 'brel nas nyal na/ a bhi dha nar/ spro ba dang bsdu ba byas nas// zhes gsungs pas/ rang gi lte ba'i bam̐ yig sngags phreng zla ba'i dkyil 'khor yig 'bru rnams las 'od zer 'phros/ khams gsum snod bcud thams cad la phog pas/ gzugs med khams 'od zer sngon po'i rnam pas lus kyi stod kyi cha la thim/ gzugs khams 'od zer dmar po'i rnam pas bar gyi cha la thim/ 'dod khams 'od zer dkar po'i rnam pas smad kyi cha la thim/ rnal 'byor ma rang yang sku stod sku smad nas rim gyis 'dus te chos 'byung phyi ma la/ phyi ma nang ma la/ de zla ba la/ de sngags phreng la/ de bam̐ yig 'bru bzhi la/ de zla tshes la/

de thig le la/ de nā da la thim/ mthar gnyid du 'gro kha nā da yang je phrar song ste nam mkha' la 'ja' yal ba ltar spros bral de kho na nyid kyi ngang la rnam rtog gzhan gyis bar ma chod par byas nas nyal te/ 'di rang bzhin lhan skyes stong pa'i ngang du nyal ba yin no// a bhi dha nar/ chos rnams kun gyi chos nyid bsgom// zhes gsungs so// rnal 'byor gnyis pa ldang ba'i rnal 'byor la gnyis te/ bskyed rim gyi ngang la nyal ba'i ldang lugs dang*/ rdzogs rim gyi ngang la nyal ba'i ldang lugs so// de dag la bzhi ste/ rgyu gang ldang*/ rkyen gang gis/ tshul ji ltar/ ngo bo gang ldang ba'o// dang po bskyed rim gyi ngang la nyal ba'i ldang lugs kyi rgyu ni/ mdang gi lha sku'i rnam pa de las so// rkyen ni sngas mgo'i rdo rje chos kyi nam mkhar ḍā ma ru'i sgra oṃ gsum ma'i sngags su grags pa'o// las dang po pas gnyid kyi ngang du de dran pa mi yong na gnyid sad ma thag tu des bskul nas ldang ba yin no snyam du mos pa byas pas goms na gnyid sad khar de dran pa 'byung ngo gsungs/ tshul ni skad cig gis chu las nya 'phar ba'i tshul gyis bya'o// ngo bo phyag mtshan med pa'i rnal 'byor ma'i skur lam ste langs te/ rang nyid lhar gsal ba dang*/ mdun gyi bla ma dang bcas pa gsal ba'i ngang nas gnas khang la bltas pas dag gsal gnyis med kyi ngo bo chos 'byung dmar po/ grogs sogs ni rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gsal btab/ mdun gyi bla ma la mos gus ched du byas pas 'od du zhu rang la thim pas rang nyid sngar bas kyang gsal bar bsam/ de yang*/ a bhi dha nar/ rang nyid lhag pa'i lhar sbyor ba'o// zhes gsungs/ sems can thams cad kyang rnal 'byor ma'i skur bsgom nus na khyad par 'phags te/ sems can kun la rab brtag bya// zhes gsungs/ gnyis pa rdzogs rim gyi ngang la nyal ba'i ldang lugs kyi rgyu ni/ mdang gi chos nyid bsam gyis mi khyab de las so// rkyen ni mkha' spyod kyi dpa' bo dpa' mo rnams kyis nam mkhar ḍā ma ru'i sgra oṃ gsum ma'i sngags su 'khrol te byung ba'o// tshul ni chu las nya 'phar ba'i tshul bya ba'am yang na bsam mi khyab de las nā dar ldang*/

de nas thig le nas rnal 'byor ma'i skur bsgom pa'i bar gyis ldang ngo*// ngo bo phyag mtshan med pa'i rnal 'byor ma'i skur langs te/ sems can thams cad rnal 'byor ma'i skur bsgom pa sngar bzhin no// ldang ba'i dus tshod ni nam gyi bzhi cha'am brgyad cha nas ldang bar 'dod gsungs/ de dag gi sbyang gzhi sbyong byed ngo sprad na/ snod kyi 'jig rten 'jig pa zhig nas stong pa/ bcud kyi sems can 'chi ba la phra rags gnyis te/ rags pa'i 'chi rim sa chu la thim/ chu me la thim/ me rlung la thim/ rlung rnam par shes pa la thim pa ni rags pa'i 'chi rim mo// rnam par shes pa snang ba la thim/ snang ba mched pa la thim/ mched pa thob pa la thim/ thob pa 'od gsal la thim pa ni phra ba'i 'chi rim ste/ snod kyi 'jig rten zhig pa da 'jig 'gyur/ sngar bcud kyi sems can shi ba/ da 'jig 'gyur gyi bar rtog pa'i snang ba dang bcas pa thams cad rang bzhin thams cad dge sbyor gyis rtsis ma zin pa'i tha mal gyi nyal ldang rnams kyang yin gsungs/ sbyong byed ni de thams cad 'dir bsgom pa'i kun gzhi rang sems skad cig ma gcig tu bsgyur/ de spros bral de kho na nyid bsam mi khyab kyi ngang du bshig nas bsgoms la/ de lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin ni/ de yang pho nya gsum bsres kyi tshul du nyams su len te/ rang gi dmigs pa'i sgo nas bsgom pa'i pho nya sngags skyes/ de'ang yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i zhing skyes sprul sku'i ting nge 'dzin las gzhan ma yin te/ zhing skyes de'ang 'og min gyi pho nya lhan skyes kyi ting nge 'dzin las gzhan ma yin la/ de'ang chos kyi sku las gzhan ma yin no snyam du bsgom mo// 'chi ba chos sku ngo sprod pa'o// shi nas chos sku ngo ma 'phrod na ma rig pas rgyu byas bag chags kyis rkyen byas te/ 'od gsal las thob par langs/ thob pa mched par langs pa sogs rim gyis langs te sgo dgu gang rung nas 'thon te bar do 'byung ba de spyod byed/

de nas gnyid du song ba'i gnas skabs su nyin bar gyi bag chags rmi lam sna tshogs 'byung ba rnams rmi lam du rang ngo shes par byas la longs spyod rdzogs skur ngo sprod/ pho nya gsum bsres sngar bzhin/ yang sngar skyes pa dang skye 'gyur gyi bar rtog pa'i snang ba dang bcas pa thams cad ldang ba'i rnal 'byor gyis sems skad cig mar sdud/ de rnal 'byor ma'i skur ldang*/ de sprul skur ngo sprad/ de la pho nya gsum bsre tshul sngar ltar nyams su blangs te/ sbyang gzhi skye 'chi bar do gsum mo// sbyong byed nyal ba dang gnyid du song ba dang ldang ba'i rnal 'byor gsum gyi sbyangs 'bras sku gsum ngo sprad pa yin te/ 'chi ba zhes bya chos sku ste// bar srid longs spyod rdzogs pa dang*// 'gro ba drug sogs sprul pa ste// zhes gsungs/ 'di dag la goms nas rmi lam sbyang bsgyur spel ba'i gnad kyang kha bskangs na legs so snyam mo// 'o na sbyang gzhi skye 'chi bar do gsum/ 'og lha bskyed pa'i skabs su'ang 'byung bas/ lan mang po zlos pa'i skyon med dam snyam na med de sbyang gzhi gtso che ba rnams sbyong byed du mas sbyang dgos pa'i phyir dang rang bzhin gyis dus gsum gyi skye 'chi la thug pa yang med pa'i phyir ro gsungs/ de ltar ldang ba'i rnal 'byor gyis langs nas ci byed na bsam gtan bsgom pa la 'jug pas so// 'dir bdud rtsi 'og nas 'byung ba ltar myong bsrung ba'i mchog kyang yin gsungs/ de nas go cha gsal 'debs pa dang*/ tshams rngam sngags kyis bsrung ba bya ba dang*/ dga' ba gsum gsal 'debs bsngo ba smon lam rnams byas te/ de rnams srod thun gyi mjug sdud yin gsungs/ bsnyen mtshams lta bu'am gang ltar skabs 'dir sngags thun gyi thugs dam chag med gzhan dgos pa yod pa'ang byas la thun mtshams kyi bya ba ci dgos pa 'grub bo// bsam gtan gyi grogs su 'gro zhing khrus byed par spro na dbang lha spyan drangs mchod cing gsol ba btab la/

chu gtsang ma'am 'dir rnal 'byor bla med yin pas dri chu 'bru gsum gyis byin gyis rlabs pa'am/ bum chu dbang gi skabs ltar gtso bo'i thugs ka nas sgo mtshams ma brgyad byon te bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ snying po'i rnal 'byor ma bzhi'i rdo rje'i glu len/ khaṇ+ḍa ka pā li la sogs pa'i dpa' bo rnams kyis bkra shis brjod/ rab tu gtum mo la sogs pa'i dpa' mo rnams kyis mchod pa byas/ sgo mtshams ma brgyad kyis bgegs bskrad par bsam/ dngos su khrus bya zhing yi ge brgya pa 'don dbang bzhi chu rgyun gcig la thob par bsam/ sgrub pa'i cho ga bsre ba dang rigs bdag bsam pa ni mi dgos so// gnas skabs gzhan du yang gdong bkru ba dang skra bkru ba sogs la yang khrus kyi rnal 'byor 'di dang khyad par med do// mi spro zhing bsam gtan gyi grogs su mi 'gro na ma byas kyang nyes pa med do// de nas bsam gtan bsgom pa la gnas la sogs pa ni bshad zin to// gsum pa bdud rtsi myang ba ni/ tho rangs ni ldang ba'i rjes thog de ma thag nas myong la thun gyi phyi ma gsum la thun la 'jug pa'i gong 'dir ram/ 'og rdor sems kyi bsgom bzlas tshar nas myang ba yang 'dug pas gang ltar yang bdud rtsi ril bu yod na gsum mam gnyis sam gcig 'bru gsum gyis myang*/ med na bur chang ngam nas chang byin rlabs rgyas pa byed na lū dril gyi skabs ltar bya/ 'bring rdo rje 'chang gi gtor chog bzhin/ bsdu na 'bru gsum gyis myang byin gyis brlabs la/ dag bya lus ngag yid gsum/ dag byed rdzas dang sngags ting nge 'dzin gsum gyi lam bstan nas dga' ba gsum ldan du ldang ste/ lha sku zhal phyag gi rnam par ldang ba ni sku'i dga' ba'am dag pa/ mgrin pa 'od dpag med kyi gnas su bdud rtsi myang ba gsung gi dga' ba'am dag pa/ de'ang bdud rtsi myang lugs ni/ snying kha'i bam̐ yig mchod pa'i bsam pas 'bru gsum gyis myangs te mgrin pa na ya ra la wa'i rtsa bzhi yod pas/

der dwangs ma dpag tu med pa 'phel bas lus thams cad la khyab/ khyad par snying ga'i bam̐ yig dmar po ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin can la bdud rtsi bab lus sems bde chen gyi ye shes su byin gyis brlabs/ bam̐ yig nyi ma bye ba'i gzi brjid dang ldan par bsam pa ni thugs kyi dga' ba'am dag pa yin no// bdud rtsi myang ba'i sbyang gzhi 'dod sred kyis kun nas bslangs te dus gsum gyi dkor zas lha'i bdud rtsi dud 'gro rnams kyi kha zas sogs mdor na bza' btung gi snang ba ji snyed pa rnams yin no// sbyong byed 'dir bdud rtsi myang ba'i rnal 'byor du bsgyur nas dag pa'i snang bas rgyas 'debs pa yin no// sbyangs 'bras rig pa 'dzin pa'am 'od dpag med kyi go 'phang thob par byed do// de lta bu'i nyal ba dang ldang ba dang bdud rtsi myang ba rnams 'og gi bsam mi khyab pa'i gzhung gis bstan to// bzhi pa tshad med bzhi bsgom pa ni/ gzhung las sems can thams cad 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho chen po las bsgral nas rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi bde ba la 'khod par bya'o zhes tshad med pa'i rnal 'byor sngon du 'gro bas bya'o// zhes gsungs/ de la tshad med bzhi bsgoms pa'i sngon du skyabs 'gro bya ba/ de nas tshad med bzhi bsgom pa dngos/ rgyas par na rdo rje sems dpa'i bsgom bzlas bya ba'o// de dag gi rgyu mtshan lam log pa las khyad par du bya ba skyabs 'gro'i khrid/ dman pa las khyad par du bya ba sems bskyed kyi khrid/ 'gal rkyen sdig sgrib sbyang ba yi ge brgya pa'i khrid do// de gsum gyi sgrub pa po'i rgyud kyi sdom pa gsum gyi bslab pa yar ldan bya ba ste/ so thar gyi sdom pa yar ldan du bya ba'i phyir skyabs 'gro/ byang sems kyi sdom pa yar ldan du bya ba'i phyir sems bskyed/ sngags sdom yar ldan du bya ba'i phyir rdo rje sems dpa'i bsgom bzlas so// mdor na dngos gzhi bskyed rdzogs kyi nyams len byed pa sngon 'gro sdom gsum gyi bslab pa shin tu dag pa cig dgos pas de yang nyes ltung chen po byung na slar yang dbang bskur ba blangs dgos shing*/

thun mtshams gyi nyes ltung phra mo rnams sngon 'gro'i 'di gsum byas pas dag par 'gyur ro// de skad du slob dpon 'jam dpal grags pas/ sdom gsum cho gar mi ldan par// sngags pa'i bdag nyid mi 'gyur ste// zhes dang*/ dang por so sor thar pa yi// sdom pa legs par ma bzung bar// gsang ba tshogs tshul gnas byed pa// tha ba las 'bras bskyed bzhin no// rtsa ba rnyed par mi 'gyur bas// dang po skyabs 'gro nas brtsams ste// sdom gsum cho ga rab tu brtag /ces gsungs/ de ltar sdom gsum dag par byas pas bskyed rdzogs kyi ting nge 'dzin skye ba sogs dgos pa dpag tu med pa yod de/ sdom gsum cho gar rab tu brtag /de ltar sngags pa tshul ldan pas// dngos grub la ni dogs med de// bstan pa sangs rgyas sogs bstod cing*// lha sogs 'jig rten kun gyis bkur// zhes so// dang po skyabs 'gro ni/ rnam gzhag rgyas par na/ rgyu yul tshul dang phan yon dang*// bslab bya sgra don dbye ba 'o// zhes pa'i don shes dgos la/ 'dir mdor bsdus te bshad na/ gang la skyabs su 'gro ba'i yul/ skyabs su 'gro mkhan gyi gang zag skyabs su 'gro ba'i tshul gsum las/ dang po skyabs yul gsal gdab pa ni/ rang gang du gnas pa'i sa phyogs 'di nyid tha mal gyi snang ba thams cad dbyings su thim pa'i ngang las zhing yongs su dag pa baiḍūr+ya'i sa gzhi lag mthil ltar mnyam pa la gser gyi mig mangs ris su bres pa/ mnan na nem pa btegs na spar byed pa/ reg na phun sum tshogs pa'i bde ba bskyed pa/ de'i dbus su rang gi smin mtshams kyi thad tsam du sleb pa'i mdun gyi nam mkhar seṅge chen po brgyad kyis btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri'i dbus su rtsa ba'i bla ma 'khor lo bde mchog gi rnam pa can la thugs gsung sku'i lha sgo mtshams ma brgyad kyis bskor ba/ gtso bo'i rgyab khaṇ+ḍa ro hi'i mdun du chos po ti brag ri brtsegs pa lta bu gsal btab/

de yang gtso bo ni bla ma dang sangs rgyas dkon mchog gi rang bzhin/ chos po ti ni chos dkon mchog 'khor rnams dge 'dun dkon mchog gi rang bzhin du bsams la skyabs 'gro byed pa'i tshe/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la zhes pa'i tshe gtso bo la dmigs pa gtad/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas zhes pa'i tshe'ang gtso bo la dmigs/ dam pa'i chos rnams la zhes pa'i tshe chos po ti la dmigs pa gtad/ 'phags pa'i dge 'dun zhes pa'i tshe 'khor gyi lha tshogs la dmigs pa gtad/ skyabs 'gro sdud pa'i tshe bla ma dang dkon mchog rin po che sogs kyis gsol ba btab pas skyabs yul rnams las 'od zer 'phros rigs drug gi sems can thams cad la sogs nas mi dmigs par bzhag pa gang bde bya zhes pa'i bar 'og nas 'byung ba ltar bsam/ de nas gtso bo bla ma 'od sngon por zhu rang gi snying gar thim thugs kyi byin rlabs zhugs par bsam/ chos po ti 'od dmar por zhu/ mgrin par thim/ gsung gi byin rlabs zhugs par bsam/ 'khor gyi lha rnams 'od dkar por zhu/ dpral bar thim/ sku'i byin rlabs zhugs par bsam/ de dag ni dngos grub blang ba zhes bya'o// de rnams skyabs 'gro'i dmigs pa lugs gcig go /yang na smin mtshams kyi thad kar seng khri pad nyi 'jigs byed dus mtshan dang bcas pa'i steng na skyabs gnas thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bo rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i rnam pa rgyan cha lugs yongs su rdzogs pa de'i spyi bor pad zla'i steng na rnam snang he ru ka sku mdog dkar po g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum phyag g.yas pas 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa dang g.yon pas 'khor los yu ba byas pa'i dril bu bsnol nas 'dzin pa/ rus pa'i rgyan drug gis brgyan pa gsal gdab la/ dpal ldan bla ma zhes pa'i tshe rnam snang la dmigs pa gtad/ de bzhin du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas zhes pa'i tshe bam̐ yig 'khor lo lnga brtsegs la/ dam pa'i chos rnams la/

zhes pa'i tshe sngags phreng dang gsung la/ 'phags pa'i dge 'dun zhes pa'i tshe sku la dmigs pa gtad/ bsdu ba'i tshe sku las 'od zer 'phros rigs drug gi sems can thams cad la phog pas/ de rnams kyi lus ngag yid gsum gyi sgrib pa thams cad sbyangs/ lus 'od kyi gong bu re rer gyur/ de yang mkha' spyod ma'i skur gyur te mkha' spyod la bya khyu 'phur ba ltar song bar bsam pa'am mi dmigs pa bzhag pa gang bde bya/ sems can rnams la dkon mchog gi byin rlabs bstim pa 'di gong 'og gnyis char du shes par bya'o// de nas rdo rje rnal 'byor ma de 'od du zhu nas rang la thim pas dkon mchog gi byin rlabs rang la zhugs par bsam/ yang skyabs yul lugs gcig la/ mdun gyi nam mkhar seṅges btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la rtsa ba'i bla ma rje btsun rdo rje chos kyi rnam pa can du bzhugs pa la skyabs gnas kun tshang ba yin te/ bla ma thams cad thugs yid gcig pas bla ma kun 'dus kyi ngo bo yin pas so// de nyid kyi phung po rgyal ba rigs lnga yin pas sangs rgyas kun 'dus/ thugs rgyud la bzhugs pa'i spangs rtogs kyi yon tan rnams chos/ phyi nang gi skye mched rnams sems dpa' sems ma'i ngo bo yin pas dge 'dun/ mkha' 'gro chos skyong rnams bka' nyan gsung bstod kyi tshul du gnas pas mkha' 'gro chos skyong yang tshang*/ de ltar shes par byas nas skyabs 'gro drug bskor bya ba'am/ bzhi bskor byed na/ dpal ldan bla ma zhes pa'i tshe sku la dmigs/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas zhes pa'i tshe thugs ka'i bam̐ yig dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo dang phung po lnga'i sangs rgyas rnams la dmigs/ dam pa'i chos rnams zhes pa'i tshe thugs ka'i sngags phreng dang sku'i rtsa 'khor yig 'bru rnams la dmigs/ 'phags pa'i dge 'dun zhes pa'i tshe skye mched kyi rtsa 'khor rnams la dmigs/

bsdu ba'i tshe bla ma'i sku las 'od zer sogs gong dang 'dra/ bla ma de yang yas gtsug tor nas mas seng khri nas rim gyis 'od du zhu nas snying kha'i thad du 'od rdza ma tsam cig bsam/ 'od de rang gi spyi gtsug nas thim pas lus ngag yid gsum bla ma'i sku gsung thugs dang dbyer med du bsams la mnyam bzhag bya/ de dag ni skyabs yul rgyas bsdus dmigs pa ngo sprod lugs dang bcas pa'o// gnyis pa skyabs su 'gro mkhan gyi gang zag ni/ rang nyid kyi g.yas su rtsa ba'i pha/ g.yon du rtsa ba'i ma/ mdun du dgra 'dre/ mtha' skor du rigs drug bar do dang bcas pa ston mo chen po la khrom tshogs pa lta bu khrig mer gang bar bsam/ gsum pa skyabs su 'gro ba'i tshul ni/ bla ma lam gyi 'dren pa/ sangs rgyas la lam gyi ston pa/ chos la lam dngos/ dge 'dun la lam gyi zla grogs zhu snyam pa'i sgo nas rang nyid kyis byang drangs nas thams cad kyang skyabs 'gro byed pa'i sgra di ri ri byed par bsam zhing*/ sems can thams cad kyi don du rang nyid dkon mchog gi go 'phang myur du thob pa zhig bla ma dkon mchog mkhyen snyam pas skyabs 'gro brgya rtsa stong rtsa sogs byed pa'i bar la kha tsam tshig tsam ma yin par snying khong rus pa'i gting nas khyed shes khyed mkhyen skyabs mgon re sa gzhan na med snyam du dkon mchog gsum la blo ling ste bkal ba'i go cha bgos te/ dper na khang pa'am brag gi phug la char skyob pa'i nus pa yod kyang yid gnyis the tshom byas nas der ma song na kha nas khang pa dang brag phug las brgyar bzlas kyang char pas brdung ba la mi phan pa bzhin no// des na skyabs yul rnams kyis rgyu 'bras kyi chos thams cad lag mthil du skyu ru ra bzhag pa ltar mkhyen pas na mkhyen pa'i spyan yang mnga'/ sems can thams cad la bu gcig pu shi ba ltar mi bzod pa'i thugs rje yod pas brtse ba yang mnga'/ mkhyen pa dang brtse ba yod kyang nus pa med na ma lag zha ma'i bu chus khyer ba bzhin skyob mi nus pa la rdzu 'phrul gyi nus pa yang tshad med pa mnga' bas bla ma dkon mchog gsum la yid gnyis dang the tshom spangs te sgo gsum 'jug pa rtse gcig tu dril te skyabs su song na phan yon bsam gyis mi khyab cing sdug bsngal rgyu bcas la skyob nus pa yin no// tshad med pa'i rnal 'byor dngos la ni sems bskyed tshad med rgyu 'bras su song ba dang*/

de gnyis ngo bo gcig tu song ba dang gnyis las/ dang po 'phags pa rin po che'i sgrub thabs su gsungs la/ phyi ma ni nā ro ta pa dang sa chen gyi gzhung du 'byung ba de bzhin bya gsungs pas so// gnyis pa sems bskyed ni smon 'jug gi go don spyi dang mthun zhing 'dir rnal 'byor bcu gcig gi nang tshan bzhi pa tshad med kyi rnal 'byor te/ sa skya pa chen pos/ bdag gis rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi go 'phang thob par byas la/ sems can thams cad srid pa'i sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho chen po las bsgral bar bya'o zhes bsam ste de la tshad med bzhi tshang ngo*// zhes gsungs pas/ rgyas pa gzhan ltar mi bsgom zhing bsdus pa 'di tsam la'ang tshad med bzhi tshang ba yin te/ sems can thams cad blo yul du byas pas btang snyoms tshad med/ srid pa 'khor ba sdug bsngal las bsgral zhes pa'i sems can thams cad la brtse ba mi bzod pa'i snying rje skye bas na snying rje tshad med/ snying rje'i 'chu ba byams pa ste// zhes gsungs pa ltar snying rje'i shugs las sdug bsngal bral 'dod kyi blo skye bas byams pa/ thams cad byang chub kyi bde ba la 'god snyam pa dga' ba tshad med do// zhes rje mus pas gsungs la/ zin bris la lar tshad med bzhi tshang tshul ni/ sems can thams cad la bu gcig pa ltar brtse ba ni byams pa tshad med pa/ 'di rnams sdug bsngal las bsgral rnal 'byor ma'i go 'phang la bkod snyam pa snying rje tshad med/ de la brten nas bdag rnal 'byor ma'i go 'phang thob pa la dga' snyam pa'i dga' ba tshad med/ rnal 'byor ma'i thugs rjes nye ring med par skyong ba btang snyoms tshad med yin zhes 'byung ngo*// gsum pa rdo rje sems dpa'i bsgom bzlas ni/ bla ma brgyud pa'i phyag len la/ ma rgyud pa rnams kyis a bhi dha nar bshad pa'i he ru ka'i yi ge brgya pa'i bsgom bzlas dang*/ pha rgyud pa rnams kyis de dang cha 'dra ba'i rdo rje sems dpa'i bsgom bzlas bya ba tshogs 'khor gsang ba kun rgyan las bshad pas/

'dir he ru ka'i yi ge brgya pa'i bsgom bzlas bya ba la rang nyid rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gsal ba'i spyi bor lha bsgom pa/ de'ang rdo rje sems dpa' che chung rang gi mtho tshad tsam bsgom pa bla ma rnams kyi gsung sgros yin gsungs/ sngags bzla ba/ bshags sdom bya ba rnams bsgom don mtha' dpyod dang bcas pa'i bshad pa rgyas par kun mkhyen chen pos mdzad pa'i kyai rdor man ngag lugs kyi rnam bshad sogs su shes par bya'o// de ltar sngon 'gro rnam gsum gyi sbyang gzhi sbyong byed ngo sprod pa ni/ de la skyabs 'gro'i sbyang gzhi yul mtho dman 'bring gsum/ skyabs mi 'os pa la skyabs su song ba/ blun po yi dwags la skyabs 'gro zhing*/ brtse med sdig can mi la'ang skyabs 'gro mod// de dag mkhas pa snying rje can rnams kyis// skyabs gnas ma yin snying rje'i yul nyid yin// zhes pa ltar skyabs gnas log pa la brten nas sdig pa bsags pa ji snyed dang so thar gyi nyes ltung thams cad yin/ sbyong byed skyabs 'gro'i rnal 'byor/ sbyangs 'bras dkon mchog gi go 'phang thob pa'o// sems bskyed kyi sbyang gzhi ni dug gsum gyis kun nas bslangs te sems can la gnod 'tshe nye ring chags sdang byas pa la sogs pa'i bag chags rtog snang dang bcas pa thams cad sbyong byed tshad med bzhi'i ngo bor bsgyur/ sbyangs 'bras rje btsun ma'i go 'phang thob pa'o// rdo rje sems dpa'i bsgom bzlas kyi sbyang gzhi/ dus gsum gyi lus ngag yid gsum gyi mi dge ba dang rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig nyams pa'i nyes ltung mtha' dag yin/ sbyong byed lha bsgom pa sngags bzlas pa sogs dang de'i ngo bo rang sems skad cig ma gcig la sdud/ sbyangs 'bras rdo rje sems dpa'i go 'phang thob pa'o// lnga pa bla ma'i rnal 'byor bsgom pa/ bsod nams gyi tshogs bsags pa maṇ+ḍal gyi khrid dang bcas pa ni/

gzhung las/ de nas rang gi bla ma bsgom par bya'o zhes gsungs pa/ nam mkhar rin po che'i khri la bla ma sku dar la babs pa'i cha lugs can rus pa'i rgyan drug dang ldan pa ḍā ma ru dang kha ṭ+wāṃ ga thod pa 'dzin par bsams la/ de bla ma dkon mchog gsum gyi rang bzhin yin snyam du dran zhing gus 'dud drag po bya'o zhes gsungs pas/ sa skya pa chen pos/ nam mkhar rin po che'i khri la bla ma sku dar la babs pa'i cha lugs can rus pa'i rgyan drug dang ldan pa ḍā ma ru dang kha ṭ+wāṃ ga thod pa 'dzin pa bsam/ de la bla ma dkon mchog gsum gyi rang bzhin yin snyam du dran zhing gus 'dud drag po bya'o// zhes gsungs pas/ bskyed rim gyi ting nge 'dzin skye ba la bsod nams kyi tshogs rgya chen po cig bsogs dgos pas/ de 'og ma rnams kyis rtogs rigs yar ldan pa'i tshogs rgya chen po cig bsags la tshogs bsags pa'i rten 'og ma rnams kyi rten gyi gang zag zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis pa 'dir zhal gcig phyag gnyis par sdud/ tshogs gsog pa'i yul bla ma gcig pur sdud/ gsog pa'i tshul phyag dang mchod pa byed pa rnams 'dir bla mar phur tshugs su gsol ba 'debs pa la sdud/ de'ang bla ma sangs rgyas rdo rje chos dang dpa' bo rdo rje chos gnyis nas/ phyi ma bsgom pa sa skya pa chen pos bshad cing de ltar du bsgom/ 'o na bla ma gcig pu la gsol ba 'debs pa tshogs gsag pa'i yul bzung ba'i rgyu mtshan ci yin snyam na/ rtsa rgyud las/ de nas sgrub pos dngos kun gyi// dang por slob dpon mnyes par bya// grub 'dod shin tu mnyam bzhag par// ci nus pa ni bla ma mchod// ces dang*/ sdom 'byung las/ bla ma sangs rgyas bla ma chos// bla ma dge 'dun de bzhin te// sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam sbyor ba'i// mkha' 'gro ma yi drwa ba sdom// sangs rgyas go 'phang 'dod pa yis// de phyir bla ma mnyes par bya// zhes dang*/

dril bu pas/ bla ma'i byin rlabs tsam gyis ni// skad cig nyid la 'byung gang yin// zhes dang*/ ha ri pas/ gang gi drin gyis bde chen nyid// skad cig nyid la thob 'gyur ba// bla ma rin chen lta bu yi// zhes dang*/ slob dpon klu sgrub kyis/ ri dbang rtse nas 'ga' zhig lhung gyur na// ltung bar mi 'gyur snyam yang ltung bar 'gyur// bla ma'i drin gyis phan pa'i lung thob na// grol bar mi 'gyur snyam yang grol bar 'gyur// zhes dang*/ mchod pa thams cad spangs nas ni// bla ma mchod par bya 'o zhes// de mnyes pas ni kun mkhyen gyis// ye shes mchog ni thob par 'gyur// zhes gsungs shing*/ gzhan yang mdo rgyud bstan bcos thams cad nas mchog thun mong gi dngos grub bsgrubs pa'i bla ma dam pa bsngags pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa cig gsung ngo*// bla ma'i rnal 'byor ci ltar bsgom pa'i tshul ni/ rdo rje sems dpa'i bsgom bzlas nyams su blang na/ rang sems dang rdor sems bsres pa'i stong nyid de'i ngang la rang rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gsal ba'i smin mtshams kyi thad kyi mdun gyi nam mkhar seṅges btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan gyi steng du rtsa ba'i bla ma dpa' bo rdo rje chos kyi rnam pa can bskyed cing gsol ba btab pa ni thun mong ba yin la/ thun mong ma yin pa ni sngar gyi gdan gyi steng du ngo bo rtsa ba'i bla ma rnam pa sangs rgyas rdo rje chos kyi rnam pa can sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyi g.yas rdo rje dang g.yon dril bu thugs kar bsnol nas 'dzin pa/ zhabs rdo rje skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ dbu skra ral pa'i thor cog can gzhon nu lo bcu drug lon pa lta bu'i na tshod dang ldan pa/ dar gyi na bza' dang rus pa'i rgyan drug rin po che'i phra tshom du ma yod pas brgyan pa/ 'od zer dpag med 'phro ba dang gsal ba rnyog pa med pa bdag la dges bzhin du bzhugs pa/

de'i mdun nas brtsams te g.yon skor du gdan de 'dra ba re re'i steng du sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang nas bzung ste rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bar du byon pa'i brgyud pa'i bla ma thams cad dpa' bo rdo rje chos kyi rnam pa can gyi mtha' skor du bzhugs par bsam pa'am/ yang na gtso bo dang 'dra bar bsgoms kyang chog yang na rnal 'byor pa rnams rnal 'byor pa'i cha lugs can dang*/ dge bsnyen rdo rje 'dzin pa rnams na bza' dkar po'i cha lugs can dang*/ dge tshul dang dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa rnams rab byung chos gos rnam gsum can du bsgoms kyang chog gsungs pas de rnams gang mos bya'o// de'i mthar g.yon skor gyis rim pa bzhin yi dam rgyud sde bzhi'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs dang*/ de'i mthar sangs rgyas byang sems nyan thos rang rgyal chos srung nor lha dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rnams rgyan cha lugs yongs su rdzogs pa rnam pa gsal ba sprin phung thib pa ltar bzhugs par bsam/ de thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos srung nor lha'i tshogs dang bcas pa spyan drangs par bsams la/ oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgya bya/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes brjod pas yul so so la rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos srung nor lha'i tshogs dang bcas pa cha tshang re re thim pas thams cad skyabs gnas kun 'dus kyi ngo bor gyur par bsam/ spyan drangs pa'i yul la kun snying gis de nyid 'dus pa'i 'grel pa snang chen du/ sangs rgyas kyi yul gnyis bshad pa'i dang por/ 'og min du longs sku chos sku dbyer med du bzhugs pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi yul gcig yin pa nas spyan drang ba dang*/

gnyis pa ni/ gdul bya sems can gang na gnas pa'i sa der sangs rgyas des don mdzad nas bzhugs pa ni sangs rgyas kyi yul rang bzhin gyi gnas zhes brjod de/ de spyan drangs na rang gang yod pa na sangs rgyas bzhugs kyang snang ba ma dag pas ma mthong ba yin pas rang gi snying ga'i 'od zer gyis ma dag pa bsal zhing sangs rgyas mngon sum du gzigs par bsam mo// zhes nyag bre yon tan 'od zer gyis bde mchog lū hi pa'i rnam bshad du 'byung ngo*// de nas blo snying brang gsum spyi bo'i mthil bzhi ling gis bkal te sems kyis rtse gcig tu skyid sdug legs nyes gang byung yang khyed rnams mkhyen snyam pas/ gang gi drin gyis bde chen nyid// ces sogs dang*/ 'di'i brgyud 'debs ni/ rdo rje 'chang dang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma// zhes sogs kyi gsol 'debs ngag nas 'don zhing mthor gtang dmar gtang khyed shes khyed mkhyen snyam pa'i gsol ba drag tu 'debs/ de nas rang nyid la chags pa skye ba'i yul yid du 'ong ba'i dngos po khang zhing zas nor longs spyod gnyen bshes la sogs pa nye bar mkho ba'i dngos po thams cad bla ma la phul bas/ bla mas bdag gir mdzad pas chags pa'i rnam rtog thams cad rang grol du song bar bsam/ de bzhin du zhe sdang skye pa'i yul gnod byed dgra 'dre dang mi dang mi ma yin pa'i dgra 'dre byur gsum thams cad bla ma la phul bas bla mas bdag gir mdzad pas zhe sdang gi rnam rtog thams cad rang grol du song bar bsam/ yang gti mug skye ba'i yul phan gnod gang yang med pa'i btang snyoms pa bar ma'i 'gro ba rnams bla ma la phul bas bla mas bdag gir mdzad nas gti mug gi rnam rtog thams cad rang grol du song bar bsam/ de nas ku sā li'i tshogs gsog ni/ rang rnal 'byor mar gsal ba'i snying gar sems nyid kyi ngo bo'i bam̐ yig de nyid rnal 'byor ma mtshon gang ba gcig tu gyur te/

dbu ma'i lam nas yar song spyi bo tshangs pa'i bu ga rgya mthongs kha bye ba lta bu nas 'thon/ mdun gyi rtsa ba'i bla ma dang zhal sbyor du bzhugs pa'i phan tshun gyi rgyud la bde chen ye shes skye bar bsam/ rang sems kyi rnal 'byor ma des slar phyi mig bltas pas rang gi phung po che la snum pa tsho bar 'dug pa gzigs nas/ sngar lus 'di lta bu ji snyed cig blangs pa don med du song 'dug da lan don can du bya'o snyam pa'i phung po'i sar byon te/ gri gug gis smin mtshams rna ba ltag pa rnams su reg tsam re byas pas thod pa de bog yong la khad song ba phyag gis blangs te rang bzhin gyis grub pa'i rlung dkyil me dkyil thod pa'i sgyed pu gsum gyi steng du bzhag de yang phyi dkar la nang dmar ba stong gsum gyi khyon dang mnyam par bsam/ lag na yod pa'i gri gug gis rkang pa g.yon pa dum bu gsum du gtubs nas thod pa'i nang du bskyur/ de bzhin du rkang pa g.yas lag pa gnyis nang khrol don snying rnams dang mgo bo'i lhag ma yang bskyur bas sha'i ri bo khrag gi rgya mtsho rus pa'i gram 'khrul dang bcas pas gang ba'i thod par bsam/ 'og nas me rang 'bar byung bas de rnams khol zhing lud pas zag med kyi bdud rtsi kha dog dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa dri zhim pa ro mngar ba reg bya bsil ba/ nus pas shi nas zhag bdun song ba yang sos nus pa'i bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur par bsams la/ rang rnal 'byor mar gsal bas mkha' 'gro spyi gtor ltar byin rlabs bya ba'am/ yang na 'bru gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs nas/ rang gi snying ga nas rang 'dra ba'i rnal 'byor ma g.yas thod pa chung ba dang g.yon che ba 'dzin pa dpag med spros mdun gyi bdud rtsi nas g.yas kyis bcus g.yon du blugs te mdun gyi gtso bo rtsa ba'i bla ma la mchod pas zhal du lan gsum gsol bas ljags rdo rje'i 'od kyi sbu gu can gyis gsol te thugs rgyud zag med kyi bde bas gang ba bdag la shin tu mnyes pas mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub thams cad da lta nyid du stsol ba'i bdag nyid can du bsam zhing*/

drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ slar mchod pa'i lha mo rang la bsdu/ yang snying ga nas mchod pa'i lha mo spros/ thod pas bdud rtsi bcus te brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams kyi zhal du phul bas zag med kyi bde bas thugs rgyud gang bdag la shin tu mnyes nas bde chen lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes da lta nyid du stsol ba'i bdag nyid can du bsam/ lha mo rnams tshur 'dus nas rang la thim/ yang snying ga nas lha mo spros/ thod pas bdud rtsi bcus te yi dam lha tshogs sangs rgyas byang sems nyan thos rang rgyal dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos srung nor lha rnams sprin phung 'thibs pa bzhin bzhugs pa rnams kyi zhal du phul bas/ de thams cad kyi thugs rgyud zag med kyi bde bas gang mchog thun mong gi dngos grub stsol bar bsam/ lha mo rnams tshur bsdus/ yang snying kha nas lha mo spros/ dpal mgon bdun cu rtsa lnga rnams yi dam gyi lhar gsal ba la mchod/ chos bsgrub pa'i grogs mdzad par bsam/ lha mo bsdus/ yang snying kha nas lha mo spros/ thod pas bdud rtsi bcus te gnas bdag gzhi bdag rnams la phul bas zag med kyi bde bas rgyud gang zhing rnal 'byor ma'i skur gyur nas bdag gis byang chub bsgrub pa'i grogs byed par bsam/ lha mo bsdus/ yang spros te rigs drug bar do dang bcas pa'i sems can thams cad la sbyin pas thams cad kyi bu lon sha 'khon sbyangs zag med kyi bde bas rgyud gang sems rtog med chos sku dang*/ lus zag med bde chen rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i skur gyur nas rang rang so so'i gnas dag pa'i zhing du sems can gzhan gyi don gyi phyir du bya khyu 'phur ba ltar song bar bsam/ mchod pa'i lha mo rnams rang la bsdu/ de ltar mchod pa'i lha mo spro bsdu gang yi dam nas nor lha'i bar la yang gong 'og gi rigs 'gre shes par bya'o// spyir bla ma'i bskyed chog kun 'dus nor bu lugs su bsgom pa na 'di'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor bsdus pa'i skabs so// khrom tshogs su bsgom pa ni 'dir bkod pa 'di'o// mtho brtsegs su bsgoms kyang chog go

/maṇ+ḍal phul ba ni/ tshom bu bdun ma gtso bor 'bul zhing skabs skabs so bdun ma yang 'bul/ thun 'jog khar shes na/ gang gi mchod rdzas ma dang*/ thos pa rgya mtsho ma yang bya/ 'dir bsgrub pa'i maṇ+ḍal tshom bu lnga bkod pa'ang yig rnying na 'dug cing mchod pa dang 'dod don gsol btab dang*/ yan lag bdun pa dang phyogs bcu'i dus gsum la sogs lam 'bras ltar bya ba nyid do// de nas skyabs yul rnams mtha' nas rim gyis 'od du zhu ste gtso bo la thim pas skyabs gnas kun 'dus kyi ngo bor bsams la/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo bla ma rin po che la gsol ba 'debs so// bdag la dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ bla ma'i dpral ba'i oṃ las 'od zer dkar po byung rang gi dpral bar thim pas lus kyi sgo nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad dag bum pa'i dbang thob/ bla ma'i sku'i byin rlabs ma lus pa zhugs par bsam/ mgrin pa'i āḥlas 'od zer dmar po byung mgrin par thim/ ngag gi sgrib pa dag gsang ba'i dbang thob/ gsung gi byin rlabs zhugs/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer sngon po byung snying khar thim/ sems kyi sgrib pa dag shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ thugs kyi byin rlabs zhugs/ yang yi ge gsum las 'od zer sna tshogs byung rang gi gnas gsum du thim/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi sgrib pa bag chags dang bcas pa dag dbang bzhi thob par bsam/ de nas dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo bla ma rin po che la phyag 'tshal lo skyabs su mchi'o// bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol// zhes gsol ba btab pas/ bla ma de yang yas gtsug tor dang mas gdan khri nas rim gyis 'od du zhu nas thugs ka'i thad du 'od dmar po bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin du gyur pa rdza ma tsam zhig bsam/ de yang rang gi spyi bo nas mar thim/ snying khar bde hril gyis byung nas bam̐ yig la thim/

bam̐ yig je cher song nas sngags phreng rnams kyang bam̐ yig tu song*/ de nas zla ba chos 'byung lus kyi nang gnas khang sogs nas mthar stong gsum gyi 'jig rten gyi khams nam mkha'i khams thams cad kyang bam̐ yig tu song ba la sems gtad nas ji tsam gnas kyi bar lhod kyis 'jog bam̐ yig kyang nam mkha' la 'ja' yal ba ltar song nas dmigs med stong nyid kyi ngang la lhod de 'jog bla ma'i rnal 'byor maṇ+ḍal dang bcas pa 'di bsags sbyong sogs skabs 'ga' zhig tu zur du nyams su len na'ang skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sngon du btang nas mdun gyi nam mkhar seṅges btegs pa'i sogs nas 'di'i bar nyams su blangs/ de nas thos pa rgya mtsho ma dang*/ skye ba kun tu sogs bya'o// de ltar thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon 'gro tshogs gnyis bsags pa'i sbyang gzhi sbyong byed ngo sprad pa ni/ bsod nams tshogs bsag ni 'dir bla ma'i rnal 'byor yin pa de'i sbyang gzhi skye ba'i srid pa dang skye ba snga ma rnams su yul dag pa lha dang bla ma nas yul ma dag pa 'jag ma'i srin bu'i bar yan chad la brten nas las bzang ngan ji snyed bsags pa sbyong byed bla ma'i rnal 'byor la bsten nas tshogs bsags pa'o// sbyangs 'bras rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang thob pa'o// sangs rgyas thob pa la sems nyid lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes rtogs dgos la/ de rtogs pa la yang bla ma dam pa'i man ngag dang thabs bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags pa la brten dgos te/ kye rdor rtsa rgyud las/ gzhan gyis brjod min lhan cig skyes// gang du yang ni mi rnyed de// bla ma'i dus thabs bstan pa dang*// bdag gi bsod nams las shes bya// zhes dang*/ sdud pa las/ ji srid dge ba'i rtsa ba de ni ma rdzogs par// de srid stong nyid dam pa de ni rtogs mi 'gyur// zhes so// bsod nams kyi tshogs rdzogs par byed pa'i thabs yang bla ma'i rnal 'byor las lhag pa med de/

mtshan dang dpe byad ldan pa yi// sku ni bskal par bsgom pa bas// bla ma dran pa bsod nams che'o// phan yon che'o// zhes pa la sogs pa mdo rgyud thams cad las mthun par gsungs so// 'o na bla ma dang sangs rgyas gnyis kyi nang nas bla ma yul lhag pa ci yin snyam na/ de gnyis spangs rtogs la khyad par med mod/ rang nyid la sangs rgyas kyi sku dngos su snang ba dang*/ gsung dngos su thob pa'i skal ba ma byung ba la/ rang dang skal ba mnyam pa'i bla ma'i skur bzhengs nas chos dngos su ston par mdzad pas na/ bka' drin gyi sgo nas bla ma lhag pa yin no// ngo bo rtsa ba'i bla ma bsgoms pas byin rlabs myur zhing rnam pa sangs rgyas su bsgoms pas byin rlabs che ba yin te/ so so skye bo tha mal pa'i sku lus de nyid gzhi'i rten yin pas/ de la dag bya dag byed sbyar du med pas na nges par rnam pa sangs rgyas su sgom par byed/ de yang lhag pa'i lha gang yang rung ba'i rnam par bsgom pa yod kyang 'dir bla ma'i gsung gis slob ma'i shes rgyud la phan 'dogs pa'i rten 'brel du gsungs/ dpa' bo rje btsun rdo rje chos kyi rnam pa can du sgom par byed pa dang*/ 'dir thun mong ma yin pa sangs rgyas rdo rje chos su bsgoms pa ste lugs gnyis las/ 'dir gzhung gi dngos bstan dpa' bo rdo rje chos su bsgom pa ste/ sku mdog dmar po ni bla ma'i thugs slob ma la rjes su chags pa mtshon/ phyag g.yas pas thod pa'i ḍā ma ru rgyun mi 'chad par 'khrol ba'i bde stong gnyis su med pa'i chos sgra sgrogs pa/ g.yon pas thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba bsnams pa de lta bu'i lam de nyid du nyams su blangs pas bdag rgyud la bde chen gyi ye shes skye ba mtshon pa yin/ zhes gsung ngo*// de dag kyang sngar nas las bsags pa'i tshul/ gsog pa po'i gang zag bsags pa'i las rnams ji ltar du gsog pa'i tshul gsum du bsgyur nas nyams su len/

ye shes kyi tshogs bsags bla ma 'od du zhu nas rang la bstim pa'i rkyen gyis lus sems rnams bde chen gyi ye shes su byin gyis brlabs shing gnas lugs de kho na nyid la blo bzhag pa'o// de'i sbyang gzhi bdag gzhan gyi 'chi srid do// sbyangs 'bras chos sku thob pa'o// de ltar thun mong gi sngon 'gro skyabs 'gro sems bskyed rdo rje sems dpa'i bsgom bzlas/ thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon 'gro bla ma'i rnal 'byor maṇ+ḍal 'bul zhing gsol ba btab pa rnams rtags ma byung bar du 'bad nas nyams su blang bar bya zhing*/ de la rtags ni/ skyabs 'gro rgyud la skyes na blo chos su 'gro zhing*/ blo sna dkon mchog gis 'phrogs nas srog dang bya dga'i phyir yang dkon mchog blos mi gtong ba sogs dang*/ sems bskyed rgyud la skyes na/ sems can thams cad la bcos min gyi byams snying rje bsran mi bzod pa skye ba sogs dang*/ rdo rje sems dpa'i bsgom bzlas la 'bad pas sdig pa dag pa'i rtags rmi lam du lus la rnag khrag 'dzag pa dang*/ 'bu srin 'thon pa dang*/ khrus byas pa dang*/ 'phur ba dang*/ gyen la 'dzegs pa rnams byung na legs shing*/ gzhan gyis mtshon cha bsnun nas khrag byung ba dang*/ rab byung gi rten la skra ring dang gos dkar po gyon pa dang*/ zhing rmo ba'i thang mkhan byed pa dang*/ mnyan pa byed pa rnams ngan ngan 'dra yang bzang ba yin/ rol mo'i sgra sgrogs pa dang*/ gdugs dang rgyal mtshan ba dan 'phyang ba rnams grags che ba'i rtags/ zhwa theb dkar dmar sngo ser gsar pa gyon pa dang*/ chos 'chad pa dang*/ mang pos bkur ba dang*/ gdan khri mthon po'i steng du 'dzegs pa rnams gzhan don 'byung ba'i rtags la sogs pa'o// maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba'i bsod nams kyi tshogs 'phel ba'i rtags/ khri stan mthon po la 'dug pa dang*/ gzhan gyis rdzas stobs chen 'bul ba rmi ba sogs dang bla ma la sangs rgyas dngos kyi 'du shes bcos min skye ba sogs mdor na lus sems las su rung ba'i shin sbyang dang ldan pa zhig ma byung gi bar du sngon 'gro'i chos rnams la 'bad par bya ste/

'di rnams rgyud la ma skyes na dngos po'i ting nge 'dzin mi skye bas so// drug pa bdag lhar bskyed pa ni/ gzhung las/ de'i rjes la snying khar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bsams la der oṃ sarba bud+dha ḍā ki ni ye badz+ra war+ṇa nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes bya ba'i sngags kyi phreng ba kha dog dmar po/ de las 'od zer sna tshogs 'phro ba lugs las bzlog par bsam mo// dbus su bam̐ yig go /de'i 'od zer gyis las thams cad khyab pas/ yongs su dag pa nas/ zhes gsungs pa las/ sa skya pa chen pos/ rang gi snying khar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bam̐ yig dmar po/ de'i mtha' mar sngags kyi phreng ba kha dog dmar po g.yon skor du bkod la/ de las 'od zer byung ba'i lus kyi nang thams cad 'od kyis gang ste/ des lus ngag yid gsum gyi sdig sgrib thams cad dag pas lus shel sgong dag pa bzhin du gyur pa las/ rje btsun ma'i sku gzhung nas 'byung ba bzhin bskyed la gsal gdab bo zhes gsungs pas/ gzhi sbyang zhing bsgyur bar bya ste/ de la sbyang rgyu'i gzhi ni rang gi sems nyid gnyis su med pa'i ye shes/ chos sku skye med zung 'jug brjod bral de kho na nyid chos thams cad kyi gnas lugs su gyur pa'i spros bral stong pa nyid 'di'i steng na phung khams skye mched la sogs pa 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad sems la bag chags kyis tshang*/ lus la rtsa yi ge'i tshul du dod/ de'i stobs kyis phyi rol du gnas snod kyi 'jig rten bcud kyi sems can bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig 'char ba yin te/ de yang 'od gsal de bag chags kyis bslad pa la brten nas ma rig pa langs/ nyon mongs pa gti mug gi/ de las 'dod chags/ de las zhe sdang*/ de las nga rgyal dang ser sna langs te bar do'i snang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig 'char la/ de nas gang du skye ba len pa'i gnas bzhi/ skye ba blang ba'i gnas kyi 'jig rten/

skye ba blangs pa'i bcud kyi sems can la'ang dmyal ba la sogs pa 'gro ba rigs drug rigs drug po de'i lus sems la bde sdug 'dod mi 'dod bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig shar ba rnams nang gi rten dkyil 'khor bzhi'i stobs kyis shar ba yin te/ phyi rol du gzugs sdug mi sdug ji snyed yod pa rnams nang rtsa'i stobs kyis shar cing*/ phyi ru sgra snyan mi snyan gyi bye brag bsam gyis mi khyab pa rnams nang gi yi ge'i stobs kyis shar la/ phyi rol du tshor ba bde sdug btang snyoms la sogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa rnams nang bdud rtsi'i stobs kyis shar ba yin la/ phyi rol du rnam rtog bsam gyis mi khyab pa rnams nang rlung gi stobs kyis shar ba yin la/ ye shes thig le las/ stong pa la ni thams cad 'byung*// zhes dang*/ sdom 'byung las/ rnam pa sna tshogs dri med pa'i// dkyil 'khor dag ni 'phro bar snang*// zhes gsungs/ des na phyi rol du shar tshad nang na gnas/ nang na gnas tshad phyi rol du shar ba yin te/ ye shes thig le las/ phyi dang phyi'i don rnams nang gi don gnas shes par bya'o// zhes dang*/ bde mchog rtsa rgyud las/ 'jig rten phyi rol de bzhin gnas// zhes dang*/ kye rdor rtsa rgyud las/ ji ltar phyi rol de bzhin nang*// zhes gsungs so// des na phyi rol du snang tshad nang gi rten dkyil 'khor bzhi la tshang ba yin no// de'ang dang por rtsa dbu ma/ de las ro rkyang gnyis/ de las sbas pa'i rtsa lnga/ de las nyi shu rtsa lnga/ de las sum cu rtsa bdun/ de las bsam gyis mi khyab pa gyes pa rnams dang bdud rtsi yang dang por dwangs ma/ de las khu khrag gnyis de las khams bsam gyis mi khyab pa rnams dang*/ rlung yang dang por gnas pa/ de las ldang 'jug gnyis/ de las rtsa ba'i rlung lnga/ de las rlung bcu/ de las nyi khri chig stong bsam gyis mi khyab pas so// rten dkyil 'khor bzhi po de'i stobs kyis phyi rol snod bcud kyi snang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang bcas pa thams cad sems nyid kyi rnam 'phrul yin pas de dag blo'i yul du nges par bya ba ni rgya che ba'i sbyang gzhi yin la/

nang rtsa gsum 'khor lo lnga ni zab pa'i sbyang gzhi/ sems nyid lhan cig skyes pa ni mthar thug gi sbyang gzhi yin la/ sbyong byed ni lha rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dbye na rang sems spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral ba ni gsang ba'i rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ lte ba'i rtsa mdud gru gsum gyi nang ma las thob pa'i dwangs ma gnyis dwangs sum dwangs kyi dwangs ma khrig mer te gang ba'i a thung shad kyi rnam pa can nam chos 'di ba'i thun mong ma yin pa'i bam̐ yig gi rnam pa can nang gi rnal 'byor ma/ phyi rol 'og min na bzhugs pa'i rje btsun ma ni lhan cig skyes kyi rnal 'byor ma/ yul nyer bzhi dang gnas sum cu rtsa bdun na bzhugs pa'i sprul pa'i dpa' bo dang dpa' mo rnams zhing las skyes pa'i rnal 'byor ma/ ma mkha' 'gro ma yin pa'i rigs su skyes pa rnams ni las las skyes pa/ yul dang yul gru thams cad na gnas pa'i bud med thams cad ni las las skyes pa'i rnal 'byor ma/ rang nyid rnal 'byor mar bsgom pa ni sngags las skyes pa'i rnal 'byor ma'o// de ltar na rang gi sems nyid ye gdod ma nas rdo rje rnal 'byor ma yin pa de bla mas byin gyis brlabs pa'i dus su yin par ngo sprad rang nyid kyis kyang yin par ngo shes nas/ de'i rgyu mtshan sbyong ba bskyed rdzogs kyi nyams len byas pas pha rol gyi dpa' bo dang dpa' mo rnams dbang du 'dus/ de rnams dbang du 'dus pas 'og min gyi rdo rje rnal 'byor mar byin gyis brlabs/ des byin gyis brlabs pa rang sems lhan skyes kyi rtogs pa 'char bas de ni byin rlabs yas rlobs dang rtogs pa mas 'char zhes pa'i don to// tshul ji ltar sbyang na blo yul du nges pa'i sbyang gzhi de dag bla ma 'od du zhu ba'i rkyen gyis bde chen gyi ye shes su bsgyur/ mngon par byang chub lnga ni/ rang nyid rdo rje rnal 'byor ma bsgoms pa'i snying chos 'byung nyis brtsegs stong par bsgom pa ni stong nyid las byang chub pa/

de'i dbus su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bsgom pa ni gdan zla ba las byang chub pa/ de'i steng du bam̐ yig sngags phreng dang bcas pa bsgom pa ni gsung yig 'bru las byang chub pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas lus kyi nang thams cad gang bas tshe thog med nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad bsregs lus 'od kyi gong bu gri gug gi dbyibs su gyur pa ni thugs phyag mtshan las byang chub pa/ de nyid rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i skur gyur pa ni sku rdzogs pa las byang chub pa ste/ mngon par byang chub pa lnga las bskyed pa'o// stong nyid de'i ngang nas rang rnal 'byor mar gsal ba'i snying gar gnas lugs rtogs pa'i shes rab mtshon pas e byu ru'i mdog can nyis brtsegs yongs su gyur pa las chos sku rnam par thar pa'i sgo gsum gyi rang bzhin chos 'byung nyis brtsegs te bka' brgyud pa sogs chos 'byung phyi ma gsang thabs/ de'i steng du chos 'byung nang ma langs stabs su bsgom par 'dod kyang rang lugs chos 'byung phyi ma de dwangs gsal 'od kyi rang bzhin can rnyog pa med pa ltar bsgom/ rtse mo mdun la bstan pa zur gnyis sdeb la bstan pa/ rtsa ba phra ba gsang gnas su zug pa/ gdengs ka che ba gyen la bstan pa/ chos 'byung nang ma zur gsum phyi la bstan/ zhes mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags gsung la/ dpe la lar chos 'byung gnyis brtsegs kyi phyi ma'i zur sgal tshigs la bstan pa/ zur gnyis po nu ma gnyis kyi thad du bstan pa/ nang ma'i zur mdun la bstan pa/ zur gnyis sog pa gnyis kyi thad du bstan/ de gnyis ka'i mas sna gsang gnas su zug pa/ zhes 'byung ba'i gang zag dpyod 'dir chos 'byung phyi mas snod kyi 'jig rten sbyangs/ nang mas ma'i mngal sbyangs gsungs/ chos 'byung nang ma'i kha mtshams 'phel ka bye ba'i thad du mnyam bzhag gi rnam par mi rtog pa'i ting nge 'dzin de rjes thob dag pa 'jig rten pa'i ye shes mtshon pa'i phyir zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dkar bsil nya gang ba/

de'i dbus su bam̐ yig gi mthar g.yon skor du sngags kha dog dmar po gyen du langs pa/ de yang bam̐ yig gi mdun du oṃ oṃ oṃ/ de'i 'khris su sarba log pa rbas/ de'i 'khris su bud+dha log pa d+dhabu/ de'i 'khris su kī ḍa/ de'i 'khris su ye nī/ de'i 'khris su dz+rab/ de'i 'khris su r+ṇawa/ de'i 'khris su ye nī/ de'i 'khris su dz+rab/ de'i 'khris su ro bai/ de'i 'khris su ye nī tsa/ de'i 'khris su hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ dang ṭapha ṭapha ṭapha/ de'i 'khris su hā swā// oṃ dang po'i rtsa bar sleb pa chos 'byung gi mdun rgyab spangs pa'i grwa bzhir dga' ba 'khyil pa kha dog dkar po g.yon du 'khor ba re re bsam/ 'di ni sbyang gzhi bar do'i srid pa sbyang ba byed pa yin no// sbyong byed de dag thams cad 'byung bzhi rang gi sems nyid mtshon pa'i phyir rang gi sems sam/ sdud byed kyi gtso bo las rnal 'byor ma so bdun 'byung ba mtshon pa'i phyir de'i mthar yi ge so bdun g.yon skor du 'khor ba/ 'o na rgyud dang rgya gzhung du oṃ gcig las ma bshad pas/ 'dir gsum 'byung ba ji ltar yin snyam na/ mi dbang chos gsum du grags pa'i mi'i dbang po in+d+ra bhu ti'i bshad pa rje btsun gyis shes byed du mdzad de/ gang du rdo rje phag mo'i rtsa ba'i las ma tshang ba rnams 'dis kha bskang bar bya'o// zhes gsungs/ de dag kyang rten dkyil 'khor bzhi la gnad du bsnun pa yin te/ rtsa bsam gyis mi khyab pa chos 'byung du sdud/ yi ge bsam gyis mi khyab pa rnams yig 'brur sdud/ khams bsam gyis mi khyab pa rnams zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ rlung bsam gyis mi khyab pa rnams dga' ba 'khyil bar sdud/ 'dus pa pho brang bzhi la'ang gnad du bsnun pa yi ge gong du brjod zin to// 'dir zla ba la dmar mdangs yod pa nyi zlas khu khrag yig 'bru rnams kyis bar do'i sems can thams cad bsdams mngal skyes sbyangs/

nyi zlas drod gsher skyes/ de thams cad gcig tu 'dres pas sgong skyes/ de rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gyur pas rdzus skyes sbyangs/ des na gzhi sbyang ba'i gzhi de dag nges par byas nas/ bsgyur ba'i tshul ni zla ba bam̐ yig yig 'bru dang bcas pa rnams las 'od zer kha dog sna lnga 'ja' tshon lta bu bun gyis 'phros/ 'khor 'das thams cad tshang ba'i rang gi lus sems la phog pas tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i nad gdon sdig sgrib nyes ltung bag chags dang bcas pa rnam smin gdos bcas sha khrag gis bsdus pa'i phung khams skye mched thams cad bsregs sbyangs pas rang gi lus shel sgong dag pa ltar 'od kyi gong bur gyur par bsgom pa ni gzhi sbyangs pa'o// de nas bsgyur ba ni/ gzhung las bdag nyid bcom ldan 'das ma rdo rje phag mo'i sku zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ sku mdog dmar mo bskal pa'i me lta bu'i gzi brjid can/ phyag rgya lngas rgyan dang ldan pa/ sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan la 'jigs byed dus mtshan mnan pa/ phyag g.yas na rdo rje dang gri gug g.yon na thod pa dang kha ṭ+wāṃ ga 'dzin pa'o// zhes gsungs pa'o// de yang 'od kyi gong bu de las skad cig gis rten dang brten par bcas pa wal gyis bskyed nas gsal btab cing dag bya dag byed ngo sprod pa ni/ ma dag pa snod kyi 'jig rten/ dag pa mtshon byed/ chos 'byung nyis brtsegs bsgom pa dngos su med kyang bsgom don la ma chad pa gal che'o// zhes mus chen bud+dha'i mtshan can gyis gsungs pa'o// spro na de'i phyi rol du'ang rdo rje'i sa gzhi dur khrod brgyad/ de'i phyi rol rdo rje'i gur dang bcas pa bde kyai dang mthun la/ de'i phyi rol rwa ba gru bzhi pa 'greng bur gyur pa/ gur las dpangs cung zad dma' ba/ de'i kha khyer gyis mdun rgyab 'thab ra lta bus bskor ba'i nang du sgo mtshams ma brgyad/ shar gyi g.yas su steng gi khro mo/

nub kyi g.yon du 'og gi khro mo rnams gsal btab/ de'i phyi rol du me'i 'obs gru bzhi pa cha chen gcig dpangs cha chen phyed 'tshub cing tsha ba/ de'i steng gi bar snang la mda'i drwa ba mde'u'i rtse dang ltag pa rnams sbrel ba mde'u rtse phyir bstan pa gur gyi dpangs dang mnyam pa/ de dang 'obs kyi phyi rol du ye shes kyi me kha dog lnga g.yon skor du 'bar ba me'i rtse mo shin tu mtho ba rab tu tsha bar bsam/ kha khyer gyi sgo mtshams ma rnams la de 'dra ba dpag med spros/ gnod byed thams cad bkug 'obs kyi phyi'i mthar bkod/ slar yang khro mo de rnams las stod khro bo bcu'i rnam pa smad phur bu'i rnam pa can dpag med spros/ gnod byed rnams kyi spyi bo nas rkang mthil gyi bar bkas pho g.yon mo g.yas yin/ de ltar byas pa thams cad kyis rnam shes chos dbyings su bsgral sha rus rnams 'obs nang du 'phang khro bo khro mo rnams rang la bstim/ chos 'byung gi nang du sna tshogs pad+ma yu ba khru gang ba steng 'og gi pad 'dab bcu drug ze'u 'bru la cha chen gcig 'dab ma rnams la cha chen phyed phyed 'og gi 'dab ma rnams thur du 'byung nas yu ba la bkab pa'i tshul du yod par bsam/ zhes zin bris las 'byung ngo*// 'di nyid lam bsdus pa'i skabs yin pas srung 'khor 'di nyid med kyang 'gal ba cher med la/ 'di ltar byung na shin tu legs la srung 'khor gzhal yas khang med pa'i lha dpa' bo gcig pa la snod kyi 'jig rten sbyong byed gdan yin par mngon rtogs ljon shing las gsungs so// 'dir ni spros pa la dga' zhing rgyas pa'i dbang du byas so// gang ltar yang rgya gzhung gi phag mo'i sgrub thabs 'gar yang srung 'khor chos 'byung sogs snang ngo*// bsdus pa ltar na kha ṭ+wāṃ ga la bde mchog gi rten dang brten pa tshang ngo*// rgyas pa 'og tu 'chad do// mtshon don rnams dag bya dag byed ngo sprad pa ni/

pad+ma 'dam las skyes kyang 'dam gyi dri mas ma gos pa zhes 'byung ba ltar sgrub pa po 'khor bar gnas kyang 'khor ba'i skyon gyis ma gos pa'i brdar sna tshogs pad+ma/ de'ang sangs rgyas sems can gyi bcud las skyes kyang nyon mongs pa'i dri mas ma gos pa zhes bya ba ltar ro// pad+ma'i ze'u 'bru'i steng du rang bzhin gyi 'od gsal ba mtshon pa dang*/ byang chub sems kyi myu gu 'phel zhing smin pa'i rtags su nyi ma/ yang na thabs snying rje mtshon pas pad+ma/ gnas lugs rtogs pa'i shes rab mtshon pas nyi ma'o// de'i steng du 'jigs byed nag po g.yas ḍā ma ru dang gri gug g.yon thod pa dang kha ṭ+wāṃ ga bzung ba mgo bo g.yon phyogs su bstan pa zhe sdang phrag dog skye ba'i gzung 'dzin skyed byed kyi gnas yin pas mgo bo snying kha'i thad du rgyab tu bltabs nas dpral ba nas jir mnan pa/ de yang snying kha zhe sdang skye ba'i gnas dang dpral ba phrag dog skye ba'i gnas yin pas de nyid zhabs g.yon pas mnan pa'o// zhabs g.yas pas dus mtshan ma dmar mo gri gug dang thod pa bzung ba 'dod chags skye ba'i gnas nu ma'i steng nas mgo bo g.yas su bstan pa'o// de yang nges brjod las/ 'jigs byed dang ni dus mtshan dag /chags pa zhe sdang zhabs kyis mnan// zhes gsungs/ de yang ji ltar zhe na/ zhabs g.yon 'dod chags rnam par dag pas zhe sdang gi ngo bo 'jigs byed dang*/ g.yas pas zhe sdang rnam par dag pas 'dod chags kyi ngo bo dus mtshan mnan pa'o// 'di ma shi ba yin pa jo bo rjes bshad gsungs so// des na dbang phyug la sogs pa 'jig rten pa'i chen po rnams 'dul ba mtshon pa'o// de gnyis kyi steng du rang nyid rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dmigs pa med pa'i snying rje chen pos sems can la rjes su chags pa mtshon pa'i brdar sku mdog pad+ma rā ga ltar dmar zhing gdug pa can tshar gcod pas ba spu'i bu ga thams cad nas 'od zer dmar po 'phro zhing bskal pa'i me ltar drag cing gzi brjid 'bar ba ste/

a bhi dha na las/ de nas gzhan yang bshad bya ba// phag mo yi ni sgrub pa mchog /bsgom pa'i bdag nyid bsgom par bya// sku ni nyi ma brgya yi gzi// sku mdog gzi brjid dang mtshungs pa// me tog bad+dhu ka lta bu// zhes gsungs so// nyon mongs pa'i sgrib g.yogs dang bral ba mtshon pas sku gcer bu/ chos thams cad de bzhin nyid du ro gcig pa'i brdar zhal gcig bden pa gnyis thugs su chud pa'i brdar phyag gnyis ma/ nga rgyal la sogs 'khor ba'i skyon thams cad gcod pa'i brdar phyag g.yas pas rdo rje gri gug ni/ spyir rdo rje zhes bya ba tsam gyi dbang du byas na/ chos nyid kyi rdo rje/ mtshan pa'i rdo rje/ thabs sam gsang ba'i rdo rje/ rdzas kyi rdo rje ste bzhi'o// dang po ni/ mtshan rtog 'joms pa'i ye shes stong nyid rdo rje ste gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i lam gyi snying po'o// rdo rjes mtshon don de ltar yin la/ 'dir ni de lta bu'i rdo rje phyed pas yu ba byas pa'i gri gug sor brgyad dam bcu gnyis pa gug pa'i phyogs su rtse mo cung zad gug pa rdo rjes mtshan pa'i gri gug thur du brkyangs nas 'og 'khor ba'i phyogs la 'jol thabs su bsnams pa ni bdag tu 'dzin pa'i dgra bo rang gis gnod cing gzhan gcod par mtshon/ de yang gzhung las/ rdo rje dang gri gug ces gsungs kyang*/ phyag len la ye shes lngar mtshon pa'i brdar rdo rje rtse lnga pa phyed pas mtshan pa'i gri gug mdzad do// bde chen gyi ye shes mkha' spyod kyi go 'phang brnyes pa'i brdar g.yon pa zla ba ltar dkar ba'i thod pa bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin khrag gis gang ba steng gi phyogs su bzung ste zhal gyen du phyogs pas rgyun mi 'chad par gsol ba/ rang nyid shes rab ma yin pa'i brdar zhal g.yon du phyogs pa/ thabs he ru ka dang mi 'bral ba'i brdar phrag pa g.yon pa kha ṭ+wāṃ ga ni/ kha zhes pa nam mkha' yin la/

ṭ+wāṃ ga zhes pa keng rus sam dbyug to ste nam mkha'i dbyug pa zhes pa gzhi lam 'bras bu chos thams cad mtshon pas lus tshad dang mnyam pa mdor na 'khor lo bde mchog gi gsang ba gsum gyi zab gnad thams cad mtshon pas yu ba dkar po brgyad gzhogs su byas pas 'phags lam brgyad mtshon/ rtsa ba la rdo rje rtse lnga pa phyed pas mtshon pa 'gro ba rgyud lnga mtshon/ gyen du 'phel ka che ba ni yon tan gong nas gong du 'phel ba mtshon/ des 'gro ba rgyud lnga sku gsum gyi sar 'dren pa mtshon no// de yongs su 'gro ba'i lam ni/ tshogs sbyor sogs yin/ 'dir sems can 'khrul pa'i lam rgyud lnga ste/ rmi lam gyi lam dang*/ bag chags kyi lam dang*/ las kyi mtha'i lam dang*/ 'khrul 'khor ma nges pa'i lam dang*/ rgyu dang 'bras bu so sor ma nges pa'i lam dang lnga nas so// yang lam rgyud lnga ni ngan song gsum lha mi zung gcig ste/ rgya rol las/ sred srid ma rig dbang gis skye bo rnams// mi dang lha gnas ngan song rnam gsum po// 'gro ba lnga po dag tu mi mkhas 'khor// zhes so// rtse mor sna tshogs rdo rje'i khar bum pa/ de'i khar thod pa skam rlon 'dres ma gsum mam yang na skam po gsum brtsegs pa'i khar rdo rje rtse lnga pa drang pos mtshan pa/ thabs snying rje chen po dang gnas lugs rtogs pa'i shes rab zung du chud pa la brten nas sems can gyi don dpag med bsgrub pa mtshon/ kha ṭ+wāṃ ga la ḍā ma ru dang dril bu dang 'phan rtse gsum pa 'phyang bzhin pa dang rtsa ba mdun la bstan pa/ rtse mo rgyab la bstan pa phrag pa la bkal ba'i tshul gyis 'dzin pa'i gru mor 'dzin pa yang mus chen gyis bshad/ yang kha ṭ+wāṃ gas lha sku ḍā ma ru dang g.yer khas gsung*/ 'phan rtse gsum pas thugs rnam par thar pa'i sgo gsum mtshon pas yab kyi sku gsung thugs mtshon/ mas kyi rdo rje phyed pas srung 'khor rkang gi brgyad gzhogs dur khrod brgyad/

sna tshogs rdo rje gzhal yas khang*/ thod pa skam rlon rnyid gsum ni sku gsung thugs kyi 'khor lo/ bum pa ni bde chen 'khor lo/ steng gi rdo rje phyed pa ni tog yin no// rten dkyil 'khor du ma zad brten pa lha yang tshang ste/ steng gi rdo rje phyed pa bcom ldan 'das yum ni rje btsun ma nyid dngos su snang ba/ bum pas snying po'i rnal 'byor ma bzhi bum thod dang bcas pa/ mi mgo gsum gyis thugs gsung sku'i dpa' bo dang dpa' mo bzhi bcu rtsa brgyad/ sna tshogs rdo rje ni dam tshig 'khor lo'i rnal 'byor ma brgyad yin no// yang sna tshogs rdo rje phrin las sna tshogs pas sems can gyi don byed pas sprul sku mtshon/ bum pa ni bde ba chen po ste longs sku mtshon/ thod pa skam po gsum ni rnam thar sgo gsum gyi rang bzhin chos sku mtshon/ steng gi rdo rje rtse lnga pa ni sku gsum po re re yang ye shes lnga lnga'i bdag nyid can yin no// de dag ni thugs kyi gsang ba mtshon la/ ḍā ma ru dang dril bus ni gsung gi gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang*/ 'phan gyis ni sku'i gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa mtshon gsungs/ bshad pa gzhan yang kha ṭ+wāṃ ga rang gi lus tshad dang mnyam pa chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag cing kha dog gang du'ang bsgyur rung ba'i brdar dkar po'o// 'khor ba'i rtsa phra ba'i brdar rtsa ba phra ba'o// yang sna tshogs rdo rje'i bum dbang*/ bum pas gsang dbang*/ thod skam gsum gyis shes rab dbang*/ steng gi rdo rje rtse lnga pas dbang bzhi pa mtshon/ 'dir rgyas par bshad na mtha' yas mod/ don hril gyis bsdu na mchog tu mi 'gyur ba bde ba chen po'i brda ste nang du rig stong zung 'jug go /gzigs par bya ba'i gnas khams gsum la gzigs shing*/ mkhyen rab bya ba dus gsum gcig char du mkhyen pa/ bsnyes par bya ba sku gsum gyi go 'phang bsnyes par mtshon pas spyan gsum/

bdag 'dzin grol bar mtshon pas dbu skra nag po ma 'dzings shing ma mdud pa sil bur gyur pa sku sked yan chad khebs pa ste kun 'dzin gyi rtog pa'i mdud pa thams cad grol ba'i brda'o// nyon mongs lnga spangs ye shes lnga mtshon pa'i brdar ltag par gnyer ma gsum mgul pa gnyis su gnyer ma re re yod pa/ ye shes lnga'i rgyal ba rigs lnga mtshon pas mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan de yang leb mo sor lnga pa rgya tshos kyis kha mig bzos pa re re'i steng du gser la sogs pa rin po che'i rtse phran gyi dbus su rigs lnga'i phyag mtshan dang bcas pa rin po che'i 'khyud mo'am rus pa'i 'khyud mos steng 'og gnyis na gsum gshibs re re'i bar na gnyis gshibs dang bcas pas brgyan pa/ thod skam 'di'i tshad la rje ngag dbang chos grags kyi khrid yig tu sor bcu gnyis pa zhes byung bas mtheb sor lnga la mdzub mo'i rtse sor nyi shu byas pa'i bcu gnyis sam/ yang na mthe'u chung gi bcu gnyis te mtshon don rten 'brel bcu gnyis so zhes gsungs te da dung dpyad do// nang gi khams ā li kā li lnga bcu dag pa'i brdar mi mgo skam po lnga bcu/ ye shes kyi snang ba las grub pa'i ro skra'i thag pa la brgyus pa'i do shal phrag pa nas brla'i bar 'phyang ba/ yum la thod skam lnga bcu'i do shal byas pa'i don ni yum shes rab byang sems dmar po'i rang bzhin yin pa thod skam gyis byang sems dkar po mtshon pas brgyan pa'o// thabs dang mi 'bral bar mtshon pas thal ba dang mchod phyir thogs shes rab mtshon byed yin la/ des na rang nyid stong nyid kyi ngo bo yin pa'i phyir de gnyis spangs pa'i phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ de dag kyang spyi bor rtsa 'dab so gnyis mtshon pa'i brdar rus pa'i 'khor lo drwa mig sum cu so gnyis pa/ skra thams cad drwa mig nang nas yar drangs pa/ de'i mthar thod skam gyi drwa ba drwa phyed sor gnyis tsam dang sna ltag gnyis rnams su cung zad 'phyang ba'i mtha' rnams su dril chung dang bcas pa ste spyi bo'i 'khor los bsam gtan mtshon/

snyan gnyis la rus pa'i a long nyis brtsegs rus thung dang bcas pa mtha' rnams su nor bu mig gsum pa re res brgyan pa des bzod pa mtshon/ nang gi rtsa 'dab bcu drug mtshon pa'i brdar mgul rgyan rus pa'i gzhung gsum drwa mig bcu drug dril chung sogs gong dang 'dra/ des sbyin pa mtshon/ yan lag rnams la rus pa'i gzhung gsum gsum drwa ba drwa phyed dril chung dang bcas pa/ dpung rgyan dang lag gdub gnyis drwa phyed kha sprod/ zhabs kyi drwa phyed dril chung rnams thur du 'phyang ba de dag gis tshul khrims mtshon/ lte bar rang gi rtsa 'dab drug cu rtsa bzhi mtshon pa'i brdar 'og pags sam/ smad rgyan nam ske rags zhes bya ba ni rus pa'i gzhung gsum bar na nyis gshibs kyis bsdam pa drwa mig drug cu rtsa bzhi/ drwa phyed dril chung ring ba rnams bol gang*/ de las thung ba rnams pus mo dang*/ de las thung ba rnams dpyi mgor sleb pa'o// des brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa mtshon te/ bde mchog rtsa rgyud las/ pha rol phyin drug rgyan drug sogs/

sems dpa' chen po'i dngos slob blo gros rin chen pa'i kyai rdor mngon rtogs bshad pa rgyan drug ni/ lus mtha' dag la thal chen gyi rgya'am/ mchod phyir thogs kyi snying kha'i thad du pad+ma 'dab brgyad byas pa ni snying kha'i rtsa 'dab brgyad mtshon/ dpe'am tshangs skud dam/ de gsum gang rung gis kyang rgyan drug gi go ni chod/ yum la ni rgyan drug pa mi dgos te/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma'i rang bzhin yin pa'i phyir/ /zhes so/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma rang shes rab kyi ngo bo yin pas se ral kha dang thal chen gyi rgya mi dgos gsungs/ de'i spyi gtsug tu rang chas su rigs bdag rnam snang he ru ka dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis 'khor lo dang dril bu thugs kar bsnol nas 'dzin pa/ zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang ngam g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum du'ang bshad 'dug pas legs pa 'dra'o// rgyan la rus pa dang rin po che gnyis ka bshad 'dug pas dpyad do// ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ legs par gsal btab bo// sgrub thabs snying pa 'ga' rer rigs bdag gi gsal kha med pa bla ma rang la bstim pa des 'thus par mdzad/ rgyas par rnam snang la yum sangs rgyas spyan ma gri thod 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba snang*/ de'ang rigs bdag rang chas dang dbang bskur nas rgyas 'debs pa gnyis te/ sbyang gzhi la rgyal po'i bu lta bu rgyal srid la dbang ma bskur ba mchod yul du mi 'gyur ba zhig dang skyes tsam nyid nas yul gzhi sogs la dbang ba'i rigs te lugs gnyis 'byung ba'i phyi ma dang bstun nas rang chas su bsgom pa ste/ ngag 'don la med pa rnams su bsam bya la/ de lta bu'i rigs bdag ni ma chad par shin tu gal che ste/ chos kyi rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi tas/ bskyed pa'i rim pa'i mthar thug la// dbu rgyan la ni rigs bdag 'byung*// rigs bdag de ni bla ma yin// 'di ni gal te 'chol gyur na// dngos grub med par rgyud las gsungs// zhes gsungs pas/

rang gi rnal 'byor ma'i byin rlabs thob pa'i bla ma de nyid dang gzhan yang chos 'brel thob pa'i bla ma thams cad dang ngo bo dbyer med du shes dgos so// phyi nang gi gdon bgegs thams cad bsreg par mtshon pas rang gi sku las skyes pa'i ye shes me dpung chen po'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ bdud bzhi skrod par byed pa'i brdar mche ba bzhi gtsigs pa/ bde chen gyi ye shes rgyas pa'i brdar nu 'bur gnyis dam zhing rgyas pa/ dga' ba bcu drug rgyas pa'i brdar gzhon nu lo bcu drug lon pa'i na tshod can/ thabs dmigs pa med pa'i snying rje chen pos sems can thams cad rjes su 'dzin pa'i brdar zhabs g.yas brkyang pas myang 'das kyi mtha' dus mtshan ma mnan pa/ gnas lugs rtogs pa'i shes rab chen pos 'khor ba'i phyogs su ma lhung ba'i brdar zhabs g.yon bskum pas 'khor ba'i mtha' 'jigs byed mnan pa'o// 'di gnyis gnon tshul rgyas par gdan gyi skabs su bshad pa ltar ro// mtha' gnyis spangs nas mi gnas pa'i myang 'das su bsgrub pa'o// de ltar rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sku mdangs dang 'od zer gyi rang bzhin can du bsgom mo// 'di dag skye srid sbyong byed yin la/ 'khor lo bde mchog gi zab gnad bdag gzhan gyi gzhi sbyang bsgyur zhes bya ba'i bdag gzhi sbyang bsgyur gnyis tshang ba yin te/ sngags phreng las 'od zer 'phros nas sdig sgrib rnam smin gyi phung po dang bcas pa stong nyid du sbyangs pa ni bdag gi gzhi sbyangs pa dang*/ de'i ngang las rang nyid rje btsun ma'i sku zhal phyag rgyan cha lugs yongs rdzogs dang ldan par bskyed pa ni bdag gi gzhi bsgyur ba yin no// rje mus pa'i rnam bshad du/ skabs 'dir lus dkyil bsgom pa 'byung yang*/ tshar chen dang mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags kyis 'gro ba dag pa'i rnal 'byor gyi rjes su 'byung bas der brjod par bya'o// mkhyen brtse dbang pos ni ye shes pa bcug pa'i rkyen gyis lus dkyil gsal 'debs par gsungs so// bdun pa 'gro ba dag pa'i rnal 'byor ni// gzhung las/

yang de las 'od 'phros pas 'gro ba thams cad dag par byas te/ slar log ste sngags kyi phreng ba de nyid la zhugs pa dang*/ zhes gsungs/ sa skya pa chen pos sngags phreng las 'od zer byung ste ba spu'i bu ga nas song*/ rigs drug gi sems can thams cad la phog pas de thams cad kyi lus ngag yid gsum gyi sdig pa dag par bsam zhing rje btsun ma'i sku bskyed do// zhes gsungs pas/ snying kha'i sngags phreng las 'od zer kha dog sna tshogs 'phros/ lus kyi nang thams cad gang ba spu'i bu ga nas phar song*/ snod bcud thams cad la phog pas sdig sgrib thams cad dag snod chos 'byung dang bcud kyi sems can thams cad rnal 'byor ma'i skur bsgom ste/ de yang 'od zer de rigs drug bar do dang bcas pa'i sems can thams cad la phog ma thag sdig sgrib rnam smin gyi phung po dang bcas pa skad cig nyid la sbyong*/ thams cad rnal 'byor ma'i sku rgyan cha lugs zhal phyag yongs su rdzogs par gyur/ 'di la gzhan gyi gzhi sbyang bsgyur gnyis tshang ba yin te/ phyi nang snod bcud thams cad rang sems kho na yin pa'i don gyis sbyang ba dang*/ bsgyur du btub pa yin gyi rang la tha dad du grub pa zhig yin na de dag sbyang bsgyur mi nus gsungs/ de dag kyang mngon brjod las/ ba spu'i bu ga'i rtsa la spro// chos kyi 'khor lo ston par byed// 'gro ba rigs drug bsgral nas ni// bla med byang chub la bzhag bya// zhes gsungs so// 'gro ba rdo rje rnal 'byor mar byas pa 'di rnams skabs 'di nyid du rang la bsdu ba'am/ 'og ye shes pa bstim pa dang mnyam du bsdu ba gang mos bya'o// 'dir lus dkyil gyi lha gsal btab pa ni/ spyir phyi dkyil las lus dkyil khyad par 'phags pa'i rgyu mtshan bde kyai gnyis kyi zab mo lus dkyil gyi skabs su rtogs par bya'o// 'di la'ang zhal gnyis ma'i rdzogs rim sngags kyi de nyid grub par gsungs pa'i 'di bla med thun mong ba zhig dang*/

thun mong ma yin pa grub chen nā ro ta pa'i slob bshad/ snyan brgyud kho nar bzhugs pa ste/ lugs gnyis las 'dir phyi ma ste/ rang rnal 'byor mar gsal ba'i snying gar lus dkyil bsgom pa ni mngon brjod las/ ye shes mkha' 'gro'i snying gar ni// sku gsung thugs dang bcas par bsgom// zhes gsungs pas chos 'byung dang zla ba ni sku'i ngo bo/ bam̐ yig thugs kyi ngo bo/ yig 'bru rnams ni gsung gi ngo bo/ rnal 'byor ma sum cu rtsa bdun gyi ngo bo yin te/ mngon brjod las/ bcom ldan bdag pos 'di gsungs te// yi ge re re rnal 'byor ma// de nas rnal 'byor ma mchod bya// rnal 'byor ma ni sngags kyi sku// de tshe dngos grub 'dod pa yis// de dag dbye ba mi bya 'o// zhes gsungs pas/ yi ge so gnyis rnal 'byor ma so gnyis/ bam̐ yig cha lnga rnal 'byor ma lnga'o// de yang klad kor rdo rje phag mo yin pas so// lha drug cu rtsa gnyis tshang tshul dang sbyar nas/ chos 'byung gi gzhal yas khang mtshon/ zla bas dpa' bo nyer bzhi mtshon/ yig 'bru bai ro tsa nā yan gyis dpa' mo nyer bzhi mtshon/ de ltar zla ba yig 'bru rnams thabs shes rab sbyar bas oṃ dang po khaṇ+ḍa ka pā li dang rab tu gtum mo zhes sogs sbyar ro// de ltar na sku'i rnam pa'ang dpa' bo dpa' mo zhal sbyor gyi rnam par bsgom mo snyam na de ni mi dgos te/ 'dir rnal 'byor ma so bdun kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dang bcas pa rnams la yab yum gyi mtshon don tshang ba'i phyir ro// 'di man brgyad kyis sgo mtshams ma brgyad mtshon/ bam̐ yig gi srog yig ya ra la wa bzhis snying po'i rnal 'byor ma bzhi mtshon/ a thung bam̐ yig gis gtso bo yab yum mtshon/ de rnams rang gnas su lus bsgom pa ni/ yi ge nyer bzhis dpa' mo nyer bzhi/ de rnams kyi kha ṭ+wāṃ ga nyer bzhis dpa' bo nyer bzhi mtshon/ yi ge lhag ma brgyad kyis sgo mtshams brgyad/
