de brgyad kyi kha ṭ+wāṃ gas gtso bos phyag tha ma brgyad mtshon/ srog yig bzhi'i ngo bo rnal 'byor ma bzhi'i kha ṭ+wāṃ gas gtso bos phyag dang po bzhi mtshon/ de ltar nges par byas nas ji ltar bsgom pa'i tshul ni/ chos 'byung gi zla ba'i dbus su bam̐ yig gi ngo bo rnal 'byor ma dmar mo/ bam̐ yig gi srog ya ra la wa bzhi las/ shar du ya'i ngo bo rnal 'byor ma dkar mo/ g.yon du ra'i ngo bo rnal 'byor ma ljang gu/ rgyab tu la'i ngo bo rnal 'byor ma dmar mo/ g.yas su wa'i ngo bo rnal 'byor ma ser mo/ mthar sngags phreng so gnyis kyang re re nas kun dril lus dkyil gyi lha so bdun rgyan cha lugs yongs su rdzogs pa phyi'i rnal 'byor ma dang 'dra ba thugs kar 'khor lo lnga brtsegs kyang gsal gdab/ 'di'i zab gnad rdo rje'i lus la yul chen sum cu so bdun gyi rtsa khams yi ge rnams tshang bar gnas/ de'i nus pa snying dbus la gnas pa'i rtsa khams la tshang ba ste rgyas par gong du rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i lung*/ rtsa yi mchog gi grong khyer du// zhes sogs kyi lung don/ dang por a wa dhū ti nas rgya mtsho'i nang du skar ma shar ba bzhin zhes pa'i bar de dag go /des na rnal 'byor ma'i snying po oṃ gsum ma la yig 'bru sum cu so gnyis/ bam̐ yig gi srog gi a thung 'byung bzhi'i yi ge dang bcas pa 'byung*/ de rnams 'dir lhar bskyed pa'i lus dkyil 'di ni rje btsun sa skya pa yab sras la snyan brgyud 'ba' zhig tu bzhugs pa brgyud pa zam ma chad pa las byung ba kho na yin zhing*/ rjes 'brang ba yin lo phal cher gyi rna bas ma thos pa'i chos yin no// de'i phyir snod ldan ma gtogs dam tshig dang mi ldan zhing byin rlabs sogs ma thob pa rnams kyi rna lam du ming tsam yang mi bsgrag go /'di legs par bsgoms na nang gi gnas so bdun gyi rlung sems thams cad dbu mar thim nas sa lam bgrod cing phyi rol gyi yul so bdun na bzhugs pa'i dpa' bo dang dpa' mo rnams dbang du 'du ba yin te/

rtsa rgyud las/ yul 'di dag gi bu mo gang*// dpa' bo gnyis med rnal 'byor ma// de kun 'dod pa'i gzugs can te// yid kyi shugs kyis 'jug pa yin// zhes gsungs so// de ltar lus dkyil bsgom pa'i tshe ye shes pa spyan 'dren pa dang*/ bzlas pa'i tshe rnal 'byor ma dbus ma'i thugs ka'i bam̐ yig sngags phreng las 'od zer spro bsdu byed pa yin no// tshar chen gyi gsung rgyun las ni 'khor rnams kyi thugs ka'i 'khor lo lnga brtsegs kyi gsal kha mi snang ngo*// smras pa/ snying dbus bzhugs pa'i mkha' spyod ma gang de// snying nas grub par 'dod pa'i rnal 'byor pas// snying ga'i gdams pa mchog 'dis tshim byas nas// snying ltar gces pas dam du sba bar gyis// zhes pa ltar rtogs par bya'o// brgyad pa dpa' bo dpa' mos byin gyis brlab pa ni/ gzhung las slar yang yig 'bru'i tshogs kyi 'od zer gyis/ dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro ma'i tshogs thams cad spyan drangs te bdag nyid la zhugs par bya'o zhes gsungs la/ sa skya pa chen pos/ yang 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad sems can thams cad la rnal 'byor mar bskyed pa thams cad kyang bdag gi ba spu'i bu ga thams cad nas bsdus shing thim par bya'o// zhes gsungs pas gzhan las ye shes pa dgug gzhug 'byung ba'i don te/ de'ang lus kyi phyag rgya ni/ 'khor lo sdom pa'i bshad rgyud las/ mdzub mo 'dud bya zhes sogs gsungs te/ mthe bong gnyis lto sbyar/ mdzub mo gnyis mdud/ gung mo gnyis rtse sbyar zhing gzhan rnams 'bar ba ltar byas pas 'bar ba'i phyag rgya'o// saṃ bu ṭa las/ ngo mtshar sgyu ma'i phyag rgya zhes gsungs la/ rkang pa'i stabs sogs rgyun du ma grub kyang sngags phyag rgya ting nge 'dzin gsum shin tu gal che bas/ sngags ni phaiṃ zhes pas mkha' 'gro'i dam tshig gi rdo rje brjod de/ phaiṃ zhes pas thung ngu ma yin par phaiṃ zhes dang pha dang e dang ma ste yi ge gsum gyi gdangs thon tsam byas te/

pho nya gsum gcig tu 'dus pa'i don yin la/ bod skad khos zhes bya ba yin te/ sngags dang phyag rgya 'dis spyan drangs pas/ gal te mi 'byon na dam tshig nyams pas mgo khos zhes bya ba'i don yin gsungs pas phaiṃ gyi sgra dang bcas shing mig gyen du bsgreng*/ rkang pa'i mthe bong g.yas pas g.yon pa mnan lus kyis 'bar ba'i phyag rgya dpral ba'i dbyings su lan gsum g.yon skor du bskor/ sems kyi dmigs pa thugs ka'i bam̐ yig las 'od zer dmar po lcags kyu'i rnam pa can 'phros dbu ma'i nang nas yar song nas smin mtshams kyi thad nas thon te 'og min na bzhugs pa'i lhan skyes kyi rnal 'byor ma la sangs rgyas byang sems kyis bskor ba dang yul nyer bzhi na bzhugs pa'i zhing skyes kyi dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rnams dang*/ 'gro ba rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gyur pa sngags las skyes pa rnams 'od zer gyi sna la steng nas char 'bab pa dang*/ 'og nas rlung rdol ba dang bar nas dge 'dun chos 'khor la 'byon pa ltar bsam zhing dzaḥ zhes pas byon/ hūm̐ zhes pas nye bar byon/ baṃ zhes pas rang nyid rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dam tshig par gsal ba'i spyi bo la sogs pa'i ba spu'i bu ga rnams nas bstim/ hoḥzhes pas ye shes pa'i ngo bor gcig tu gyur par bsgom/ mkhyen brtse pas mdzad/ dzaḥzhes pas rang gi spyi bor byon/ hūm̐ zhes pas sib kyis thim/ baṃ zhes pas chu la chu bzhag pa bzhin du dbyer med du 'dres/ hoḥzhes pas gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi dbang du gyur te dus gtan du nam yang mi 'bral bar bsam/ phyag rgya ma byas kyang btub/ spro na kyai rdor ltar bya gsungs/ mngon brjod las/ ye shes 'khor lo de ltar de// chos rnams kun gyi ngo bor byas// ye shes dkyil 'khor sbyor ba yi// chos kun ro gcig gyur par bsgom// zhes gsungs so// des na 'og min gyi lhan skyes longs sku dang yul nyer bzhi sogs kyi zhing skyes dang sngags skyes gnyis sprul sku yin te/

de rnams kyang chos sku las 'byung bas sku gsum gyi bdag nyid nga'o snyam du nga rgyal bzung ste/ dril bu lus dkyil gyi ngag 'don thol/ paṇa chen grags rgyal gyi gsung la mkhan chen legs 'byung gi zin bris mdzad par/ rnam lnga 'dod bskor dbus su gsum/ g.yas g.yon du re re'am/ dbu sogs steng 'og tu re re'o// dbus dang g.yas g.yon du re re ste lngar byed/ pad skor gyi mthar 'khyud rgya bya ba ni/ thabs shes zung 'jug mtshon byed yin/ 'khyud pa'i phyag rgya byas nas oṃ yo ga shud+dha sogs brjod de/ yo ga ni rnal 'byor ma yin la de'i don yang*/ thabs dang shes rab gnyis med pa// rnal 'byor de bzhin gshegs pas gsungs// zhes gsungs pa ltar/ bdag nyid thabs dang shes rab gnyis su med pa la gnas pa de bzhin du 'gro ba thams cad kyang thabs shes gnyis su med pa la gnas par bsam ste/ gsang mtha'i zab khyad pho nya gsum bsres te/ de dag thams cad rang sems gcig po nyid de dang der snang ba yin la/ de nyid 'di nyid du nyams su len pa nas skye bo dam pa kun 'dus pa zhes pa'i nyams len te rig pa brjod med du cham me bzhag go /de nas go cha dgod pa ni/ gzhung las dngos su ma bshad kyang bla ma'i man ngag gis kha bskang ste/ slob bshad ltar na/ shing gnyis gzer gyis bsdam pa dang 'dra bar yi dam dang 'bral med du 'ching ba'i don gyis ye shes pa bcug pa'i rjes su bkod de/ lte ba la sogs par rnal 'byor ma drug yi ge'i rnam par bkod de/ lha nyid sngags kyi gzugs kyis ni// sgrub pa po la dngos grub ster// zhes gsungs pas/ de yang rnal 'byor mar gsal ba'i lte ba la sogs pa'i gnas rnams su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor re re'i steng du oṃ bam̐ la sogs pa dpa' mo'i go cha rnams ngo bo lha yin kyang rnam pa yi ge'i gzugs su bsgom pa ste/ lte ba'i nang thad du oṃ bam̐ snying khar bam̐ yig gi mdun du ham̐ yoṃ/

lce gzhung du hriṃ moṃ/ dpral ba'i skra mtshams kyi nang du hriṃ hriṃ/ spyi gtsug gi rus pa dang klad pa'i hrag tu hūm̐ hūm̐/ yan lag thams cad la zhes pa gru mo dang dpyi zur rnams spangs pa'i tshigs chen brgyad ni rkang pa'i tshigs bzhi lag pa'i tshigs bzhi ste/ tshigs de rnams kyi bar du phaṭa phaṭa/ yig 'bru de rnams kyi kha dog ni sgrub thabs rnams su 'byung ba ltar yin zhing lha de dang de'i ngo bo yin snyam du bsgom mo// dpe la lar dpyi zur 'dug ste dpyad do// de ltar go cha bkod pa'i dgos pa gzhan yang bar chad bsrung ba dang*/ mngon shes drug 'char ba sogs rje btsun rtse mos bshad do// go cha dgod pa ni/ ye shes pa gzhug pa'i snga rting gang la bsgoms kyang 'gal ba med de sngon la bsgom pa rgyud rgya gzhung phal cher gyi dgongs pa yin zhing*/ rting la bsgom pa jo bo nā ro ta pa'i man ngag yin par gsungs pas 'di ni de nyid kyi rjes su 'brang ba yin no// 'di la dbang bskur rigs bdag gi rgyas 'debs pa 'ga' zhig rgyas par byed kyang 'di'i lugs kyi spros pa shin tu chung ba'i skabs yin pa'i phyir/ rigs bdag rang chas su bsgom pa ma gtogs dngos su mi byed do// 'di nyid kyi tshe rang chas 'di ka gzhung dang mthun/ mdun bskyed lta bu spros pa la dga' ba'i tshe dbang bskur rgyas btab byas kyang rung gsungs/ dgu pa bzlas pa ni slob dpon gyi gzhung las/ sngags kyi phreng ba de nyid la zhugs pa dang*/ yid dang ngag gi dbye bas bzlas par bya'o// zhes gsungs/ sa skya pa chen pos/ ngag bzlas byed na snying kha'i sngags phreng la dmigs pa bzlas pa bya/ yid bzlas ni don la rdzogs rim mtshan bcas te/ de yang bde ba skyed par 'dod na gsang gnas su chos 'byung nyis brtsegs sam rkyang pa gang rung dmar seng nge bsgom/ de'i grwa rnams su dga' ba 'khyil pa g.yung drung bzhi yang dmigs pa bam̐ yig la sngags phreng g.yon du bkod/

de la dmigs te steng rlung mnan 'og rlung yang bskum ste de lta bu'i yid kyi bzlas pa bdun nam lnga'am gsum bya'o// zhes gsungs la/ de las ngag bzlas yid bzlas gnyis kyi dang po ni/ bzlas pa'i yul phreng ba mang yang*/ 'dir/ dung chen phreng ba blangs nas ni// zhes pa dung chen mi rus yin la/ de yang mi rus gang rung gis mi chog cing thod phreng nges par dgos so// phreng ba byin rlabs ni kyai rdor ltar byas pas chog ste/ kyai rdor gyi phreng ba byin rlabs yang saṃ bu ṭar 'byung zhing*/ saṃ bu ṭa bde kye gnyis ka'i thun mong gi bshad rgyud yin pas so// des na phreng ba byin brlabs bya tshul ni/ rang lha'i nga rgyal dang ldan pa'i sgo nas rang gi lag pa g.yon pa'i sor mo rnams pad+ma 'dab ma lnga dang lag pa'i mthil du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la a ā sogs nas aṃ a'i bar brjod de dbyangs bcu drug gis g.yon du bskor ba'i lte ba la āḥ lag pa g.yas pa'i sor mo lnga rdo rje rtse lnga pa lag pa'i mthil du nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la/ ka kha nas k+ṣa'i bar du brjod de gsal byed kyis g.yas su bskor ba'i lte ba la hūm̐/ gung mdzub gnyis kyi bar du sum̐ dkar po rnams bsams nas mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i phreng ba la nang mchod kyis gtor la/ sum+bha nis bsangs/ swā bhā was sbyangs pa'i phreng ba pad skor sngon du 'gro bas blangs la/ lag pa gnyis kyi bar du bcug ste sor mo'i rtse rdo rje dang pad+ma snyoms par zhugs pa'i byang chub kyi sems sum̐ la khyab/ de ā li kā li la khyab/ de phreng ba dang gnyis su med par gyur par bsams la/ oṃ pa de pa de mahā dz+nyā na sarba bud+dha ma yaṃ bha wa te hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ ho ho ho a khaṃ swā hā/ zhes pas thog mar byin rlabs kyi dus phreng skor gcig bzlas/ de rjes thun re la nyer gcig la sogs pa ji rigs pa bzla ba ni phreng ba byin rlabs yin zhing*/

phreng thag dgu dril mdo 'dzin nyis brtsegs dgos tshul sogs rnam dbye rgyas pa man ngag rnam bshad sogs su blta'o// de nas ji ltar bzlas pa'i bsam gtan dngos ni/ lus dkyil bsgoms na dbus kyi bam̐ yig gi ngo bo rnal 'byor ma'i thugs ka dang*/ ma bsgoms na rang gi snying gar chos 'byung nyis brtsegs zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bam̐ yig yig 'bru rnams gsal btab/ de dag las 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros/ rang gi lugs kyi nang thams cad gang bas tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad sbyangs/ 'od zer ba spu'i bu ga nas phyir 'phros/ de dag gi sna la phyi nang gsang gsum gyi mchod pa'i bye brag dpag tu med pa sprul te/ rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro sogs myang 'das rnams la mchod pa'i sprin bsams gyis mi khyab pa phul bas thugs rgyud zag med kyi bde ba khyad par can brnyes pas rang gi tshogs rdzogs shing sgrib pa dag yang 'od zer de khams gsum snod bcud thams cad la phog pas snod thams cad chos 'byung dang*/ bcud kyi sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i go 'phang la bkod pa ni rnal 'byor ma'i skur bsgyur ba'i don no// de dag ni ye shes kyi bzlas pa'o// yang 'od zer rnams rim gyis rang la bsdu ba'i tshe/ rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rnams kyi thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes mkhyen brtse nus gsum gyi yon tan byin rlabs nus mthu thams cad pho nya gsum gyi byin rlabs dang*/ mkha' spyod kyi dngos grub kyi ngo bo yin pa la/ rnam pa 'od zer dmar po'i rnam par nam mkha' gang bar byon nas rang gi snying ga'i bam̐ yig sngags phreng dang bcas pa la thim pas rgyud byin gyis brlabs shing mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa thob par gyur par bsam pa ni dam tshig gi bzlas pa'o// yang las gang byed dang mthun pa'i 'od zer spro bsdu yang rung gsungs/

de dag ni spro bsdu'i bzlas pa'o// bkod pa'i bzlas pa ni/ sngags kyi yig 'bru rnams mgo gyen bstan de dag bzlog pa'i tshul gyis bzlas pa'o// rig byed 'don pa lta bu'i bzlas pa ni sngags rnams ring thung phyed cing skad gdangs dang bcas bzla ba'o// 'di ni snod min gyis mi thos pa'i sa dang*/ gnyid rmugs kyis byings na bya'o// shub bu'i bzlas pa ni sngags kyi sgra rang gi gos kyi gong bas tshor tsam du bzla ba 'di gtso che'o// rang nyid kyis sngags 'dren pa bzhin du dgra gnyen bar ma'i sems can dang*/ lus kyi srin bu tshun chad thams cad rnal 'byor ma'i skur gsal bas sngags kyi sgra de ri rir 'dren par bsam mo// sgo gsum 'jug pa rtse gcig tu dril nas bzlas na phan yon shin tu che ste/ dgos med rnam rtog la shes pa rgya yan du btang nas/ sngags bgrang ba'i grangs ji tsam mang yang byin rlabs mi 'byung bas na/ rang gi ma byung bar lha dang bla ma gdams ngag la 'khang par byed pa mang du gda' ste chos spang gi las su gyur par gsungs la/ dmigs pa rtse gcig dang ma bral ba'i ngang nas bzlas brjod byas na byin rlabs kyi mtshan ma gdon mi za ba 'byung ngo*// bde mchog sdom 'byung las/ gzhan du mi 'phro'i sems kyis ni// de lta'i tshul gyis bzlas par bya// yul gzhan blo ni 'phro ba yis// bskal par bzlas kyang 'bras mi 'byin// zhes gsungs so// bzlas bya sngags kyi don phal cher gong du bshad zin la/ 'dir bod skad du bsgyur du rung ba rnams skad gnyis shan sbyar na/ oṃ gsum gyi don ni/ mchog ster ba dang sngags kyi 'go 'dren pa sogs don brgyad la 'jug par bshad do// 'dir mchog ster ba gtso bor gzung ngo*// sarba thams cad/ bud+dha sangs rgyas/ ḍā ki nī ye mkha' 'gro ma/ badz+ra rdo rje/ war+ṇa nī ye kha dog ma ste rgyas par na kha dog ma ste rdo rje rigs can ma zhes 'byung ngo*// badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye rdo rje rnam par snang mdzad ma/

hūm̐ gsum ni sdug bsngal 'joms pa sogs du ma la 'jug go /phaṭa gsum ni dgas sa khos shig ste bdud dang sdug bsngal 'joms pa'i don no// swā hā gzhi tshugs zhes pa'o// de la in+d+ra bhū tis yig 'bru rnams lha mo'i kha dog dang mthun pa dang gnas spyi bo la sogs par bsgom par gsungs kyang*/ 'di pa'i lugs kyis gnas snying kha la sogs pa rnams su yig 'bru rnams kha dog dmar po bsgoms la/ yi ge bskor lugs gong du bshad zin la/ don bsdu na sngags 'di'i steng du gzhi lam 'bras gsum thams cad mtshon pas bskal bzang dag gis bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i don can du go bar bya zhing sngags dag pa dang byin rlabs che ba'i phyir sngags btu ba'i cho ga ni/ rgyal chen in+d+ra bhū tis mdzad pa'i yi ge las shes par bya'o// mgo bo'i oṃ dang mjug gi hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā rnams kyi sngags don gyi lung khungs gsal po rdo rje rtse mo'i rgyud na bzhugs kyang 'dir yi ge mang gi dogs pas ma bris la/ lung nyer mkho cung zad dang sbyar na sa skya pa chen pos yig 'bru rnams bri ba'i tshe re re dmigs la/ oṃ 'dra la/ sarba bud+dha zhes sogs bkod la bzlog pa'i go rim bzhin no// zhes dang 'phags pas g.yon skor du go rim bzhin bkod la bzla'o// zhes so// de ltar oṃ gsum ma thun re la yang brgya rtsa stong rtsa sogs dam bca' ji tsam yod pa las mi nyung bar mi tshig gis bar ma chod par bzlas shing*/ de yang bsnyen pa lta bu ma yin pa'i dus rgyun du thun re la sum brgya'am lnga brgya gang rigs mdzad gsungs/ kha cig oṃ gsum sogs yod pa'i rgyu mtshan rtsa sngags snying po nye snying phyogs gcig tu bsdebs pa mtshon zer ba mi 'thad gsung ngo*// tha na'ang brgya rtsa la sogs pa dam bca' las mi nyung ba bzla ba gal che ste/ spyir gsang sngags thams cad kyi zab pa'i mthar thug pa ni 'khor lo bde mchog gi skor 'di rnams yin par gsungs shing*/

de'i yang zab mthar thug pa ni rje btsun lū nag dril gsum gyis mdzad pa'i lam rim rnams yin la/ de'i don gyi snying po ma lus pa 'dus pa'i man ngag gi yang rtser gyur pa ni nā ro mkha' spyod kyi lam 'di nyid yin par gsungs pa dang*/ gzhan yang bsgrub bya'i yul du gyur pa'i mkha' 'gro ma bsam gyis mi khyab pa yod kyang*/ de rnams bye ba phyed dang bzhi ru bsdus pa yin la/ de yang stong phrag bdun cu rtsa gnyis su bsdus shing*/ de yang sum cu rtsa bdun du bsdus/ de yang nyi shu rtsa bzhi'am brgyad dam lngar bsdus/ de yang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma 'di kho na la bsdus te/ mus chen sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan gyis/ mkha' 'gro grangs med bsam gyis mi khyab na'ang 'di nyid bye ba phyed bzhis bsdus/ de nyid stong phrag bdun cu rtsa gnyis su// brtson chen la sogs nyi shu rtsa bzhis bsdus// de nyid la ma la sogs drug tu 'dus// kun 'dus la ma rnal 'byor ma la 'dud// ces mchod brjod du gsungs pa ltar ro// des na 'di nyid gcig pu bsgoms shing bsgrubs pas mkha' 'gro bye ba rab 'byams ri rab kyi rdul dang mnyam pa bsgom pa dang bsgrub par 'gyur pa dang*/ de bzhin du 'di'i gsang sngags oṃ gsum ma la yang sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro thams cad kyi ngo bo 'khor lo bde mchog lha drug cu rtsa gnyis kyi sngags thams cad 'dus par bshad pas/ de la dgongs nas bla ma gong ma rnams kyis bde mchog lū nag gi byin rlabs drug skor gyi skabs dang rnam rgyal bum pa'i lha thams cad kyi bzlas sngags la yum gyi nye snying kho na bzlas chog par gsungs pa yin la/ des na gsang sngags oṃ gsum ma 'di la chig sgril du byas pas sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro thams cad kyi thugs 'khul zhing byin gyis rlobs par 'gyur zhing oṃ gsum ma lan gcig brjod pas kyang bskal pa mang po'i sgrib pa 'dag par nges pa yin te/

de'i rgyu mtshan gsang sngags pa rnams tshe gcig lus gcig la dngos grub thob pa'i gnad kyang 'di 'dra'i rigs kyi zab gnad dang ldan pa las 'byung ba yin par gsungs pa sogs rtsod pa dang bral ba'i rje btsun gong ma rnams kyi gsung rab dang gsung rgyun dag las spyir mi lus lan gcig tsam thob pa'i dus 'dir gsang sngags zab mo'i lam nyams su len pa shin tu skal ba bzang ba'i tshul dang*/ lhag par mkha' spyod dbang mo 'di nyid bzlas bsgom nyams su len pa la phan yon gzhan las ches che ba'i sgrub byed mang du 'byung ngo*// de yang lam 'di nyid la brten nas rgya bod du mkhas grub bya khyu 'phur ba lta bu mang du byung ste mdor bsdus tsam sngags 'chang thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis mdzad pa'i mkha' spyod ma'i dkyil chog gi mjug tu blta'o// bsnyen pa bya tshul ni 'og tu 'chad do// gnyis pa yid bzlas ni lto 'grangs ltog snyoms pa'i dus su rlung ro rnams lan dgu phrugs su bus/ de tsam ma byung na'ang g.yon nas lan gsum 'bud pa'am g.yas g.yon gnyis ka gsum la dmigs te 'bud pa gang rung bya zhing de nas 'og rlung snyan gsan 'bebs pa'i tshul du cung zad bskum/ steng rlung lus gug byas nas dal bus rngubs rlung rdzogs rjes mchil ma'i rta dang bcas te lte bar sdigs te bskyur ba dang mnyam du chos 'byung nyis brtsegs zla ba bam̐ yig sngags phreng dang bcas pa bde ba skyed par 'dod na gsang gnas su/ mi rtog pa skye bar 'dod na lte bar phab ste/ 'og rlung rdzogs par 'then la rlung bum pa can nam kha sbyar du grags pa bzung ste/ lus dkyil bsgoms nas mi dmigs pa'am yig 'brur bsgyur ba gang rung bya'o// chos 'byung gi mdun rgyab spangs pa'i grwa bzhir dga' ba 'khyil pa bde ba'i nyams dang ldan pa dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa g.yon skor du 'khor ba la sems gtad/

dga' ba 'khyil pa 'khor gyi bam̐ yig sngags phreng dang bcas pa mi 'khor ro// yig 'bru g.yon skor du klog pa'i tshul gyis lan bdun la sogs pa ci nus yid kyis bzlas/ phyis goms pa dang grangs mang du bya'o// de dag kyang klog lugs oṃ la sogs pa'i yig 'bru rnams thad kar dang du bzlog /sarba sogs tshom bu rnams g.yon skor klog rlung mi thub na dal bus glod/ yid bzlas 'di rdzogs rim mtshan bcas yin pa drod dang bde ba skye zhing 'phar g.yo drag tu 'byung la/ de byung na rim gyis glod/ du ba la sogs pa'i rtags thams cad kyang 'di las 'byung gsungs/ bzlas pa'i mthar mdun gyi nam mkhar rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rnams bzhugs par dmigs la byung na thun re la sngags grangs ji tsam song ba nges par byas nas bla ma dang yi dam gyi mtshan nas bzung ste de rnams la dgongs gsol byas la bdag gi thun 'di la sngags 'di tsam song ba bla ma yi dam gyi sku gsung thugs la 'bul lags na/ thugs brtse ba can gyis bzhes su gsol/ bzhes nas bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab du gsol/ zhes grangs yi dam la gtad pa gdams pa'i mchog yin gsungs/ bzlas pa phul nas yig brgya dang rten 'brel snying po tshar gsum gsum bzlas na shin tu legs so// de tsam ma byung kyang bzlas pa bsdu ba na phreng ba thal mo bar du bzung la/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad kyis bdag dang sems can thams cad la byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ myur du phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i go 'phang tshe 'di nyid la thob par mdzad du gsol/ zhes brjod cing phreng ba mgo thog tu bzhag go /bzlas pa'i sbyang gzhi la rigs drug gi skad sna tshogs rdzun phra ma la sogs pa ngag gi las sgrib thams cad dang*/ de dag gi bag chags sems la tshang*/

de lus dkyil 'khor bzhi dang*/ khyad par du rgya yig dang bod yig gi rnam par shar ba thams cad sbyong byed 'dir de thams cad sngags phreng du bsgom/ rlung thams cad skad gdangs su bsgom/ rnam rtog thams cad 'od zer du bsgoms pas srid pa gsum gyi tha mal gyi sgra dbyangs thams cad spangs pa mkha' spyod ma'i gsung sgrub par byed pa'i gdams ngag ste/ chos rje rdo rje 'chang gis/ oṃ gsum ldan pa'i gsang sngags yi ge'i tshogs// zhes sogs tshigs bcad gcig gi don no// yid bzlas kyi sbyang gzhi gzhan la mi mngon pa'i sgo nas bsam ngan brnar sems gnod sems log lta sogs yin par bshad do// de ltar bshad ma thag pa'i bskyed rim bzlas pa'i rnal 'byor dang bcas pa de dag dbang bzhi'i lam lus la dril nas nyams su len pa yin te/ ngag bzlas yid bzlas ni bskyed rim gyi lam/ lte bar yid bzlas byed pa gsang dbang gi lam/ gsang gnas su yid bzlas byed pa shes rab ye shes kyi lam/ de dag la brten nas bde chen gyi ye shes skyes pa ni bzhi pa'i lam mo// de dag re re la'ang dbang bzhi'i lam tshang ste/ rang nyid rnal 'byor ma rten dang brten par bcas par bsam pa bum dbang gi lam chos 'byung zla ba'i dkyil 'khor yig 'bru dang bcas pa gsang dbang gi lam/ dga' ba 'khyil pa shes rab ye shes kyi lam ste/ de'ang dga' ba sogs pa'i dga' ba bzhi mtshon pas dga' 'khyil bzhi zur med pa ni rnam rtog gi grwa zur med pa'o// dga' ba bzhi po re re la'ang bzhi bzhi mtshon pas dga' 'khyil re la g.yung drung ris bzhi bzhi ste bcu drug de dag la brten nas bskyed pa'i bde chen gyi ye shes ni bzhi pa'i lam mo// de yang rdo rje 'chang gis/ dbang bzhi'i don ldan bskyed rim zab mo'i lam// zhes sogs tshigs bcad gcig gi don no// 'dir zhar byung gi rdzogs rim cung zad 'byung ba rje ngag dbang chos grags sogs kyis mdzad pa'i khrid yig tu shes so// 'on kyang 'di 'og nas 'byung ba'i chos rje dpal rdor ba'i gsung dang gnad 'dra bar 'dug go

/rje mkhyen brtse ba dang ngag dbang chos grags gnyis kyi yig cha la'ang go rim cung zad mi 'dra ba 'dug pas dpyad do// bcu pa bsam mi khyab kyi rnal 'byor ni/ gzhung las/ de nas bam̐ yig gi 'od zer gyis sa gsum lus dang lus yi ge rim gyis bsam gyis mi khyab pa la bzhugs pa sngon du 'gro bas de kho na nyid bsgom par bya'o// zhes gsungs/ rje sa chen gyis/ snying kha'i sngags phreng las 'od zer 'phros pas khams gsum thams cad 'od zer gyis khengs/ de yang gzugs med khams lus kyi stod kyi cha la/ gzugs khams bar gyi cha la/ 'dod khams smad kyi cha la/ rang yang chos 'byung la/ chos 'byung sngags dang zla ba/ zla ba'ang sngags la/ de bam̐ la/ de thig le la/ de nā da dkar dmar du gyur te chu la rlabs thim pa ltar ci yang mi dmigs par gyur par bsams la/ de'i ngang la shes pa glod de/ de la ji tsam gnas tshad du bzhag go /zhi gnas shas che na lhar ldang ngo*// gsal ba bde ba shas che na stong par bzhag go /zhes gsungs te/ rgyas pa gong nyal ba'i rnal 'byor gyi skabs su bshad pa ltar ro// bsam mi khyab kyi sbyang gzhi yang dus gsum gyi 'chi ba sbyang ba sogs nyal ba'i rnal 'byor ltar ro// skabs 'dir bsam mi khyab thun mong ma yin pa'i nyams len dang 'da' kha ma'i gdams ngag du ma yod pa rnams mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags sogs kyi yig cha bzhin rang gis ji ltar thob pa nyams su blang bar bya zhing*/ rtsa dbu ma'i man ngag 'og nas 'byung ba ltar 'dir bsgom mo// de nas thun las ldang ba na go cha dran pa tsham rngam sngags kyis bsrung ba/ dga' ba gsum gsal 'debs pa/ bsngo ba smon lam bkra shis sogs bya'o// gtor ma 'bul na go cha sogs kyi gong du bya'o// de nas go cha sogs rjes cho ga spyi ltar bya'o// sku mdog dmar ba ni sems can la rjes su chags pa'o// zhes gong gi dag bya dag byed rnams dran par byas kyang rung*/

ma byas kyang skyon med/ bcu gcig pa spyod lam gyi rnal 'byor ni/ gzhung las/ dngos su mi 'byung yang shugs las bstan la/ sa skya pa chen pos rang dang snang ba thams cad rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i skur dmigs la/ lha la lhas mchod par bsam pa sku'i dga' ba/ de yang sgyu ma lta bu'i sku dang bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i ngang las ma g.yos par dran par bya ba thugs kyi dga' ba/ sgra ci grags pa thams cad ngag gi bzlas par bya ba gsung gi dga' ba ste de ltar don bcu gcig go /zhes gsungs so// mdor na spyod lam gyi rnal 'byor 'di la nan tan du bya dgos te mnyam bzhag tu thugs dam mog mog re byas lo byas kyang rjes thob kun tu tha mal du lus na chos pa'i 'khyer so gtor 'gro gsung ngo*// de las 'phros pa'i don la zas kyi rnal 'byor phyi mchod sbyin sreg rgyas pa la'ang bzhi/ sdig pa sbyang ba'i phyir mar me'i sbyin sreg tshes bcu'i mchod pa gsum/ gtor ma'i rnal 'byor rnams dang*/ bzhi 'bum la sogs pa'i bsnyen pa ji ltar bya ba'i tshul/ sin+dhū ra'i sgrub pa'i bskyed rim gyi sems 'dzin man ngag gces btus sogs su 'byung ba'i rtsa dbu ma'i man ngag rnams mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags dang*/ rje kun dga' tshul khrims sogs kyis mdzad pa'i gong du rkang grangs smos pa'i yig char blta'o// 'dir zas kyi rnal 'byor gyi gsal kha cung zad bri na/ rang gi mdun du kha zas 'dus byas nas gtor ma ltar byin gyis brlabs/ rang rnal 'byor mar gsal ba'i thugs kar rdo rje rnal 'byor ma rgyan cha lugs yongs su rdzogs pa/ de de'i mtha' skor du bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyis bskor ba dwangs gsal rnyog pa med pa me long nang gi gzugs brnyan lta bur gyur/ zhes brjod cing dmigs pa la/ lte bar me 'bar ba'i khrod na dur khrod bdag po sogs chos srung nor lha'i tshogs dang bcas gsal bar gyur/

zhes brjod cing bsams la/ lha de dag mchod pa'i bsams pas/ kha hom khung lag pa dgang gzar blugs gzar du bsams te g.yas kyis g.yon du blugs cing zos pas phud kyis snying ga'i lha tshogs mchod/ lhag mas lte ba'i chos srung nor lha thams cad mchod par bsam mo// gal te lag pa g.yas pas g.yon du blugs cing za ba rgyun du ma byung na'ang bza' btung gang yin dang po kham 'ga' de ltar bya/ de nas ci bder bya gsungs/ phud mchod dang chang bu sogs spyi dang 'dra'o// zas kyi rnal 'byor bya tshul cung zad mi 'dra ba rnams gzhan du rtogs par bya'o// 'di ma chad pa gal che ste/ nang gi sbyin sreg tu 'gyur ba dang*/ rtsa ltung bcu gsum pa mi 'byung ba dang*/ kha zas bu lon can du mi 'gyur ba dang*/ 'dod sred kyis kun nas bslang ba'i bza' btung gi snang ba rnams sbyangs nus so// bsnyen pa'i skabs su lag len phal cher gzhung 'di'i gong 'og gi shugs las kyang shes la/ de na'ang shar rgyal mkhar rtse ba bdag po ngag dbang bsod nams rgyal mtshan sogs kyis bsnyen thabs yod do// der cung zad mi gsal ba mtshams lo gcig byed na sngon 'gro skyabs 'gro yig brgya maṇ+ḍal rnams zhag bdun bdun byed/ zla ba gsum byed na zhag gsum re'o// 'di'i 'bru 'bum gyi don oṃ gsum ma la yig 'bru so gnyis bam̐ yig gi srog yig bzhi dang bcas pa'i so bdun 'byung la/ de la bsnyen pa oṃ gsum ma 'bum phrag so gnyis sam so lnga so bdun rnams gang rung lo gcig la 'gro zhing sbyin sreg byed na de'i kha bskang zhing mi byed na khri phrag so bdun sogs kha bskang du bzla'o// gzhung gi mjug don ni/ las dang po pa'i bsgom pa mdor bsdus pa/ slob dpon nā ro ta pa'i zhal gyi gdams ngag brgyud pa'i rjes su gnang ba rdzogs so// rgya gar gyi mkhan po su ma ti'i zhal snga nas dang dge slong pradz+nyā kirtis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa'o// zhes pa 'di la bskyed rim phag mo mkha' spyod/

ces gsungs kyang don gyi bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug yin pa'i phyir gzhan las khyad par 'phags te/ dbang bzhi lus sgrig gi nyams len gyi gnad kyis so zhes gsungs so// de dag gis ni rgya gzhung dang sbyar te bskyed rim phag mo mkha' spyod kyi rnam bshad mdor bsdus te bstan zin to// gsum pa shin tu zab pa'i rdzogs pa'i rim pa bshad pa ni/ rdzogs rim gyi tshe steng mkha' spyod kyi 'khor lo la brten pa mi rtog pa bsgrub pa/ 'og rlung gi 'khor lo la brten nas bde ba bsgrub pa/ bar sngags kyi 'khor lo la brten nas drod bsgrub pa'i thabs rnams so// de yang rdzogs pa'i rim pa bsgom pa'i gang zag bskyed rim gyi sems 'dzin sogs legs par mthar phyin pa gegs sel sogs nges pa dang bcas pas bsgom dgos so// de la rdzogs rim rnam pa mang yang*/ 'dir rje mus chen bud+dha dh+wa dza'i rnam bshad ltar bshad na 'di ltar 'byung ste/ sa chen gyi chos 'byung rkyang pa bsgoms na'ang zhes pas rdzogs rim bstan pa yin te/ sngon 'gro dang dngos gzhi gnyis las/ dang po ni tshams rngam sngags kyi srung 'khor bsgom/ de nas bla ma bsgom/ dpa' mo'i go cha dgod pa'o// 'di ni sgrub thabs dang 'brel bar bsgom pa'i dbang du byas la/ gzhan du skyabs sems yig brgya bla ma'i rnal 'byor maṇ+ḍal dang bcas pa'i rjes su bsgoms kyang rung bar bshad/ dang po la chos rje dpal rdor ba'i gsung gis rang rje btsun mar gsal ba'i gsang gnas nas smin mtshams kyi bar la dbu ma dmar po 'od zer gyi rang bzhin can gsal btab/ dbu ma'i mas sna ru rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyi ngo bo chos 'byung dmar po cig bsam/ de'i dbus su dpa' bo thams cad kyi ngo bo dga' ba 'khyil pa g.yon du 'khor ba la sems gtad/ dmigs pa gtso che rlung 'dzin pa med do// de ltar byas pas dbu ma kha bye/ der rlung sems thams cad 'dus/

dbu ma nas yar zhugs pas bde ba'i ye shes skyes par bsam mo// yang smin mtshams su chos 'byung sngar dang 'dra ba las rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyi ngo bo dga' ba 'khyil pa g.yon phyogs su 'khor ba sogs sngar dang 'dra bar byas pa las/ shes rab stong pa'i ye shes skyes par bsam mo// mthar gsang gnas dang yang smin mtshams su chos 'byung dga' 'khyil dang bcas pa dbu mar zhugs snying khar kha sbyar bas bde stong dbyer med kyi ye shes skyed par bsam mo// yang rje zhwa lu pa'i gsung gis lte ba'i bam̐ dang spyi bo'i haṃ dbu mas zung sbrel bar bsams la/ lte bar yid bzlas la sems gtad pas bam̐ las me 'bar te dbu ma nas yar tal song ste haṃ la phog pas de las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas 'bar 'dzag la sems gtad de/ de ltar byas pas bde stong gi ye shes dang de la bogs dbyung ba'i phyir grwa bzhi'i dga' ba 'khyil pa rnams g.yon du 'khor bar bsam pas bde ba chen po g.yos te lus thams cad bde bas gang bar bsam mo// yang bsdu na chos 'byung phyi ma nang ma la bsdus nas chos 'byung gcig gi nang du dpa' bo thams cad kyi ngo bo zla ba sran ma phyed bkas pa tsam gsal btab/ de'i steng du rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyi ngo bo bam̐ dmar yungs 'bru tsam cig gsal btab/ de la rtse gcig tu yid gtad nas bsgoms pas bam̐ las me 'bar ba sogs sngar ltar bsgom pas bde stong gi ye shes skyes par bsam mo// de ltar thun mong ma yin pa'i rdzogs rim song nas/ da yab dang thun mong ba'i rdzogs rim rtsa dbu ma nyams su len pa la/ rje btsun gyis yab la sbyar kyang yum la sbyor ba bshad cing mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho las/ slar yang rdo rje phag mo yis// rnal 'byor ma yis rigs ldan mchod// de yi dus kyi ye shes ni// mkhas pas a wa d+dhū tī'i nang*// zhes dang*/ rnal 'byor ma mchog 'byung ba ni// rtsa rnams kun gyi grong khyer mchog

/stong phrag bdun cu rtsa gnyis kyi// dbu ma a wa dhū tī 'o// de ltar phag mo gtso bo ste// go 'phang mchog bzhin shes par bya// zhes so// 'di nyid nyams su len pa la gdams ngag gi mtshan nyid kyi rnam grangs zab pa'i dpe gsum dang ldan pa'i zab khyad gsum de dang ldan pa'i lam bsgom pa las/ rtogs bya dngos po'i gnas lugs/ de la brten nas 'bras bu 'grub pa'i tshul/ sgrub byed kyi lam nyams su blangs pa rnams su yod pa las mtshan la du ma yod de/ rtsa rgyud las/ pho nya lhag pa'i skyes grub ni// mchog dang 'bring dang tha ma ste// zhes pho nya mchod gdams ngag ces bya'o// da lan pho nya rtsa la byed pas/ mchog tu dbu ma/ 'bring nyer bzhi/ tha ma bug pa brgyad kyi rtsa'o// 'di ni pho nya mchog mchod pa yin no// ci'i phyir pho nya bya na/ mchog thun mong gi dngos grub thams cad 'gugs pa'o// de la rlung sems dbu mar chud dgos te/ de la sdud dgos/ sdud pa'i gdams ngag ni/ mu tig phreng ba'i mchan las/ rlung sems dbu mar sdud pa'i gdam ngag gnyis te/ bdag lhar gnas pa dang*/ tsaṇ+ḍā li'o// zhes bshad pas le'u dang po'i brjod bya 'di yin par bstan no// yang rtsa rgyud las/ rnal 'byor ma dus khyad par du// rigs ldan ma rnams rtag mchod bya// zhes rigs ldan ma mchod pa'i gdams ngag ces kyang bya'o// de la dmar chos kyi rgyal mtshan ni/ dbu ma la rigs ldan ma zhes bya ste// lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes kyi// rigs mang ldan pa zhes bya'o// zhes gsungs/ bla ma zhang bya ru bas/ rtsa sum cu rtsa drug la sogs pa'i rigs dang ldan pas so// zhes bshad/ kun spyod las/ bsam gyis mi khyab de bshad na// des ni gzungs ni thob par 'gyur// zhes gsungs so// bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i gdams ngag ces bya ste/ rlung sems dbu mar chud pa las rtogs bya dngos po'i gnas lugs rtogs dgos/ de la brten nas stobs bcu la sogs pa'i yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang ldan pa'i sangs rgyas thob pa'i thabs yin no// brtag gnyis las/

kun 'dar ma ni dbus su gnas// gzung dang 'dzin pa rnam par spangs// zhes gzung 'dzin gnyis kyi rnam rtogs btsan thabs su gcod pa'i gdams ngag ces bya ste/ dbu ma las gzhan pa'i rtsa gang du rlung sems gnas kyang gzung 'dzin skyed par byed la gdams ngag 'di'i sgo nas rtsa rlung sems thams cad dbu mar bsdus nas gzung 'dzin dang bral ba'i gnyis med kyi ye shes rtogs pa'i thabs yin pas so// de ldan gyi gdams ngag de gzhan las zab pa'i rgyu mtshan ci zhe na/ zab pa'i dpe gsum dang ldan te/ bshan pa srog gi gnad la mkhas pa/ 'khrul 'khor mkhan 'khrul 'khor la mkhas pa/ shing mkhan shing gi gnad la mkhas pa'o// dang po ni srog gcod pa la mkhas pa gcig gis rtsa gnas pa'i sa der shing gshags la sogs pa cung zad cig bsnun pas sems can gyi srog 'gags/ rkang lag sogs la bsnun pa dang de 'phral mi 'chi ba yin no// gnyis pa ni/ lho nub kyi phyogs la rgyal po bho dza de wa'i pho brang na zhal ba chu ris byas te de la sbal lcong la sogs pa'i gzugs brnyan bris/ sgo bzhir shing gi mi s+t+wa gri thogs pa gnyis gnyis yod de/ gzhan gyis bltas pa'i tshe zhal ba chur mer ba sbal lcong 'khrugs pa mthong ste/ der phyin pas shing gi mis dum bur gtub pa cig yod/ shing gi mi la mdzings pas mi thub/ 'khrul 'khor gyi gnad la mkhas pa cig gis srung 'khor thag pa cig yod pa de bcad nas shing gi mi thams cad rang 'gyel du 'gro/ gsum pa ni/ lho phyogs ḍā ki pa ta zhes pa'i grong khyer na shing sdong po chen po gcig la mi s+t+wa gri thogs pa brgyas bcad kyang mi chod pa che ru ka 'gro ba cig yod/ shing gi gnad la mkhas pa cig gis chu rgyu ba'i 'phrang bltas te der bug pa la shing gi gzer cig brgyab nas shing de rang skam la 'gro ba yin no// de bzhin du gzung 'dzin gyi rnam rtog dbu ma 'ba' zhig tu bsdus nas nyams su blangs pas dbu ma'i kha phye nas der rlung sems 'dus nas gzung 'dzin thams cad rang 'gyel rang skam la 'gro ba yin no// rtogs bya dngos po'i gnas lugs kyang der rtogs pa yin no// de bas na 'bad pas bsgom ste/

ma bsgoms na mi rtogs ma rtogs na yon tan bdag rgyud la mi thob ste/ klu sgrub kyis bsgrubs pa'i dngul chu bzhin no// de la dngul chu thig gcig la rdzas gser mu man mu tig kham dkar po rak+ta dri chen sha chen gla rtsi mu zi dri chu ste bcu gcig bsres kyang che ru mi 'gro/ mdog kyang dngul chu'i mdog lta bu yong ba cig yod la/ bcud len ma grub pa'i dus yon tan bcu gcig 'byung ba'i nus pa yod kyang mngon du mi 'gyur/ 'grub na mngon du 'gyur te gser gyi mdog ser ba dang lo drug brgya thub/ mu men gyis stobs che mig gi dbang po gsal/ byang sems kyis grang ba sel/ rak+tas rgyal po dbang du 'du/ dri chen gyis klu nad sel/ sha chen gyis mi ma yin pa dbang du 'du/ gla rtsis dri zhim/ mu tig gis mdog legs tshe ring*/ chus mtshon gyis mi tshugs par 'gyur/ de bzhin du kun gzhi'i steng na yon tan rin po che 'byung ba'i nus pa yod kyang mngon du mi 'gyur ba la gnas lugs rtogs dgos te rtogs pa la bsgom dgos pa yin no// dpe gsum gyis mtshon pa'i zab khyad gang zhe na gsum ste/ gzhi 'khor ba'i gnas lugs bsgom pa/ rnal 'byor pa'i gnad/ 'bras bu sangs rgyas pa'i gnad/ dang po 'khor ba'i zag bcas kyi lus dang rtog bcas kyi sems yin te/ rtog bcas kyi sems las rnam rtog de las nyon mongs pa/ de las las kyi dbang gis 'khor ba mtha' med du 'khyams pa yin te/ de gang gis nyes snyam na sems rlung dang 'phrad pas nyes te/ las kyi rlung dang ma 'phrad pa'i dus su sems gnyug ma ma bcos pa rnal du pheb pa yin la rlung dang 'phrad na sems rnam rtog tu song*/ rtsa tha dad du rgyus pas rnam rtog bcas/ rtsa tha dad du khams rgyus/ de rlung dang 'dres pas lus zag bcas su byas so// de bzhin du bshad na bag chags kyi sems pha ma'i khams dkar dmar dang ro gcig tu 'dres te/

bag chags thams cad khams dkar dmar la smin pas sems can gyi lus grub ste/ de yang thog mar lte ba'i gnas su rtsa a na ha ta bya ba mtshal gyi shad lta bu cig chags/ de nas nam mkha'i rlung rgyu/ shar du dbyug tho lta bu/ de nas sa rlung rgyu/ lhor tsheg drag lta bu/ de nas me rlung rgyu/ nub tu thang gug lta bu/ de nas chu rlung rgyu/ byang du thig le lta bu/ de nas rlung gi rlung rgyu'o// de'i phyi skor la a ka tsa ṭa ta pa ya sha'i dbyibs can brgyad chags/ de nas 'byung ba bzhi'i rlung cha snyom du rgyu'o// de'i phyi skor la rtsa 'dab bcu chags te/ rtsa ba'i rlung lnga dang yan lag gi rlung lnga ste bcu rgyu'o// de'i phyi skor la rtsa 'dab bcu gnyis chags te/ pho gdangs kyi yi ge ring po drug dang*/ mo gdangs kyi yi ge thung ngu drug gi dbyibs su chags/ pho gdangs rlung gi phyir rgyu ba dang gzung ba bskyed/ mo gdangs kyi rlung nang du 'jug pa dang 'dzin pa bskyed/ de'i phyir rtsa 'dab sum cu chags te sde tshan lnga dang sbas pa sde tshan te/ yi ge sum cu'i dbyibs su yod/ sde tshan dang po nas rtsa rlung rgyu/ gnyis pa nas chu rlung rgyu/ gzhan la yang shes par bya'o// de nas 'khor lo rnams kyi rtsa brgya nyi shu rtsa mdud so gsum/ yul nyer bzhi/ rtsa phran stong phrag bdun cu rtsa gnyis la sogs pa chags so// de rnams rlung rgyus pa las rlung bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'phel te/ yul nyer bzhi sa rlung dgu brgya phrag re yod pa las rlung nyi khri chig stong drug brgya la sogs pa las rlung bsam gyis mi khyab pa yod la/ de rnams kyis sems rtog bcas gzung 'dzin dang bcas pa stong*/ rtsa des khams rgyus rlung dang 'dres pa las/ lus zag bcas skye 'chi dang stong*/ khams dang rlung gcig yin kyang byed las tha dad ste/ khams kyis rigs drug gi so sen mo la sogs pa'i lus skyed rlung gis rtog bcas kyi sems bskyed de/

rim lnga las/ rnam par shes pa ni zhen pa'i// rlung zhes bya ba'i las kun byed// ces gsungs te/ de yang lte ba na gnas pa'i tshe/ gzung 'dzin rags pa ni mi bskyed/ sems blangs pa la rnam rtog gi rtsa ba lta bu'i dus zhes/ snying ga na gnas pa'i tshe sems dang 'dres/ gzung 'dzin bskyed pa lo ma'i rlangs pa lta bu'i dus zhes bya ba yin no// mgrin par sleb pa'i tshe dbang po'i sgo la brten nas yul la dmigs pa'i rtog pa khar song ste/ 'bras bu smin pa lta bu'i dus zhes bya ste/ rim lnga las/ rlung rnams phra ba'i gzugs kyis ni// shes dang yang dag 'dres gyur pas// dbang po'i lam nas byung nas ni// yul rnams la ni dmigs par byed// ces 'di rnams nad ngos bzung ba yin no// de gsos par byed pa'i sman nyams su blangs pa la gsum/ sngon 'gro rlung sbyor ba/ dngos po'i bdag nyid lhag par gnas pa/ mjug gtum mo tsaṇ+ḍā li kha 'byed pa'o// dang po la gsum ste/ rab 'bring dang tha ma'o// de yang rlung che 'bring chung gsum la bzhag go /rab kyis zhag gsum la rlung mthar phyin te nyin zhag re la thun chen drug drug thun chen re la thun lnga lnga ste thun chen bco brgyad thun chung bcu drug la/ sa bcu gnyis kyi rlung stobs su 'gyur/ 'byung bzhi mnyam/ gtum mo'i drod skyes te mthar phyin pa yin no// 'bring zhag bdun thun chung sngar dang 'dra/ tha ma zhag bco lnga la thun phyed dang*/ lnga brgya nas mthar phyin pa yin no// thun tshad nyin gyi sum cha yin la/ sum cha'i lnga cha thun chung gcig gi tshod/ de yang nyi ma dang po'i snga thun la mtshon na/ de la thun chung lnga yod pas/ se gol gtogs pa dang pus mo la bskor ba gcig byas pas btang*/ yang gcig byas rlung btang*/ se gol gtogs pa dang pus mo bskor ba gcig bya/ yang btang*/ yang gcig bya/ rlung btang*/ de ltar thun chung gcig po ma rdzogs bar la ci nus bya'o// thun chen re la sngon 'gro rnams tshang bar bya'o// thun chung dang po rdzogs nas stan las mi ldang*/

chang la sogs pa zas kyi bya ba cung zad byas la khams gso'o// thun chung gnyis pa la pus mo la bskor ba lan gnyis bya rlung btang*/ yang gnyis bya rlung btang*/ 'di ltar ci nus bya'o// gsum pa la babs pa na se gol dang bskor ba gsum bya rlung btang*/ yang gsum bya rlung btang*/ de ltar gsum ma rdzogs bar la ci nus bya'o// rdzogs nas mi ldang zas sogs sngar ltar ro// bzhi pa la babs na se gol dang bskor ba bzhi bya/ rlung btang*/ yang bzhi bya/ rlung btang*/ de ltar ci nus bya'o// lnga pa la babs na lnga bya rlung btang*/ de ltar ci nus bya'o// 'di gzhan la yang sbyar bar bya'o// de ltar byas pas zhag bco lnga'i bar thun chung tha ma la se gol dang bskor ba phyed dang lnga brgya'o// thun chung lnga rdzogs pa dang thun chen gcig rdzogs pa yin pas/ langs la spyod lam bya'o// de ltar khog phub nas nyams su len pa la/ bca' ba lus kyi gnad rdo rje'i skyil krung*/ lag pa mnyam bzhag lte bar bcer/ sgal tshigs drang po la mig snying kha mthong ba tsam bya/ gtad pa sems kyi dmigs pa ni/ rlung khams ji snyed yod pa thams cad lte bar sgrims nas bsgoms/ rje zhwa lu pa'i gsung gis dbyug to lta bu la sogs pa rtsa rnams kyi nang du bsgom gsungs kyang*/ rje btsun gyis rtsa dang rlung thams cad phyogs gcig tu 'dril ba las thig ler gyur pa bltas la/ zhes gsungs pas rtsa nang du bsgom pa yin no gsungs/ des shar ljang*/ lho ser/ nub dkar/ byang dmar po/ dbus su thig le sngon po bsgom/ rnam pa thig le rgyu rlung lha yab yum lnga dang ye shes lnga yin no// de ltar dbus kyi thig le sngon po la sems gtad pas rlung phyir 'gro ba'i tshe thig le sngon po las rlung spos reng dud pa ltar lus kyi dkyil nas yar sngo na rar song sna bug gi phyir ji ltar mtshams pa cig song bar bsam/ nang du 'jug pa'i tshe thig le sngon po la thim par bsam/

de ltar lan bdun tsam bya'o// mthar 'og rlung bskum thig le la bstim/ steng rlung mnan thig le la bstim ste kha sbyar pus mo la bskor ba dang se gol gtogs pa gcig bya rlung btang*/ yang gcig bya rlung btang*/ de ltar ci nus bya'o// de ltar gzhan la'ang sbyar bar bya'o// de ltar zhag bdun dang gsum dang bco lnga las mthar phyin pa yin no// sngon 'gro rlung sbyangs pa'o// gnyis pa dngos gzhi rang nyid lhag par gnas pa'i rnal 'byor bsgom pas/ dang po lte ba'i gnas su drod 'byung*/ de nas lus la drod 'byung*/ de nas gnas khang dang nye 'khor thams cad la drod byung*/ de'i stobs kyis bud med dang sbyar ba'i bde ba'i dpes mtshon du med pa'i lus la bde ba 'byung ste rlung lus la chud pa'i rtags yin no// rang lus ras kyi 'dab ma ltar yang ba dang sangs rgyas kyi chos kyi sku'i ye shes rang yin snyam pa'i nyams byung ste/ rlung sems la chud pa'i rtags yin no// de nas snang mi snang bde mi bde la sogs pa las 'das pa'i nyams khyad par can 'byung ste/ dus de'i tshe rang gi lus kyang dbu mar 'jug pa snyam byed/ rtsa gnyis kyang dbu mar 'jug pa snyam byed pa 'byung ste/ dang po la tshor ba bde ba/ gnyis pa la mi rtog pa bde ba/ gsum pa la mtshon byed dpe'i ye shes bya ba yin te dus de'i tshe dbu ma kha 'byed du rung yang re zhig sngar gyi rgyun bskyangs te bsgoms pas mnyam bzhag la dmigs pa gang bsgoms kyang lag mthil gyi ri mo ltar du gsal/ rjes spyod du dang po du ba lta bu/ gnyis pa smig rgyu/ gsum pa srin bu me khyer/ bzhi pa mar me/ lnga pa 'od 'bar ba chen po/ drug pa zla ba/ bdun pa nyi ma/ brgyad pa rgyu skar gyi snang ba/ dgu pa ra hu la ste smad med pa'am/ zla ba nag po 'jigs su rung ba'i gzugs mthong ba/ bcu pa la ri mo nag po ste/ nam mkha' la thig btab pa lta bu'i rtags bcu mthong*/

rtse tsam na dbu la yang nor bu'i nang na skud pa yod pa ltar mi gsal ba'i tshul gyis spring spring dngos su mthong la/ lte ba'i aṃ las/ me spar te smin mtshams kyi bar du tal le 'bar ba mngon sum du 'byung ngo*// dbu ma kha 'byed la song nas der rlung sems 'dus na tshe 'di la phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub thob pa yin no// yang rtags thams cad ma mthong zhing ci rigs mthong na 'chi kha'i bar do la 'grub/ rtags ma mthong zhing drod tsam skyes na mtho ris skye ba brgyud nas rten de las 'grub bo// de ltar nyams su len pa la dmigs pa gsum/ bdag byin gyis brlabs pa dang*/ tsaṇ+ḍā li sngon 'gro dang dngos gzhi gnyis la re re'o// dang po nyams su len pa la/ bca' ba lus kyi gnad sngar las dam du btang ba tsam la gtad pa/ sems kyi dmigs pa lte ba'i rtsa mdud kyi nang du phag mo ti la ka mtshal gyi shad lta bu'i steng du thig le dmar po cig yod pa la gsal btab/ spyi bor haṃ gi steng du thig le dkar po yungs 'bru tsam yod pa mgo mthur du bstan pa la gsal btab/ de gnyis rtsa dbu mar zung 'brel lo// rtsa g.yas g.yon gnyis kyang kha dog dmar po sbom phra gro sog 'bring po tsam lte ba nas spyi bo'i bar la gser gyi thur ma bshibs pa ltar yod/ spyi bo nas ro rkyang gnyis sba gug pa ltar gug pas sna bug gnyis la zug pa'o// dgang ba rlung gi gnad ni/ rkang mthil na rang bzhin gyis grub pa'i rlung yod pa de rgyu mo gzhung gnyis gul gul byas pas g.yos te/ brla'i rtsa bo che nas yar song sum mdo/ de nas 'og sgo 'gyed 'dzum gyi sbyor ba byas pas/ bshang sgo'i rlung g.yos de dang sum mdo'i rlung gnyis kyis aṃ la bus bas aṃ las me cha phra ba 'bar/ ro rkyang gnyis nas yar song bas ltag par rtsom chen stobs kyi rlung zla ba phyed pa'i dbyibs su yod pa de bus pas spyi bor song*/

de na yod pa'i haṃ dang rlung sna bug gnyis nas cung zad rngubs pa rnams kyi ro rkyang gi me klog ste aṃ gi gnas su cher 'bar/ des dbu ma kha bye ste dbu ma na ta le 'bar ba la sems gtad de rlung kha sbyor/ de la thun grangs med do// de ltar bsgoms pas nyams snang la dbu ma la me stag 'phro 'phro ba snyam byed pa dang*/ me de las thig le dkar dmar 'phro ba snyam byed pa dang*/ rang gi lus la yang me stag 'phro ba snyam byed pa 'byung ngo*// de'i rgyun bskyangs te bsgoms pas/ dang po lte ba'i gnas su drod 'byung ba la sogs pa sngar bshad pa'i drod rtags rnams 'byung ste/ dmigs pa dang po'o// gsum pa gtum mo tsaṇ+ḍa lī kha 'byed pa la/ sngon 'gro dngos gzhi gnyis/ dang po tha mal gyi gtum mo dang 'od kyi gtum mo kha sbyar te lte ba nas 'bar ba tha mal dang*/ spyi bo nas 'bar ba 'od kyi'o// de la gtad pa sems kyi dmigs pa ni/ lte ba'i gnas su rtsa mdud gru gsum pa'i aṃ mtshal gyi shad lta bu/ de'i thig le yungs 'bru tsam dmar po/ de'i gseb tu k+ṣuṃ

tha mal kyi gtum mo zhes bya/ dmar nag drod kyi rang bzhin can mgo mthur bstan gsal btab/ de'i phyi skor la phyi mo brgyad g.yon du bskor 'dab ma lnga bcu drug la g.yas skor du kā li so bzhi/ g.yon skor du ā li bcu drug dang thung a i u e o aṃ drug po 'di kā li'i rjes su dang*/ de nas ā li ste thams cad g.yon 'khor gyi lugs kyang snang ngu drug rnams bkod de/ kha dog dmar po 'od zer rang bzhin can/ spyi bor haṃ mgo thur bstan de'i spyi bor thig le dkar po/ de gseb tu k+ṣuṃ 'od kyi gtum mo zhes bya dmar nag mgo thur bstan no// aṃ dang haṃ gnyis rtsa dbu mas zung sbrel/ g.yas g.yon gyi gnyis kyang sngar ltar du gsal btab bo// dgang ba rlung gnad rkang pa gnyis phar drud tshur drud byas pas rkang mthil gyi rlung g.yos/ de bshang sgo'i rlung dang bsdongs te/ aṃ la bus pas aṃ las me sbar te/ dbu ma nas yar song*/ snying kha tsam du sleb/ yang sna bug gnyis nas rlung rngubs pas dpral ba dang ltag pa'i rlung g.yos/ haṃ la bus pas haṃ gi steng gi k+ṣuṃ las me 'bar/ dbu ma nas mar song snying khar sleb pa dang*/ me gnyis khrug chil 'dres te gcig gis gcig la thug brgyab pa dang me stag phro phro 'phros/ lus kyi nang thams cad mes khengs te drod dpag tu med par 'byung bar bsam mo// de ltar byas pas drod chen po skyes te drags na cung zad lhod la bzhag go /de ltar thun drug tu bcad nas bsgom/ 'di pa'i lugs kyi phyag rgya'i rnal 'byor mi dgos par rlung sems dbu mar tshud nas chos thams cad kyi gnas lugs spros bral bde stong zung 'jug gi thabs lam la brten te slob pa'i sa bcu gnyis rim gyis bgrod nas bcu gsum rdo rje theg pa'i sa mngon du byed par 'gyur ro// de ltar byas pas dbu ma kha 'byed ran pa'i rtags gong du 'byung ba rnams bshad la kha 'byed pa'i gdams ngag sngar gzhan dang 'dra ba las 'bar 'dzag dkar dmar gyi rnam pa sems gtad te/

rtsa rgyud las/ rnal 'byor pa dus khyad par du// rigs ldan ma rnams rtag mchod bya// zhes pas rigs ldan ma'i mchod pa yin no// rigs ldan ma'i mchog dbu ma yin pas de mchod par byed do// tshul ji ltar mchod na/ dus khyad par can zhes gsungs pas/ ku mun ta dang pū li ra ma la ya dang*/ dza lan+dha ra rnams su byang sems thim pa dang longs spyod dang dbang du bya ba dang gsum yod pa las/ spyir longs spyod pa ste/ byang sems kyis gang ba'i dus der mchod de/ yang so dang sen mo'i khams bskyed pa'i khams ji snyed thams cad spyi bor bsdus dbu mar 'jug pa'i 'bar 'dzag la sems gtad de/ de dbu ma bde stong lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes skyes/ de'i rang nyid rje btsun mar gsal ba'i phung khams skye mched thams cad la rgyas btab nas bsgom pa ni/ rang rdzas thig le sangs rgyas dang*// byang chub sems dpa' mchod par bya// zhes pa'i don yin no// 'bar 'dzag nyi shu rtsa bzhir yang 'gyur ba yin no// spyi don gsum pa nyams su blang ba'i 'bras bu ni/ de ltar bskyed rdzogs gnyis la brten nas drod gsum rim par skyes shing gsang spyod dang phyogs las rnam rgyal dang*/ nye rgyus nyams len rnams kyis lam mthar phyin nas rtsa thams cad e wam̐ zung 'jug dang rnam rtog thams cad mi rtog pa'i ye shes lngar gyur pa'i 'bras bu mngon du byed pa'o// de yang mkha' spyod chen po ni/ sangs rgyas kyi sa ste sku gsum yan lag bdun ldan gyi go 'phang brnyes pas so// 'bring mkha' spyod dang rig pa 'dzin pa tshe 'di nyid la thob par byed pa ste/ mkha' spyod chung ngu ni/ 'ja' lus rdo rje'i sku lo bcu drug lon pa'i ngang tshul can spyir longs spyod thams cad nam mkha' las 'byung zhing rdzu 'phrul gyis nam mkha' la 'gro nus pa sprul sku las dngos su chos gsan cing sprul sku'i zhing khams su thogs med 'gro nus pa tshe de la sangs rgyas pa cig yin gsungs so// de dag gis rje btsun nā ro mkha' spyod kyi bskyed rdzogs kyi rnam bshad mkha' spyod lam bzang zhes bya ba rgyas bsdus mtshams pa'i ngag gis bstan zin to//
